rows.name: Harmonic Depths
rows.short_description: Embark on a relaxing journey in an underwater realm. Glide through captivating environments, embracing the tranquility of exploration and survival found in these Harmonic Depths.
rows.description_html: Overview Embark on a relaxing journey in an underwater realm. Glide through captivating environments, embracing the tranquility of exploration and survival found in these Harmonic Depths. Play in Survival Mode, managing your health, which gradually decreases over time, and replenishing it by feasting on the abundant fish that surround you, or immerse yourself in Casual Mode, exploring the ocean at your own leisure. Controls To move up, press the W key, or use the up arrow key. To move down, use the S key, or the down arrow key. For left turns, press A or the left arrow key, and for right turns, use D or the right arrow key. Hold down Left Click to boost. You can pause the game anytime by pressing the Escape Key. Press the Enter Key to return to the main menu.

rows.name: Project N3T
rows.short_description: Take control of a test subject tasked with testing out a new device that functions as a powerful magnet. Complete a few tests by moving metal objects and using the magnet as a grappling hook in this short single-player experience.
rows.description_html: You play as a test subject working for the company Quanti. You have been tasked with testing out a new device called the EMFR that functions as a very powerful magnet. Your mission is to complete a series of tests all designed around magnets. You'll be faced with platform challenges and other puzzles in this short single-player experience. Features: You'll be equipped with a very powerful magnet capable of pulling and pushing metal objects. With this, you can move large objects out of the way and pull giant metal balls into holes to progress. Your magnet also functions as a grappling hook, allowing you to pull yourself to high places or push yourself up in the air. As you progress through the tests, the Overseer will observe your performance and talk to you as you play. You'll get to know him, and hear the struggles he faces while working at the facility.

rows.name: Taora : Beginning
rows.short_description: Taora : Beginning offers the limited introduction experience to Taora : Survival, an open world survival game with unique character building and crafting. Build and upgrade your base, and survive the zombie apocalypse!
rows.description_html: Taora is an island that is infested with zombies and hold many places to explore and loot. You can build your base, craft and upgrade your gear, explore many unique places, loot materials or gears. You can upgrade your vehicle to suit your needs. Upgrade you characters` skills to fit different conditions like hacking electronics, reapiring broken things, healing the wounded or fighting with zombies. Looting: Loot materials needed for crafting, base building etc. Vehicles: There are many vehicles for you to use on Taora. Crafting: You can craft and upgrade your gears, vehicles, weapons, armors that make you a real survivor. Open World: You can hop on your vehicle and explore unique places on Taora. Survive: Shoot and kill as many zombies as you can to survive. Base Building: It is important to build your base to survive on Taora. You can store your loot and weapons on your base, build various tools or tables that help you to improve your weapons, vehicles and survivors. Skills: Skill up your character on different aspects, they can be a soldier to kill hordes of zombies, or a mechanic that can craft tools, disarm traps, unlock safes.

rows.name: Pirates Of Gensokyo
rows.short_description: Marisa rounds up a most unlikely crew, in search of adventure, and of course, treasure! Interpersonal conflict ensues among the crew, but in the end, their stark differences bring clarity to their personal lives. The real treasure is the one you find within yourself!
rows.description_html: A fangame for Touhou Project by ZUN A short visual novel about 4 girls, one of whom will discover who they are. Marisa rounds up a most unlikely crew, in search of adventure, and of course, treasure! Interpersonal conflict ensues among the crew, but in the end, their stark differences bring clarity to their personal lives. The real treasure is the one you find within yourself! Featuring: Marisa, Sanae, Alice, and Satori. But there will be a few more extra characters we meet along the way! With 1 hidden character! A story that features comedy, drama, romance, and heartfelt expressions of fear, shame, self-doubt, and love. Every route starts with warmth and humor and ends with something deeper and more intimate.

rows.name: Final Hour
rows.short_description: In a world on its deathbed, explore and connect with your neighbors for one last day.
rows.description_html: Final Hour is a 2D adventure RPG in which the player explores a world that is moments away from being destroyed by an exploding star. In response to the impending tragedy, the player must make one last attempt to connect with their neighbors before their tragic death… if it ever comes. On this adventure the player will encounter • 21 unique characters to interact with • Different interactions based on progression in the story • Many items to collect to assist the player on their journey

rows.name: self-indulgence
rows.short_description: A PSX-style psychological horror game. Search for your missing child in a decaying world of memories and dread. No jumpscares. Just a slow descent into something far worse.
rows.description_html: “When you’re finally there for yourself… will you be able to shoulder it?” Self-Indulgence is a PSX-style psychological horror game that drags you deep into a decaying world where memories rot and truth is a shifting shadow. Guided only by fading memories and desperation, a father searches for his missing child—only to uncover something far more disturbing than he ever imagined. What begins as a rescue turns into a descent into the unknown. 🔸 Retro survival horror, reimagined – tank controls, fixed camera angles, gritty textures 🔸 A story-driven nightmare – every clue pulls you deeper 🔸 2 major free updates coming post-launch 🔸 No jumpscares. Just dread. If you loved the eerie silence of Silent Hill , the tension of Resident Evil , and the mystery of Lost , you’re going to feel right at home—and very, very uncomfortable. Are you ready to remember what you’ve tried to forget?

rows.name: Stronghold Siege
rows.short_description: Command your army against a relentless demon horde in this intense real-time strategy game. Master strategy and resource management to conquer the enemy's stronghold while defending your own in the ultimate battle for survival.
rows.description_html: Overview Command your army against a relentless demon horde in this intense real-time strategy game. Master strategy and resource management to conquer the enemy's stronghold while defending your own in the ultimate battle for survival. As you progress through the game, you'll unlock new troops, each with unique abilities and strengths. Refine your strategy by leveraging your troops' strengths to exploit your enemy's weaknesses. Experiment with different unit compositions and tactics to discover the most effective ways to conquer the enemy. As you adapt and evolve your strategy, you'll find new and exciting ways to outwit your foes and claim victory in the heat of battle. Game Modes Choose your path to victory by playing in Siege Mode or Blitz Mode. In Siege Mode, begin with basic troops and gradually unlock more powerful units as you survive waves of increasingly challenging enemies. Test your endurance and strategic prowess as you build your forces from the ground up. In Blitz Mode, start with all troops at your disposal and race against time to conquer the enemy castle as quickly as possible, making split-second decisions to outmaneuver your opponents. Whether you prefer to manage the battle from a commanding view above the battlefield or dive into the heart of the action in third-person mode, Stronghold Siege offers an immersive experience that puts you in full control of your army's destiny. Lead your forces, devise cunning strategies, and claim victory in a world where every decision could be the difference between triumph and defeat.

rows.name: Stagelands – eternal defense
rows.short_description: Defend your lands from crowds of enemies! Create a unique multi-floor defense of your kingdom! Arrange your troops wisely, use ancient magic, repel the onslaught of the enemy!
rows.description_html: Defend your kingdom and conquer the lands of your enemies! From the magical portals comes a horde of enemies. Orcs, undead, and brigands want to tear apart your kingdom piece by piece. You have several different biomes (floors) to defend simultaneously, hire fighters for defense, to build towers, turrets, traps and various modules for reliable protection. Use their abilities and skills, and create your own tactics to successfully push back the enemy's army. Gameplay: You can play offline anywhere in the world; Convenient and simple controls, easy to understand and start playing right off. Have fun and get stronger; Unite into clans to crush the enemy – interact with each other; Grow your kingdom and improve your defenses. Invent your own tactics, use different skills and abilities; Offense is the best defense. Seize enemy lands, replenishing your supplies. Variety: Hundreds of different waves, each one unique, making you feel like a new game with different mechanics; Different modes, capturing castles and other lands, defending caravans, raiding resource islands; Different types and classes of enemies. No time to be bored: everyone needs a different approach; A wide variety of worlds-biomes to defend. From winter mountains to warm seashores: each location is unique and exciting; Each level is a unique biome with its own strong abilities for defense; Mages, knights, archers, dragons, towers, defense towers, defense modules – collect them all! Fight back your enemies on all levels. Build an impregnable fortress.

rows.name: Freestyle Ice Skater
rows.short_description: Freestyle Ice Skater is a casual action/sports game. Your goal is to join the local group of freestyle ice skaters, master your tricks and beat the rival team in an epic freestyle battle at the old Nagyerdei ice rink. The old ice rink was a real life location until it was shut down permanently.
rows.description_html: The original idea behind the game was to resurrect our old ice rink that was closed in 2011 and is still missed by local people. Freestyle Ice Skater is a casual action/sports game that takes place in real and fictional locations. Your goal is to join the local freestyle ice skaters - Nagyerdei Korisok - master your tricks and beat the rival team in an epic freestyle battle. Key Features: -Single player story mode where you progress by learning new tricks (mapped to keypress combos) / or solving puzzles. -Free skate mode on the maps with a couple of extra elements. -Fish game mode (a kind of a tag game, optionally with powerups) -Achievements -Basic character skill / stat progression

rows.name: Foxhaven
rows.short_description: Foxhaven is a gripping 3 vs 1 3D action multiplayer game. Among the four villagers, one is an Impostor, THE FOX. To avoid getting killed, the villagers must find six keys and escape from the village!
rows.description_html: Foxhaven is an online multiplayer game designed for 3 vs 1 3D action multi-player game. In this game, 4 players participate, with 1 player assuming the role of THE FOX. The objective is for the villagers to escape from the village without falling victim to THE FOX's schemes. To do so, they must find 6 keys scattered throughout the village. The central conflict revolves around the villagers' goal to identify who among them is THE FOX and to share this crucial information with their fellow players. Meanwhile, THE FOX aims to eliminate all the villagers before they can escape. Effective communication is pivotal for the villagers as they must swiftly discern the identity of THE FOX and disseminate this information to all players. Conversely, THE FOX endeavors to maintain a covert identity while discreetly eliminating villagers one by one. Can you escape from Foxhaven Village?

rows.name: No Recollection
rows.short_description: A mystery visual novel following a boy who awoke in a strange building, with no recollection of where he is, how he arrived, why he’s here, or how to leave. Discover the answers to these mysteries as you search for a way out. Meet a small but colorful cast in your journey, and escape together!
rows.description_html: About the story: You’ve awoken in a strange bedroom - a bedroom that is certainly not your own, located in a building you’ve never been inside of before. An equally strange building, with 10 different floors, all lacking windows of any kind. Upon further inspection, you come to the realization you are trapped in this mysterious building. You have no recollection of where this is or why you’re here. Actually, there seems to be a mysterious gap in your memory from the past few weeks. And so, a slew of questions flood your mind. “Where am I? Why am I here?” And most importantly: “how do I escape?” And you’re not alone here. Far from it. Meet a small but colorful cast of characters in your journey to answer the questions plaguing your mind. A unique group of people, whose thoughts seem to contradict your own. Interrogate them. Hang out with them. Explore this place with them. Uncover the truth with them. And most importantly, escape with them! About the gameplay: No Recollection is a full length visual novel that is completely free . Over 155,000 words within the game’s main story. Over 25,000 words of optional content (mostly consisting of alternate endings.) There are 6 different bad endings and 1 main ending. The game is mostly linear, focusing on one story; your choices can alter the order in which some events play out, and can occasionally result in a bad ending, but there is only one route. About the development: This game is a passion project I worked on for almost 3 years. It is the first novel I’ve ever written, as well as the first full game I’ve ever made. I also created the entire thing myself, so it may not be the epitome of quality. But even so, this game means a lot to me, regardless of how it turned out.

rows.name: Kaizo Block
rows.short_description: A tough, 2D, pixel-art platformer. Overcome 8 progressively more difficult Kaizo-style levels, or try and see how fast you can finish an already completed level. On this journey, momentum, jumps, air dashes, and frequent checkpoints are your friends. The world is your enemy.
rows.description_html: Kaizo Block is a precision 2D platformer with a retro pixel-art artstyle. It's tough, and only gets tougher, but it's also designed so that even inexperienced platforming gamers can pick it up. But for those true sadists and god-gamers among us, there is an even more brutal challenge in the form of time trials. Make use of momentum, jumps, air dashes, ground boosts, jump-orbs, and a multitude of movement techniques to overcome the game's 8 levels. Checkpoints are frequent, but hazards even more so. Spikes and giant saws will block your path, but if you are dexterous, you can weave through them in no time! Do you have what it takes to overcome the world of Kaizo Block?

rows.short_description: Quiz Game Night is a multiplayer trivia game for up to 10 players. Grab your friends, get any player-created pack from workshop and have a great game night!
rows.description_html: Quiz Game Night is a multiplayer trivia game for up to 10 players. Download question packs from the workshop or create your own. Invite your friends for an evening of thought-provoking questions and friendly rivalry. Become the quizmaster and host your own Quiz Game Night – where friendship and clever questions combine for a memorable multiplayer experience like no other.

rows.name: Blood Kiss
rows.short_description: The job I barely managed to get is in a dungeon filled with vampires? What would you do, if you had to work together with dangerous and mysterious vampires who hate humans? Experience the secret romance in interactive otome game with these ikemen vampires, in Blood Kiss!
rows.description_html: [Story] 'You, there's something sweet... and delicious about your scent.' In a twist of fate far from an inheritance, 'you' find yourself burdened with sudden debt. Just when all seems lost, an opportunity arises that could turn your life around. The catch? You must survive a detention center where vampires that have lost all control are imprisoned... In the vampire's lair, will 'your' future be fraught with danger, or could there possibly be a chance for romance? [Character] The dangerously sexy head vampire of noble lineage, 'Dayn' The kind-hearted half-vampire who sees himself as a monster, 'Gray' The vampire with a complex about his origins, mysteriously adorable, 'Ruel' Dayn's right-hand man, a loyal vampire, 'Eden' - Embark on a genuine otome romance simulation game where 'your' choices determine the ending. - Dive into a female-oriented visual novel where your decisions unfold unique storylines with four men. - In BloodKiss, you are the protagonist. Craft your own love story. - With over 200 choices, explore each character's ending, special illustrations, and hidden finales. - Begin your perilous yet romantic dates with these four men today.

rows.name: SpaceDRG
rows.short_description: SpaceDRG is a high-octane, motion sickness inducing action game featuring cute pixel art graphics. Fight against the letters D, R & G in a space themed 1980s retro arcade environment.
rows.description_html: SpaceDRG is a high-octane, motion sickness inducing action game featuring cute pixel art graphics. Fight against the letters D, R & G in a space themed 1980s retro arcade environment. Compete with friends for the top spot on online leader boards, master the art of space navigation and collect power ups to even the odds. SpaceDRG features a unique psychedelic color system which is a feast for the eyes and senses. Become a Master of Self Control SpaceDRG features a revolutionary convention breaking keyboard layout that encourages players to regulate emotions, resist impulsivity, and stay focused on long-term goals. Self-awareness, discipline, and aligning choices with personal values are key to success in the game. Use Power Responsibly SpaceDRG encourages the responsible use of in-game power. Wield power responsibly to navigate challenges. Misuse can lead to negative consequences. Recognizing the responsibility that accompanies power is essential for fostering a harmonious balance between authority and accountability. Compete In Online Leader Boards SpaceDRG contributes to overall societal progress by encouraging competition via online leader boards. This method has been proven to motivate players to improve continuously by using their creativity, efficiency, and resilience, while also cultivating essential skills and work ethics.

rows.name: Rusty Ride
rows.short_description: Take the wheel as a gritty veteran in a jetpack-equipped car with a tank cannon. Traverse dynamic, procedurally generated landscapes, obliterate obstacles, and unlock explosive upgrades. A thrilling, action-packed adventure awaits!
rows.description_html: Embark on an exhilarating adventure as a rugged veteran in the driver's seat of a battle-worn vehicle that's seen better days, yet harbors a heart of steel. This isn't just any decrepit car — it's a roaring beast equipped with a formidable tank cannon and a high-powered jetpack, ready to defy both age and gravity. Journey through a procedurally generated world that unfurls new challenges and vistas with each play through. Unleash chaos as you obliterate obstacles in your path, transforming your once humble vehicle into a powerhouse of destruction with a plethora of upgrades awaiting to be discovered. Flex your strategic muscles as you decide whether to obliterate your enemies in a rain of cannon fire or soar to new heights to reach previously inaccessible areas. Since Unity is now fucked up, I decided to semi cancel this game. Now it will be completely free, so they don't make any money from it. But now the game will be only 1 level long. I might continue the project and 100% complete it if I don't have anything better to do with my life, but now I'll probably start a new game on UE5 or Godot

Adder challenges players to manage random weapons, ammo, and abilities while fighting through hordes of zombies on procedurally generated levels. Unyielding Zombie Hordes: Employ strategic thinking to survive against relentless zombie waves. Dive deeper into the gameplay with the developer console (toggle with the tilde key `).

rows.name: ColorCoordination
rows.short_description: ColorCoordination is a puzzle game where you match colored blocks and spaces by moving them in unison. Explore deep, philosophical topics with your AI Assistant 'CoCo' and discover more about its purpose - all while solving a myriad of colorful brainteasers!
rows.description_html: MEET COCO Meet your assigned AI companion, CoCo! This charming assistant is very curious and talkative . This AI partner will help you navigate the software but will also bring up several topics ranging from your experience with the puzzles to the value of life. As you progress, you'll also uncover a mystery surrounding CoCo and the company that created it. COORDINATE THE COLORS Match blocks and spaces of the same color by shifting entire rows or columns of them in unison! Careful though, as the blocks will respect the empty spaces in between! Even if one block in the group can't move, none of them will move ; they work as a whole! COLORBLINDNESS ACCESIBILITY On top of being color-coded, all blocks and spaces are marked by clearly distinguishable symbols! FEATURES Accesibility options for colorblindness! 50+ brain scratching puzzles! Fun interactions with CoCo! Philosophical reflection of AI and artificial life. Unravel a mystery and its hidden lore! Two unique endings! Optional post-game content! Challenging achievements!

rows.short_description: To get to heaven, you must climb the Nine Circles of Hell. But you might never make it to the depths.
rows.description_html: STORY Going down to get to heaven has never been easy. You are the Fallen, a believer in a higher power who only wanted to enter Paradise. But when you're sent to the depths of Hell, you can only do one thing: travel through the Nine Circles and state your case of innocence to Satan. Everyone has been kind to you so far. Too kind, maybe. Especially the Keeper of Heresy, the Sixth Circle. In the confines of his space while an ash storm rages outside, the two of you pry each other open. But he might break you first. FEATURES Loosely based on real world religions and Dante's Inferno , 10:16 is a story about possessiveness, melancholy, and unfamiliar ash. Over 8,000 words Lo-fi and grunge visuals, combining photography with hand-drawn illustrations 6 endings, all of which decide your fate in the Circle of Heresy Steam achievements Full voice acting in English, done by the lovely Zack Valence.

rows.name: Armchair Commander
rows.short_description: A turn-based strategy game where you can experience WWII campaigns and explore alternate history scenarios made by the community.
rows.description_html: Relive history! This is the only game out there with an unlimited number of missions you can play — there are thousands of them, many created by committed players! Play or create your own missions in World War 2 and all the way through the Cold War. Learn to master the skill of the commander and conquer every enemy! Wargame & Turn-based Simulation From the Battle of Stalingrad to the Normandy landings, it’s got the vast majority of WW2 covered. Play as Germany, the Soviet Union, Republic of China, United States, Great Britain, or any of the 100+ countries with additional customization possible. Attack enemy strongholds and defend your cities with 20+ land, naval, and air units. Even the same unit has special functionalities differing by country! Campaigns & Conquests There are currently about 30 or so missions and conquest maps. The missions can be played through the story line, and the conquests (you get to choose your country) feature 1939-1950 Europe and 1937-1950 Asia. All the campaign maps can be downloaded and modified at your own will, as seen in the following section... Sandbox & Custom Maps Like I said, you can create your own maps; you can even upload them for the world to see! The map editor is readily available for use inside the base game. Every aspect of a mission is customizable: a country’s alliance, resources, cities, airports, troops, veterency, troop attack distance, winning conditions, and even which troops have generals can be customized. Simulated Politics From custom events to war declarations, this recent addition allows dynamic games of multiple alliances and betrayals; custom events can also be made to reflect historical events with different types of consequences (changes to resources, alliances, unit experience). Aid can also be given to allies like Lend Lease in the real WW2. Historical Generals Hundreds of generals — with more coming by each update — from various countries around the world. Generals are not tied to specific units; they can be sacked from a unit on the spot and be replaced at any time. Mobile Crossplay Yes, this is also a mobile game. But it's a lot nicer to edit maps on the PC client, and there are no advertisements or micro-transactions here — you will be given $5 worth of coins upfront. You can also crossplay with mobile users in the multiplayer system and paste your user progress from your mobile apps. About Me I’m an indie student developer, so this app is very flexible in terms of update content. Please feel free to contact me if you want to make suggestions or collaborate to make the game better. Game Engine: Unity (C# + Python)

rows.name: Dynasty
rows.short_description: Dynasty is a singleplayer social deduction roguelike in which you must rule your kingdom through your untrustworthy advisors. Earn your advisors loyalty and grant them the power to administrate, but beware: the more power you grant them, the more they may use that power against you.
rows.description_html: Your king father is dead, and you are now alone. A day ago he stood strong and proud. The royal advisors found cause and means to open your king father's chest to voice their dissent against his rule. 'Trust no one,' were his dying words. You do not know why they killed him, or how they killed him, but there is no denying that they succeeded. The mandate of heaven falls to you. You must prolong the Dynasty . Dynasty is a social deduction roguelike in which you must rule your kingdom through your advisors, who you are unsure whether you can trust. Your advisors hold the keys to power. You must please them enough to keep them loyal and grant them the power to administrate your kingdom. But beware-- the more power you grant them, the more they may use that power against you. You must survive 30 turns without being assassinated. If you have not been assassinated by your advisors by turn 30, you win. Features: Play a social deduction roguelike in which you must avoid assassination by your advisors as you administer your kingdom. 200 programs 30 turns 15 abilities 6 advisors 1 monarch There are six primary advisors: Seneschal Belmin : The majordomo of your palace. Through him you can curry the loyalty of your other advisors. He can help you expand your palace and staff, and with enough power can learn the true loyalty of your other advisors. Captain Niri : The Captain of your Crownguard. She will help you discover and foil assassination plots. If you suspect another advisor of plotting against you, you can have her arrest them, to be replaced by another hopefully more loyal second. Treasurer Chaddik : Of the Royal Treasury. He safeguards your income and manages your coffers and expenses. Through him you can purchase the loyalty of other advisors. Magistrate Elenda : Of the Ministry of the Commons. She represents the will of your subjects. Without her resourceful solutions to the problems your kingdom faces, there would surely be unrest and revolts. Unitary Alesanvi : The highest religious officiant. The piety of other advisors only offers her more power, though she tells you that her power comes only from the heavens. General Higan : The commander of the Royal Army. Through his military might you can command fear and obedience. Beware that you do not turn your kingdom into a military dictatorship.

EarthKart is a real world driving simulator that combines the speed and excitement of kart racing with the revolutionary integration of Google Maps. Experience the ultimate Google Earth driving simulator as you traverse through the urban jungles of New York, glide along the Great Wall of China, or speed through the winding alleys of Marrakech. The entire Earth is your racetrack in this drive on Google Maps Driving Game!

rows.name: Cube Battlefield: 2048
rows.short_description: A rogue-like top-down shooting game with infinitely generated levels. Grow a army of cubes with different abilities to break down enemies into smaller units. Make your cube army more powerful each time you are reborn.
rows.description_html: Cube Battlefield: 2048 is a rogue-like top-down shooting game with infinitely generated levels. In this game, you will shoot down your enemies with various bullets, also leveling up your troop from a single cube to an army of cubes with different abilities. With the coins you collect from the battlefield, you can strengthen your cube abilities and thus beat more levels. Unleash the Power of Cubes 8 different cubes with various abilities are waiting for you to unlock! Cube 8 can use a rifle gun, Cube 16 can freeze enemies, and what Cube 64 can do will impress you. You can control all these cubes simply by point-and-click, and they will destroy the cube enemies into pieces! Leveling up Your Army Only a single tiny cube in the beginning? No worries! You can expand your armed forces by collecting coins from beating your enemies. The more coins you collect, the more cubes you will have! All these cubes will align nicely together waiting for your command to initiate their attack! Enemies are also Cubes Most of the cube enemies can be broken down into smaller cubes! Each of them owns a special ability. Some cubes can slow you down, and some cubes can shoot poisonous bubbles. Would you be able to eliminate all of them and survive? Infinite Levels All the levels are generated on the fly, and you have infinite levels to beat! However, you will always start from Room 1 after you lose all your cubes. How far can you reach? Let's test it out! Upgrading Cubes with Coins A plethora of cube abilities are upgradable! Use coins to boost your cube to a higher level! How about making the rifle shoot 15 bullets at a time? Or shooting a bullet that can reach the furthest enemy? You can only get more powerful each time you are reborn.

rows.name: Zarie: The Story of Sin
rows.short_description: What kind of conversation will you have with the Shinigami girl? How will you conclude your story? The choice is yours in this tale of sin and 'the girl'.
rows.description_html: A story of sin and 'the girl'. You find yourself in a world of monochrome, alone, until you meet Zarie, a girl with white hair, red eyes, and black clothes. She tells you she is a deity of death, this is Hell, and that you are a sinner. Guided by Zaire, you travel to meet Emma, Hell's Judgement, to be tried. What awaits you at the end of this short, yet arduous journey? Features ・A short visual novel with minimal text, backgrounds, and CG. ・Dynamic story choices change how Zarie answers. ・Enjoy the story's four CGs in 'CG Mode'. ・Supports both Japanese and English playback.

rows.name: Reapers
rows.short_description: An online battle trading card game set in a dystopian universe, focused on deck building, resource management and trading.
rows.description_html: Reapers is an online trading card game set in a dystopian future. Collect cards and packs, build custom decks, and win games against other players. All current season cards are shared so you can jump right into the action. Get rewarded for winning games and grow your own private collection. Currently in the Beta Season, cards and packs are limited, so gather them now, boost their visuals for added value and trade them later! I originally wanted to create a table top card game for my kids, but figured out it would be easier to make a computer sandbox. The project eventually turned into a fully online game, packed with features and interesting mechanics. The first release of the game with 300+ Alpha Season cards came out in January 2022. The Beta Season cards were released in September 2022. Looking forward to create the Third Season cards with the help of the community! Looking forward to challenge you on the battlefield!

rows.name: Please, Touch The Artwork 2
rows.short_description: A handpainted cozy hidden object adventure. Explore a surreal world. Collect items for its quirky inhabitants. Fix damaged paintings and solve casual puzzles. Help a lost skeleton painter find his way home. This game is short but 100% FREE (no ads, no IAP).
rows.description_html: Disclaimer: This is a short game made in 6 months . It's 100% FREE  (no ads, no IAP), made by a solo dev in honour of James Ensor’s 75 year remembrance. Touch the artwork and help a lost skeleton artist find its way home in a surreal, hand-painted universe. Collect hidden objects for its quirky inhabitants, solve casual puzzles, and restore cracks in the fabric of the paintings. This slow paced relaxing adventure was carefully crafted from works by James Ensor, a Belgian pioneer in the world of Modern Art. Features: Hidden object adventure 5 unique worlds Hints when stuck Casual point & click gameplay Zoom-in for extra details Real hand-painted art Atmospheric relaxing sound Silly and quirky Slow-paced & relaxing Fit for ages 12-99 The game was created with the support of the Flemish Government on the occasion of the Belgian EU Presidency 2024.

rows.name: Mortgage nightmares
rows.short_description: Your very own apartment, even if it's a 20-year mortgage – what could be better? Maybe the fact that Lena isn’t the only one living in this apartment? Or maybe they're not exactly people...
rows.description_html: A slice-of-life visual novel with an unusual plot. Befriend your new neighbors and try to get along with them! Lena is an ordinary freelance designer who finally decides to move out of her parents' house into a mortgage-bought apartment. However, as soon as she crosses the threshold, strange things start happening – mysterious reflections in the mirror, groceries ending up in the trash... It seems there's more to it than meets the eye. But what exactly is happening? You'll need to figure it out quickly before you run out of money for replacing all the broken light bulbs... rows.name: SAMUZA
rows.short_description: Welcome to the world of SAMUZA! In this time attack obstacle course game, you play as one of the 'SAMUZA' series of robots who tries to restore the lost world by finding it's allies.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the world of SAMUZA! In this time attack obstacle course game, you play as one of the 'SAMUZA' series of robots who tries to restore the lost world by finding it's allies. Story The year is 299X. Humanity has perished, and the world is ruled by a runaway artificial intelligence. Foreseeing the end, the last Engineer made 9 keys, each with a piece of code, to be used when all else failed to restore the world to it's prevous state. You are Humanity's last hope, the robot series 'Samuza-L800'. You must find the 9 special robots scattered around the world and collect their keys. The ruling AI will surely interfere. You must overcome it's traps, collect the keys and use their combined code to reset the world. I wish you luck! Gameplay Compete in several game modes with different levels from the game's story and the community. Each level has a track you must complete while avoiding a series of obstacles. Story Mode The game's story campaign. Complete a series of premade levels and unlock new blocks to use in your creations. Endless Mode Complete random community made levels. Be careful not to fall off the course, as you will lose one life each time you reset. See how far you can go! Search Mode Use this to find community made levels. Use a code to find specific levels or follow other creators to easilly find their levels. 2P Versus Mode Play with your friends in split screen local multiplayer. You will get random levels from the community. In this mode there are no lives, have fun with your friends any way you want to. 2P Search Mode Play any specific level with a friend in split screen local multiplayer. Here you can search and play community made levels. You can play against your friends on the levels you created! Prepare a difficult course and compete against your friends! Creator Mode Make your own content! You can create your own original levels in the Creator Mode! Here you can choose from a collection of blocks and combine them to make your unique levels. Unlock new blocks by playing the Story Campaign and Endless Modes! Build at your pace Take your time in the creator mode. Test your progress at any time inside the Creator. Save your progress locally or to your account. Once complete, you can upload your levels and share them with your friends and the community! Let everyone around the world play in your original levels!

rows.name: Protoplanet Express
rows.short_description: Embark on an exciting journey to explore distant star systems and witness the fascinating process of planet formation. In this immersive video game, you'll have the chance to learn about real protoplanetary systems based on simulations crafted by professional astronomers.
rows.description_html: Embark on an exciting journey to explore distant star systems and witness the captivating process of planet formation in this immersive video game. You'll have the opportunity to delve into real protoplanetary systems, all meticulously recreated through simulations by professional astronomers. Climb aboard the Protoplanet Express, your reliable spacecraft for this adventure, and navigate through the vastness of space. Discover a multitude of viewpoints within these simulations, each offering a fresh perspective on every system. As you progress, you'll encounter different astronomers who will share insights into what makes each system truly unique. In some systems, you'll not only find stars but also planets and multiple stars. These celestial bodies wield gravitational forces like cosmic artists, sculpting dust and gas into mesmerizing features such as spirals, rings, and gaps – all ready for you to explore in these celestial realms. Each system you explore is painstakingly crafted, with hundreds of thousands of particles arranged precisely to match astrophysical simulations. This ensures that you won't miss a single visual detail throughout your cosmic odyssey.

rows.name: Elemental Mage Defense
rows.short_description: Step into 'Elemental Mage Defense', a dynamic realm where magic meets valiant heroism. As a mage, you'll defend your homeland through strategic battles, unfolding narratives, and thrilling expansions. Every choice carves your legacy.
rows.description_html: Master three potent spells: Earth , Fire , and Water . Engage in strategic battles against invading monsters of opposing elemental types: Fire, Earth, and Water. Earth Spell (Geomancy): Unleash the earthen energies to counter the relentless waves of WaterMonsters , turning their tides into mere puddles. Fire Spell (Pyromancy): Call upon the fiery heavens to scorch the advancing EarthMonsters , turning their solid resolve into ashes. Water Spell (Hydromancy): Conjure torrents of water to douse the flaming assault of the FireMonsters , quelling their fiery onslaught with a splash of reality. Evolve your strategies, and rotate your spells to defend your station and in turn survive. Elemental Mage Defense beckons you to immerse yourself in a vibrant and dynamic world brimming with elemental magic and untold perils. In this groundbreaking shoot 'em up adventure, you take on the role of a valiant mage caught amidst an unforeseen invasion that threatens to engulf your homeland. With the weight of your kingdom on your shoulders, you embark on a legendary journey, from defending tranquil villages to safeguarding the mighty fortress that stands as the last beacon of hope against the advancing dark forces. In this journey of magic and heroism, strategy meets action at every turn. Harness the powers of Earth, Fire, and Water to protect your realm from the elemental beasts hell-bent on chaos and destruction. With a dynamic rock-paper-scissors battle system, every encounter calls for strategic planning and quick reflexes. An Engrossing Journey: Start in the scenic plains, defending peaceful villages from the impending doom. Work your way back to your castle, the heart of your kingdom, preparing for a grand showdown. Experience a rich narrative filled with twists and monumental battles. Visually Stunning Environments: Traverse through a vivid world crafted with breathtaking detail. From idyllic villages to grandiose castles, each setting offers a unique backdrop for battle. Bonus Game Modes: Dimensional Shift : Switch gears with a 3D FPS shooter mode, adding a fresh perspective to your adventure. Dodgeball : Take a break from battle with a high-speed asteroid dodging game, testing your agility and precision. Wall of Death : Face wave after wave of enemies in an ultimate test of endurance and might. Danger Room : load up an endless environment tracking Time Survived, Monsters Killed, and Score. A World Ever-Growing Dive into a continuously evolving landscape, teeming with potential and opportunities for further exploration and challenges. As we steer Elemental Mage Defense into the future, anticipate periodic expansions and add-ons that promise to enrich the lore, introduce new terrains and adversaries, and expand the gameplay dynamics. Your adventure is bound to grow, offering fresh narratives and challenges, marking an unending journey in a world that grows with the community's passion and enthusiasm. Elemental Mage Defense is more than a game; it's an expedition into a world where your wits are your greatest weapon, and your courage is tested at every corner. Prepare to immerse yourself in a tale where every decision carves your legacy. Prepare to embrace your destiny as the elemental mage in Elemental Mage Defense, where adventure beckons the brave. Add to your wishlist now, and be the first to step into a world where magic is your mightiest ally.

rows.name: Krashimals
rows.short_description: Krashimals is a fast-paced multiplayer kart racing game where up to 4 players race through wacky tracks like Mushy Mountains and Gnome Garden. Collect coins, animal-powered abilities, customize your racer with hats, karts, and wheels, and race to victory in chaotic, fun-filled challenges!
rows.description_html: Krashimals is a fast-paced, chaotic racing game where you and your friends crash, dash, and boost your way to victory! Pick your favorite wacky animal driver, customize your look, and speed through vibrant tracks filled with boost pads, tricky shortcuts, and hidden secrets. Welcome to Krashimals! Now featuring customization , you can personalize your Krashimal with unique hats, characters, and vehicles ! Want to race as a wizard-hat-wearing frog on a flying carpet ? Or maybe a snail rocking a Spartan helmet in a bathtub ? The choice is yours! With fun options like a traffic cone , cardboard box , and even a shopping 'kart' , there’s no shortage of ways to express your style. Use powerful abilities to outmaneuver your rivals—zip past them with a speed boost, send them flying with a well-timed impact, or find secret paths that give you the ultimate edge. Every race is unpredictable, with creative map designs that reward skill, exploration, and a little bit of mayhem. Features: 🚀 Fast & Fun Racing – Use boost pads, abilities, and clever shortcuts to speed past your competition. 🏁 Exciting Tracks – Race across colorful, unique maps filled with surprises and hidden areas. 🐾 Crazy Animal Drivers – Play as a cat, snail, elephant, frog, or duck ! 🎩 Customize Your Look – Choose from hats like a Spartan helmet, wizard hat, or traffic cone . 🚗 Wild Vehicles – Ride in a carpet, bathtub, shopping 'kart', or cardboard box ! ⚡ Abilities & Power-ups – Master 8 different abilities to gain the upper hand. 🎉 Multiplayer Madness – Compete against friends for the ultimate racing glory! Get ready to crash, customize, and compete in Krashimals ! 🚀 Developer Note: I'm a solo developer , and I’ve put Krashimals into Early Access because I want to keep improving the game with your help! I’m actively working on new features, polish, and content, and your feedback is incredibly important in shaping the future of Krashimals . Whether it’s ideas for new maps, customization options, or gameplay tweaks, I’d love to hear from you as the game continues to evolve!

rows.short_description: Underground Waifus it's a CCG, Deck Builder TCG with PVP Card Battler F2P Game
rows.description_html: Welcome to Underground Waifus: Dive into the Future of TCG multiplayer with PVP Battles. Play for free this CCG and battler card game and compete, achieve quests and earn free rewards! The universe of Underground Waifus takes place in the future, corrupted by the scarcity of materials, money: stardust, and the desire for power. An eternal war between different races and more than 9 factions. The gameplay merges several themes: cyberpunk and manga, anime waifus cards based in a post-apocalyptic future. Underground Waifus is more than just a TCG, CCG, or JJC. It's the dawn of a new era of TCG gaming. If you are tired of traditional Card PVP games, enjoy battling in a vast Battle Arena CCG with players worldwide. One of the main sources of innovation is that it proposes a circular economy model that combines F2P (Free to Play) in that TCG (Trading Card Game), we’re shifting gears to warp speed! Can you create a top deck building strategy? There are several combat modes in this card F2P collecting action game: PVE CCG training available in the F2P mobile and PC version. PVP Battler Card version with a game pass, winning player gets all. PVP Player Battle Card Battler version of winning ELO will determine who is the winner of each SEASON. That JJC trading card game is focused on a competitive side, with an easy PVP (player vs player) battles game with no barriers to entry and hybrid F2P for all players! FEATURES of an awesome CCG game based on a TCG game: TCG and CCG Fusion: Enjoy the flavor of the card battles both Trading Card Games and Collectible Card Games with an awesome deck builder. Deck building Dynamics: Conquer all factions, strategy and deck builder here is that fun but with cards! Join us in crafting a tale of strategy, card battles, trading and prosperity in the ever expanding cosmos of Underground Waifus TCG (Trading Card Game). 2023 and 2024 Underground Waifus TCG it is a trademark or registered Jurval Corp (Warlands Corp and Nexxyo company)

rows.description_html: A turn-based roguelike dungeon crawler where you maneuver to collect items enabling you to fight enemies. Pick your hero, craft your deck, unlock powerful artifacts and forge your path through dungeons filled with ruthless enemies, dangerous traps and cataclysmic events! ROGUELIKE GAMEPLAY Explore procedurally generated dungeons filled with intricate puzzles and challenges, ensuring that each descent is a unique experience. With procedurally generated content and a variety of character builds to experiment with, this game offers endless replay-ability for both new and seasoned adventurers. EACH DECISION MATTERS Each move shape your environment where you have to make your path. Each decisions impact all future possibilities, and each move hides a great tactical depth. Engage in strategic battles against a variety of enemies, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Plan your moves carefully to emerge victorious. UNLOCKABLE ARTIFACTS, HEROES AND DUNGEONS Unlock heroes with different starting abilities and skills to create your custom run! Discover a wealth of items that can aid or hinder your progress, and craft your gear wisely with more than 50 artifacts offering a wide variety of effects that you can unlock with every game you play! Unlock the various dungeon realms and uncover how each one introduces new rules, increasing the game's difficulty. Will you be able to reach the final dungeon?
rows.about_html: A turn-based roguelike dungeon crawler where you maneuver to collect items enabling you to fight enemies. Pick your hero, craft your deck, unlock powerful artifacts and forge your path through dungeons filled with ruthless enemies, dangerous traps and cataclysmic events! ROGUELIKE GAMEPLAY Explore procedurally generated dungeons filled with intricate puzzles and challenges, ensuring that each descent is a unique experience. With procedurally generated content and a variety of character builds to experiment with, this game offers endless replay-ability for both new and seasoned adventurers. EACH DECISION MATTERS Each move shape your environment where you have to make your path. Each decisions impact all future possibilities, and each move hides a great tactical depth. Engage in strategic battles against a variety of enemies, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Plan your moves carefully to emerge victorious. UNLOCKABLE ARTIFACTS, HEROES AND DUNGEONS Unlock heroes with different starting abilities and skills to create your custom run! Discover a wealth of items that can aid or hinder your progress, and craft your gear wisely with more than 50 artifacts offering a wide variety of effects that you can unlock with every game you play! Unlock the various dungeon realms and uncover how each one introduces new rules, increasing the game's difficulty. Will you be able to reach the final dungeon?

rows.name: The Summit Library
rows.short_description: A Library that's falling apart, an Empire on the brink of war, and a dangerous magical mystery you've been tasked to solve.
rows.description_html: Welcome, Keeper. ...To the wonders of the Summit Library; the largest and most important Library in the Eawin Empire. Your trade has been suffering under the rule of the current Emperor -- but with the Summit requesting your services things are looking up. Except when you arrive you suddenly find yourself in a dangerous magical mystery. Something's wrong with the books, and the Library is falling apart at the seams. Also, there might be a war? But the Summit Library is situated on neutral territory, so that doesn't affect you. ...Right? As you set out the uncover the Library's secrets, you get drawn into the complexities of the Empire's politics; rebellion, betrayal, underground organisations, and more. Meet the various people residing at the Summit Library; make alliances and enemies; fall in love and get your heart broken. Make choices that matter and explore all the multiple routes and endings, as well as the secrets you can record in your Codex. May you live to see the end of this tale written. * Meet the Residents Berit - the High Librarian Overworked and underappreciated, Berit is slowly being crushed by the expectations put on her shoulders. Aias - the Cynical Investigator Standoffish and unfriendly, Aias doesn't seem to have much taste for his work, using his position as Librarian to discover hidden truths instead. River - the Shrewd Politician Calculating, charming, and a little too interested in the secrets of your trade, River's true intentions remain a mystery. Yakyar - the Rebel Survivor Escaping a bloody fate, Yakyar wields magic of their own -- and seems to know far more about yours than possible. Thasar - the Runaway Soldier Weary of killing and made bitter by the blood on his hands, all Thasar wants is to turn his back on the world. * Features A magical mystery set in a fantasy-rich world Choices that matter; have your actions and relationships with others shape the story A customisable MC; choose your name, appearance, pronouns, and place of origin A diverse LGBTQ+ cast Collectible CGs Unlockable information for your codex Optional mature intimacy scenes Content warnings: Fantasy violence, death, blood, strong language, screenshakes, sexual themes and language. This game will feature mature content and mature intimacy scenes in the future, and is intended for 18+ audiences. These scenes can always be skipped without penalty and are completely optional for gameplay. Currently Chapter 1 is out and free to play! Check back soon for the next installment.

rows.name: AGO BRISTOL 1775: From Warship to Prison Hulk
rows.short_description: AGO BRISTOL 1775 is a ground-breaking collaboration between VR developers and a museum, transforming a British warship model made in 1775 into an immersive experience. Users can explore freely or follow a narrative aboard the Bristol when it served as a floating prison for captured enemy soldiers.
rows.description_html: Key Features - Learn from curators and conservators from around the world - Experience life aboard a prison hulk during the Napoleonic Wars - Choose between a guided tour and free roaming on your own - Experience state-of-the-art VR environments powered by Unreal Engine 5's Nanite and Lumen technologies. - Explore our models, captured via Computed Tomography and Photogrammetry, rendered in hundreds of millions of polygons with 20k textures. - Navigate using a VR headset preferably, confirmed users can switch to 2D mode with a mouse and keyboard. - Best enjoyed in VR on a high-end PC for optimal performance. - Choose between exploring solo or in a group of up to 6 attendees. - Free to download on Steam for Windows 10 and beyond Technology and Museums This VR experience is possible because of the following critical technological aspects: Scanning Technology - Photogrammetry is a technology that converts multiple high-resolution photographs into highly detailed 3D models. By capturing images of a subject from various angles and then analyzing them with specialized software, photogrammetry constructs a mesh of polygons that closely mimics the object's surface. The original textures are then mapped onto this 3D mesh, delivering a digital model that boasts an unparalleled level of detail and realism. - Computed Tomography (CT) scans offer another avenue for creating detailed 3D models, particularly useful for intricate objects like ship models. Unlike traditional X-rays that provide a 2D view, a CT scan rotates around the object, capturing multiple images from different angles. These images are then processed by software to create cross-sectional slices of the object, which are stacked to form a comprehensive 3D model. The result is an incredibly accurate representation, capturing even the inner complexities that are often missed by other scanning methods. Unreal Engine 5 Technology - Nanite is Unreal Engine 5's virtualized geometry system which uses a new internal mesh format and rendering technology to render pixel scale detail and high object counts. It intelligently does work on only the detail that can be perceived and no more. It offers multiple orders of magnitude increase in geometry complexity, higher triangle, and object counts than have been possible before in real-time The Photogrammetry and CT Scan museum assets used in this experience were imported without loss of quality, at the staggering resolutions of 50 to 90 million polygon assets. - Lumen is Unreal Engine 5's fully dynamic global illumination and reflections system that is designed for next-generation consoles and the latest PCs. Lumen Global Illumination solves indirect lighting. For example, light bouncing off a surface picks up the color of that surface and reflects the colored light onto other nearby surfaces in large, detailed environments at scales ranging from millimeters to kilometers. Project Team Aimed at defining what a historical artifact exhibit would be like in Virtual Reality, this special project was created by Priam Gvord Studio and the Art Gallery of Ontario (Toronto, Canada), working in cooperation. - Priam Givord, Project Director & Conceptor - VR Interactive Designer, Priam Givord Studio inc. - Gillian McIntyre, Project Lead - Interpretive Planner, Art Gallery of Ontario - Adam Harris Levine - Associate Curator, European Art, Art Gallery of Ontario - Sherry Phillips - Conservator, contemporary art and ship models (retired) research and content development - Matthew Scott - Media Producer, Art Gallery of Ontario - Simon Stephens - Curator of Ship Model and Boat Collections, National Maritime Museum, Greenwich, London. - Hans Biorn-Lian - Digital Programming and Partnerships Lead, National Maritime Museum - Catherine Thomson - Manager, Digital Projects, Art Gallery of Ontario - Sean Guadron - Lead Developer at letscreatesomethingamazing - Pyramid Attack & Tyler Dillman - 3D Design - Karen Vanderborght - Interface Design, KRAK Fractured Media - Candice Dan, Art Collision - Project submission & Synopsis About the Game AGO BRISTOL 1775 is an advanced VR immersive application aiming to establish a high-quality standard in the field of Museum Virtual Reality exhibitions. This groundbreaking project was co-produced by Priam Givord Studio and the Art Gallery of Ontario (Toronto, Canada) to explore the potential of virtual reality to exhibit and interpret historical artifacts. This free application will serve as the first-in-the-world multiplayer VR museum visit system with a live guide from the AGO (up to 6 visitors from anywhere around the world). The VR experience is focused on an original ship model of the Bristol, a warship and later a hulk that held prisoners from the Napoleonic Wars (1793-1815). The model belongs to the Thomson Collection of Ship Models, on exhibit at the Art Gallery of Ontario, unique in Canada and one of the finest ship model collections in the world.

rows.name: The Chad
rows.short_description: The evil Simp Co is turning everyone at Muscle Beach into Simps! Can you fight your way through all the simps and thots to find the source of the simp pandemic? We need your help Chad!
rows.description_html: You are Chad. You like to lift weights, chew bubble gum, and kick ass. However, everything has changed with the arrival of Simp Co. and the recent Simp pandemic on the West Coast of California. Fight through hordes of simps, thots, and all sorts of weirdos to destroy their degenerate shrines and find the source of the chaos. Will you save us from the pandemic, get these gains, and remain supreme, or will you become just another beta? Key Features: Play through 6 interesting levels to learn 6 powerful abilities and fight off 5 unique enemy types. Meet up and speak with other alpha male NPCs who will help you on your journey. Launch barrels at enemies, hazardous statues, and shrine spawners to progress and become stronger.

rows.name: Three Kingdoms: Battle of Generals
rows.short_description: Three Kingdoms: Battle of Generals is a multi-player online real-time strategy game based on the Three Kingdoms history which recreates realistic landscapes in the world map. Look out for flank attacks and road blocks from your enemies when you explore the open world and build your city.
rows.description_html: Three Kingdoms: Battle of Generals is a multi-player online real-time strategy game based on the Three Kingdoms history which recreates realistic landscapes in the world map. Look out for flank attacks and road blocks from your enemies when you explore the open world and build your city. Reimagine various formations and different troop types from ancient times. Recruit and leverage hundreds of military generals and develop strategies to build up defense! New seasons and innovative game modes make it possible for every player to take the throne. Choose your own script and experience the original Three Kingdoms history. You will play as a lord, grow your army, find your allies and conquer it all! 【All-in-one server. Epic battle between nations now begins!】 Hundreds of thousands of players from around the world are all in this war together. Join a powerful guild and find like-minded alliance to experience epic battles from Three Kingdoms history. Every move matters. Pick your strategies wisely and get ready for the bloody country war. 【Fair and square with no resources sold in the game. Strategy matters.】 We don’t sell resources, troops or lands. With our innovative road map system, you can now march troops more effectively. Every time you occupy a land or city, the marching route will change according to your move. You can also implement strategies like Pincer Attack or Flank Attack to defeat opponents. 【No pay-to-win. Hundreds of legendary generals waiting for your summon】 The key to conquer all kingdoms and unite the country is not by money but strategy. Build up your own city, double up resources and expand your territory to win! Hundreds of legendary generals from real Three Kingdoms history are waiting to join your force. All generals are detailed modeled with over a million faces based on real history in order to present the most original gaming experience for you. 【Realistic battlefield full of unpredictable surprises】 Players can arrange their 3x3 formations using different troop types and ordinances to come up with more strategies such as “Flanking Attack”, “Archer Attack” and “Spear formation counter Calvary” to defeat enemies.

rows.name: The Path to Memento Mori
rows.short_description: In The Path to Memento Mori, players navigate eerie mazes in a co-op multiplayer horror puzzle game, solving complex puzzles and evading relentless monsters. Work together to uncover buried family secrets and unravel the chilling mystery that lies at the heart of the estate.
rows.description_html: The Path to Memento Mori plunges you into the depths of the haunted Sullivan estate, where something dark and forgotten stirs beneath the surface. After the death of his grandfather, Daniel returns to his childhood home only to be drawn into a web of hidden catacombs, twisted mazes, and a sinister mystery left behind by his late custodian. Daniel must confront a past he’s repressed, solving puzzles and navigating through nightmarish challenges to uncover a secret buried deep within the estate. In this 1-4 player cooperative horror puzzle game, you'll need to work together to survive the relentless monsters lurking in the catacombs while deciphering intricate puzzles designed to keep the estate’s secrets locked away. As you explore the dark, atmospheric environments, a haunting soundtrack heightens the tension, immersing you in a chilling experience that grows more intense with every step. Key Features: Co-op Multiplayer: Team up with up to four players to tackle the estate's mysteries, with teamwork being your key to survival. Puzzles and Mazes: Test your wits and unravel the twisted puzzles that stand between you and the truth. Horror Atmosphere: Explore eerie environments drenched in a haunting, immersive atmosphere that will send shivers down your spine. Relentless Enemies: Evade and outsmart the relentless monsters that stalk the catacombs, ready to trap you in the shadows of the past. Progressive Difficulty: As you delve deeper into the estate’s secrets, the mazes and puzzles become increasingly complex and dangerous. Will you and your team uncover the truth behind Daniel’s past, or will you succumb to the darkness that lurks within the Sullivan estate?

rows.name: Defense Cards
rows.short_description: Defense Card is a very creative barrage shooting game. It combines the gameplay of barrage shooting and card use. It also has a random in-game growth mechanism, making it an addictive and fast-paced bullet hell game. curtain shooter
rows.description_html: About this game Defense Cards is a small, replayable arcade score game. The goal of the game is to continuously improve your survival time in the previous game, and to unlock and build your own new hand of cards through gold coins collected in battles. If you encounter any problems during the game or have any ideas, you can send me an email and I will reply and fix it as soon as possible. (I'm glad if you like this game) Gameplay In the game, enemies will come to you one after another, so you need to keep dragging cards to release barrages and skills. You can’t keep shooting because the cards will consume your usage points. In order to consume the card points more rationally, you need a certain card usage strategy. In the game, you can continuously obtain new skill cards through upgrading. These powerful cards will help you better eliminate monsters. After each game, you can unlock cards in the store. These unlocked cards will appear in your hand in advance, which can make you stronger every game Game features Easy-to-learn card usage strategies A variety of card skills to help you survive better in the game Continuously upgraded cards provide strong support for clearing monsters. Gold coins can be obtained immediately when clearing monsters, allowing your abilities to continue to grow. Steam achievements Steam cloud Provides different combat experiences

rows.short_description: Roguelike survival game that focuses on combat and exploration. Have Fun! Inspired by Muck.
rows.description_html: Corrupted Universe Cries Quietly is a roguelike survival game that focuses on combat and exploration. We were inspired by the game ' MUCK ' to make a game and this was the result. Explore the world to gather resources and use them to make tools , armour and consumables . Attempt challenges to gain relics that provide a wide range of effects - the harder the challenge, the better the reward. Prepare yourself against waves of enemies at night by gearing up. The game was designed to be better enjoyed with more people, so grab some friends and play. It's Free and Short, try the game! We created a Discord!!!! Join to contact the developers and see behind the scenes for upcoming games.

rows.name: Leave Panda Away
rows.short_description: In China, there is a peaceful and beautiful country inhabited by pandas of various races. They are usually gentle and friendly, but when faced with threats, they will demonstrate strong combat effectiveness.
rows.description_html: Welcome to join the QQ discussion group, we will follow every game related information. Fan QQ group: 645822693 Also welcome to follow the Bilibili account and stay updated on the latest development progress. Bilibili account:猫着游戏工作室 Game Background In China, there is a peaceful and beautiful country inhabited by pandas of various races. They are usually gentle and friendly, but when faced with threats, they will demonstrate strong combat effectiveness. These races all have their own unique characteristics and skills: the 'bamboo forest tribe' pandas, who live in dense bamboo forests. They are famous for their expertise in using bamboo to make tools and weapons, and their skills are very exquisite. The 'Ice and Snow Clan' panda has a unique white fur and can survive in extremely cold environments. It is skilled in ice and snow magic and can summon the power of ice and snow elements. There are also 'Flame Clan' pandas, who live in tropical areas near volcanic craters. Their fur appears bright red, and the pandas of the Flame Clan possess powerful flame abilities that can be used to attack enemies. There are also more races such as the 'Wisdom Clan' and 'Diablo Clan' appearing one after another... This country is facing a huge crisis, with evil forces threatening its peace and security. In order to protect their homeland, pandas of various ethnic groups have decided to unite and fight against evil forces together. Game Features ■Each character can carry 6 automatic weapons! ■30 unique characters to experience the different levels of fun brought by different characters! ■Provide 25 basic and 6 advanced optional special weapons (such as pulling monster leather straps, bubble wrapped lucky koi, Vietnam War stronger bear claw fists... more weapons can be discovered and explored on your own)! ■Over 100 optional props! ■20 wave level breaking waves and infinite wave challenge waves are waiting for you! ■Pursue every battle to be cool, peaceful, and fast!

Game Features ■Each character can carry 6 automatic weapons! ■30 unique characters to experience the different levels of fun brought by different characters! ■Provide 25 basic and 6 advanced optional special weapons (such as pulling monster leather straps, bubble wrapped lucky koi, Vietnam War stronger bear claw fists... more weapons can be discovered and explored on your own)! ■Over 100 optional props! ■20 wave level breaking waves and infinite wave challenge waves are waiting for you! ■Pursue every battle to be cool, peaceful, and fast!

The obstacles - Blue walls stop you. - White is the ground. - Yellow and Orange walls can be run on. - Purple makes you faster when you slide on them. - Red is moving on the Beat.

rows.name: Editarrr
rows.short_description: Challenge yourself and your friends in this pixel-perfect pirate platformer! Create your own levels and compete for swashbuckling supremacy on the leaderboards.
rows.description_html: Set sail for an epic adventure in the high seas of creativity with Editarrr, a thrilling 2D platformer that's as much about building as it is about jumping! Key Features: 🏴‍☠️ Craft Your Own Swashbuckling Saga: Unleash your inner game designer with our robust level editor. Build intricate, challenging levels filled with traps, puzzles, and secret hideaways. The only limit is your imagination! 🏴‍☠️ Compete for Pirate Supremacy: Think you've got what it takes to be the fastest pirate on the leaderboard? Race against other players in heart-pounding time trials. Prove your skills and claim the title of Ultimate Pirate Champion. 🏴‍☠️ A Community-Driven Adventure: Editarrr was born from the creative minds of the 'Game Dev Field Guide' podcast community. Join us for an annual level design competition, where your creations can become a part of the game's lore! Editarrr is not just a game; it's an invitation to join a vibrant community of like-minded adventurers. Sail the seas, conquer obstacles, and design your dream levels while competing with the best of the best. The journey begins now – are you ready to become a legend of the high seas?

rows.name: My Boss Leidi
rows.short_description: A short 18+ kinetic novel about an exhausted college student and his boss.
rows.description_html: Nicholas is a hardworking college student who is burnt out from school and work. Everything looks grim for him until he is graced by the presence of the beautiful blue-haired Leidi , his boss at his part-time job. What exciting adventure will these two characters dive into? Featuring artwork created by Lök Polymorfa and story written by Playerboy117 . Sit back and relax with this 20-minute 18+ kinetic novel. Now on Steam! English, Chinese, and Polish languages available.

rows.name: Bad Mineral
rows.short_description: A gritty local multiplayer, controller-based platform shooter with one heal per round.
rows.description_html: Bad Mineral is a gritty platform shooter with local multiplayer for up to four players. Test your skill and adaptability in short, brutal firefights, and taxing hand to hand combat, as you play chicken with one heal per round. Each hit damages your character's ability to aim, walk, stand or avoid bleeding out. -Humiliate your friends with 80 weapons, including guns, blades, less-lethal, and agricultural tools. -Build your skill against challenging NPC waves. -Take on the horde, alone or with friends. -Win exponentially with gun-game, or handicap yourself with reverse-gun-game. -Pepper-spray a zombie. **The game is single player only with a mouse and keyboard setup, controllers are required for multiplayer.**

rows.name: A Park Full of Cats
rows.short_description: Welcome to 'A Park Full of Cats,' a hidden object game that invites you to revel in the enchanting world of amusement parks! Experience the thrill and excitement of the rides and give those cats the fun they truly deserve!
rows.description_html: Welcome to 'A Park Full of Cats,' a hidden object game that invites you to revel in the enchanting world of amusement parks! Experience the thrill and excitement of the rides and give those cats the fun they truly deserve! At the center of the park, Fofiño takes the stage! Search for the cats that'll join him in making this an unforgettable show! Explore every nook and cranny, from the Roller Coasters to the Bumper Cars and the towering Ferris Wheels, to find these playful cats! 'A Park Full of Cats' features: One Enormous Scenario: Immerse yourself in a vast, single-screen scenario, brimming with hidden cats. It's the largest and most intricately designed setting we've created, ensuring you have plenty to explore. Fun and Games: Experience the amusement park like never before as you locate hidden cats and unlock new achievements. The thrill of the rides is just a click away! Free Admission: 'A Park Full of Cats' is not only an amusement park for cats but also for players. The ticket to this adventure is absolutely FREE, giving everyone a chance to have fun and find all the cats without any cost. Countless Cats: As you delve into the world of amusement, you'll encounter a plethora of playful feline companions, each with their unique charm. Can you find them all? So, grab your virtual ticket, hop on the rides, and embark on an unforgettable adventure at 'A Park Full of Cats.'. Get ready to enjoy a day at the amusement park and discover the magic that happens when cats have their own playground!

rows.name: The Finnish War x Sotidrokhima: Finlandsaga
rows.short_description: The heroes of Finland's past must come together to save the land from oblivion in the hands of the sorcerer, Louhi. The game is a non-canonical sequel to The Finnish War and Sotidrokhima, combining hack-n-slash and real-time strategy gameplay from the two titles.
rows.description_html: An adventure that wasn't meant to be - it's here The Finnish War x Sotidrokhima: Finlandsaga is an epic follow-up to two previous games by AcroGames - The Finnish War (2022) and Sotidrokhima (2022). Finlandsaga is a hybrid hack-n-slash/real-time strategy game, mixing both gameplay and story elements from the two last-mentioned games. It combines the hack-n-slash action of Sotidrokhima with the calculative strategy gameplay of The Finnish War. The story centers around the Finnish national epic Kalevala , and connects its events to modern day, as well as with characters from the Finnish War and Sotidrokhima. The game can however be enjoyed by anyone, even those new to the two preceding titles - or Finnish mythology. Finlandsaga is well self-aware of its odd premise, and takes it all the way. Blood will fly, gore will spurt, and a rocking soundtrack sends our heroes off on their epic quest to save Finland. Features combined hack n' slash and RTS action blood and gore galore! rocking original soundtrack mow down hundreds of enemies with effective special moves

rows.name: Critical Failure
rows.short_description: This is a simple wave-based zombie survival game. The world's first VIDEO GAME CONTROLLED LIVE ACTION SERIES. Be prepared to directly influence the world of CRITICAL FAILURE.
rows.description_html: Full throttle zombie wave-based survival. The world's first VIDEO GAME CONTROLLED LIVE ACTION ZOMBIE SERIES. Your actions make an impact on the show named the same title. We plan on taking you through a story telling experience as you have fun with friends and family killing hordes of zombies. There is a faction war happening between four factions known as, WITCH'S, BIKER'S, MARAUDER'S, AND HACKER'S. Upon starting your first game you will be asked what faction you plan on fighting for, but no worries, if you grow tired of one faction than you can switch to another whenever you may like. Through the faction war you will be at war with the other three factions as you push waves of zombie hordes away from your home , 'NO MAN'S LAND'. There will be Suprise live events as well as pvp game modes added to spice things up a bit between factions. We hope you enjoy the growing community of CRITICAL FAILURE.

rows.name: Zoo Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version. In Zoo Simulator: Prologue, your main task is to run and manage your own zoo. Renew it and take care of all the animals' needs, ensuring them a peaceful life! Will you attract crowds of visitors? Create your own zoo!
rows.description_html: The Prologue is only part of the full game and is completely free. Every player will be able to play it and see what awaits them in the full version of the game. Renovate your Zoo! In Zoo Simulator: Prologue, one of your first tasks will be to restore the zoo. You will have to put a lot of effort into cleaning neglected alleys and damaged places for your future animals. To do this, you will be using a lot of tools such as welders and water washers. Remember - hard work can result in a crowd of delighted visitors! Various species of animals There is no Zoo without the animals living in it, right? In our game, you decide which of them will live in your facility. Remember that the more interesting the specimens live in your zoo, the more people will want to see them, which means more income for your business. Sit down to the computer and choose from the most exotic and amazing animals from around the world! Arrange runs for animals Animals from the farthest corners of the world will appear in your zoo, they will also require appropriate living conditions - so you must take care of lairs, hiding places, and plants that will make them happy. There will be a lot of different elements in the game, which you will be able to freely move, position and rotate, thus creating unique zones for animals. Look after them In Zoo Simulator: Prologue, you also need to take care of the well-being of your animals, which in return will repay you with peace, good health, and activity in their animal run. Feed them, look after them and pay special attention to their safety - animals love to nibble their nose wherever they have a chance to fit it! Thanks to this, animals will be more likely to show themselves to visitors and win their sympathy. Develop your Zoo As you run your business, you will need to develop it as well. There will be more visitors, which means more attractions that will be able to make their time more pleasant. Take care of the right number of public toilets and sanitary facilities, and eating places where they will be able to eat! Also, don't forget to buy interesting new animals. It is extremely important that guests do not want to leave your zoo and will invite their friends.
