rows.name: Retro Combat
rows.short_description: Casual FPS, no microtransactions. Play online or with bots with machine guns, tanks, and planes.
rows.description_html: Retro Combat is the ultimate first person shooter for the casual gamer. No logins or rankings — Just open the game and play online. You can also play with up to a hundred computers and simulate a battlefield with tanks, machine guns, and airplanes! [10 New Maps] Each map has different features, and some have tanks, static machine guns, and airplanes. Play intense matches on small maps or drive vehicles around in the desert! [25+ Weapons] Weapons range from assault rifles, shotguns, snipers, submachine guns, and pistols that fall into three modes: full auto, semi auto, and three-round bursts. Weapons also can have attachments like a red dot sight, ACOG scope, or a suppressor. Skins like desert and snow camouflage are also available. [Online Multiplayer] Press play and join a server like it’s 2008! Play on any server you want with strangers or friends in team deathmatch, free for all, and survival mode. [Survival Mode] Tired of finding targets? In survival mode, you fight against endless waves of computers, by yourself or with friends! [Single Player] On an airplane? No problem, play with up to 100 computers in any map! The AI can also drive tanks and airplanes.

rows.name: Cat Fred Evil Pet
rows.short_description: Care for a cute cat Fred. If the pet is displeased, a horror game will start!
rows.description_html: Get yourself a cute cat Fred and take proper care of him: provide your pet with tasty food and fresh water, entertain him regularly, and buy a cozy mattress for him, so Fred can sleep well. Do not think that your pet will always be good and sweet. It is better to start preparing for the escape from the evil cat in advance: open all accessible doors, find a craft book, and provide the pet with maximum care. The puzzles prepared by the evil cat Fred are quite difficult. Solving them is a true quest. This is what is waiting for you in the Cat Fred Evil Pet game: craft items to complete quests; 4 days of the cat’s transformation from a cute creature into an evil monster; tons of quests, puzzles, screamers, and fun moments. In the Cat Fred Evil Pet game, we have tried to break from the traditional concept of horror games to ensure every player enjoys lots of new emotions from a brand-new gameplay and exciting story in the game. The game contains both scary elements (screamers) and fun, humorous moments.

rows.name: Quiet is the Eyes
rows.short_description: All your coworkers are gone and the halls are quiet, except for the pitter-patter of rain on the window. Explore a desolate laboratory as a creature stalks you, always watching. Run and hide as you solve puzzles and learn more about what happened to the facility and its secrets.
rows.description_html: Quiet is the Eyes is a 2D side-scrolling puzzle horror game where you play as a researcher who finds herself at the center of a twisted mystery. All your coworkers are gone and the halls are quiet, except for the pitter-patter of rain on the window. Explore a desolate laboratory as a creature stalks you, always watching. Run and hide as you solve puzzles and learn more about what happened to the facility and its secrets. Don’t Get Caught! Beware: the creature outside the window is always near. You can run and hide as the monster stalks you at every moment, but within the laboratory’s walls, no place is truly safe. Uniquely themed puzzles Warning: the laboratory has entered lockdown. Put on your lab coat as you explore the different wings of the laboratory, solving mind-bending puzzles to open doors and escape. Don’t forget, the monster is always watching. Uncover the mysteries Unauthorized Access: Figure out what's really been going on in the lab and the mysterious experiments they have been conducting. Will you discover the truth or succumb to the thing that lurks in the halls? Quiet is the Eyes was created by Ally Guo and Rachel Perry as part of the University of Southern California’s Games program. It was made in collaboration with students at the Berklee College of Music: Ali Tahir, Xiaohe Zhao, and Sophia Drozd. The game aims to explore themes of unpredictability and the unknown—how they evoke apprehension yet bring forth a sense of relief amidst uncertainty.
rows.about_html: Quiet is the Eyes is a 2D side-scrolling puzzle horror game where you play as a researcher who finds herself at the center of a twisted mystery. All your coworkers are gone and the halls are quiet, except for the pitter-patter of rain on the window. Explore a desolate laboratory as a creature stalks you, always watching. Run and hide as you solve puzzles and learn more about what happened to the facility and its secrets. Don’t Get Caught! Beware: the creature outside the window is always near. You can run and hide as the monster stalks you at every moment, but within the laboratory’s walls, no place is truly safe. Uniquely themed puzzles Warning: the laboratory has entered lockdown. Put on your lab coat as you explore the different wings of the laboratory, solving mind-bending puzzles to open doors and escape. Don’t forget, the monster is always watching. rows.name: Tale of Time: Bagua
rows.short_description: Stack BaGua spells and travel through space and time! Tale of Time is a mind-bending top-down puzzle adventure where you guide a Chinese teenager on a quest to recover his family's lost treasure, the BaGua mirrors. Overcome obstacles along the way to unveil the secrets of his ancient lineage.
rows.description_html: Tale of Time takes players on an extraordinary journey through time and space, enveloping them in a mesmerizing puzzle adventure. As a Chinese teenager on a journey to uncover his family's secrets, you'll wield the mystical power of the BaGua mirrors to travel back in time to the same location, delving into an enigmatic world filled with puzzles, mysteries, and the allure of forgotten lineage. This indie-developed, non-euclidean top-down puzzle game invites you to embark on an emotional odyssey where your decisions shape a compelling story of heritage, sacrifice, and self-discovery. Time and Space Manipulation Utilize the unique power of the BaGua mirrors to transcend conventional time and space, solving intricate puzzles and unraveling hidden secrets. Non-Euclidean Puzzle Solving Engage with mind-bending puzzles set in non-euclidean spaces, challenging your intellect and creativity as you navigate through complex, interdimensional mazes. Low-Poly, Minimalistic Art Style Experience the captivating world of Tale of Time through a visually stunning low-poly, minimalistic art style that enhances the game's atmosphere and emphasizes the purity of the storytelling. Tale of Time is a labor of love crafted by a dedicated indie development team Offseason Studio, passionate about creating unique and engaging gaming experiences. The non-euclidean gameplay mechanics were meticulously designed to challenge players while keeping them engrossed in the storyline. Every aspect of Tale of Time was carefully curated to ensure players embark on an unforgettable adventure, exploring the depths of one's family history, the complexities of time, and the boundless dimensions of human emotions.

rows.name: LOVEY ♡ DOVEY
rows.short_description: As the #1 toilet fan, you visit an abandoned toilet factory in search of the legendary golden toilets. However, you're ambushed by the factory's friendly mascot, Lovey Dovey. You're at an extreme disadvantage since the only thing you brought is a rocket launcher. Collect all the toilets then escape!
rows.description_html: LOVEY ♡ DOVEY You've always been super into toilets. You use them so many times a day that you could be considered a #1 toilet fan. That's why you decide to visit an abandoned toilet factory. Legend has it that there are golden toilets there - and obviously , you want them all! However, Lovey Dovey (the toilet factory's mascot) is on the loose. Sadly, the only thing you brought is a rocket launcher. Hopefully it can come in handy somehow. Collect all the golden toilets and escape - but can you evade the infamous and hairy-legged Lovey Dovey ? KEY ♡ FEATURES ♥ Average playtime of 20 minutes ♥ Collect the golden toilets of which the legends have spoken ♥ Use your nifty rocket launcher ♥ Escape Lovey Dovey & the toilet factory Elevate your horror game experience and try Lovey Dovey today! This very high-quality comedy horror game will not flush your expectations down the drain!

rows.name: Virtu-Pilot
rows.short_description: Get ready for take-off, cadet! Enter an immersive UE5 experience that will elevate your light aircraft procedure skills. Master preliminary checks, interior/exterior startup checks, and gain the confidence to soar. Planned features: AI instructors, multiplayer and radio communications training.
rows.description_html: A Letter from The Developers To the next generation of aviators, We hope this experience encourages and helps you to embark on your first lesson, grit through ground school, feel the joy of your first solo flight and pass your check ride. And if piloting isn't quite your cup of tea, there is a plethora of aviation careers out there. Yours, Aries VR - a squadron of aerospace enthusiasts, trainee pilots and licensed pilots sharing their first person experiences of their training journeys Overview Virtu-Pilot was originally tailored for the Meta Quest 2 to equip aspiring pilots with a cost-effective and engaging VR training tool, empowering them to gain confidence and master aviation skills at their own pace. For the most immersive experience, we recommend using VR, allowing you to step into the pilot's shoes and perform checks and procedures using your virtual hands as if you were in real life. Be prepared to crouch, chuck obstructions, check for ice, open doors, flick lights on and remove tie downs. NOTE: We excited to bring Early Access to the aviation community, but please remember, this is an early access experience, and your input is invaluable in shaping the future of aviation training. The Windows desktop mode adaptation is quite limited and compatibility with non Meta Quest VR headsets is unknown. Levels Available Start Screen Briefing Room Hangar, Lesson 1 - Preliminary interior and walk around checks Key VR Controls Move - left joystick Teleport - right joystick Grab - hold front or side triggers, release to drop items Open Checklist book - look at the left palm in a lesson Demo Locked Levels Lesson 2 - Exterior checks (surface movements, fuel, undercarriage exploded view) Lesson 3 - Engine Start Up Exciting Planned Features JSBSim Flight Simulation Taxing Take-off End of lesson quizzes Follow along animated Instructors AI instructors Multiplayer capabilities Radio communications training

rows.name: Cureocity
rows.short_description: “People think battles need powerful weapons, but strategy at hand is key.'The story follows a rookie adventurer and a new healer in a dungeon quest, with the core gameplay involving hand-picked methods using weapons and items. Fight or purify? Heal or alter? The choice is in your hands.
rows.description_html: JOIN US! Feel free to join our official Discord to share your ideas with us. X: @qiyudixiacheng About the Game We are 'Bread On Board,' a collective of independent game developers spread across four countries, united by our passion and meeting during a GameJam. Our game demo was born in the 'BOOOM CHALLENGE', a GameJam by GCORES. With only 21 days, we created a game based on a given theme. After the competition, we even won the 'Most Popular Game' award at an Online Game Trial Event. The full playthrough of our game will take about an hour. We hope to give you a short, but super heartwarming and loving adventure❤️. A rookie adventurer fresh on the scene and a former mercenary who was transferred into an adventurer due to injury. Two protagonists with contrasting personalities will embark on an adventure of fantasy and healing together. In the mysterious ruins of an underground dungeon that lies in the depth of a jungle, what awaits them will be... According to the tavern's adventurer logs, the team heading into the dungeon features a rookie adventurer and an ex-mercenary who is now working as a healer. The adventurer looks as charming as a doll, and the enthusiasm never disappears; the healer is cool and a bit traditional, acting as a guiding figure for their adventure. What stories have unfolded between these two contrasting characters, and what challenges will they face together in this adventure? The continuation of this adventurous story is yours to discover. 'People think battles need powerful weapons, but strategy at hand is key.' In 'Cureocity,' the power of your strategy is materialized as the numerical values of your hands in combat. You can swap different weapons or items held in your left and right hands to alter your character's attack and defense stats. You may also change 'gestures' to focus attacks or land heavy blows on specific enemies.As you delve deeper into the dungeon, you will take the unique traits of monsters into consideration and discuss strategies with your allies. In this adventure, you'll discover not only the secrets hidden within the dungeon, but also the truths about the world and the characters themselves. When faced with contaminated monsters, you can choose to either fight them or attempt to purify them. Of course, you also have the option to let things take their own course. With each decision,the fate of the protagonists may change. The end of this adventure... is yours to decide. About the Publisher GCORES PUBLISHING is an independent game publishing venture formed by GCORES, committed to bringing you more outstanding indie games from the BOOOM CHALLENGE. Feel free to follow our publisher webpage for future updates.

rows.name: LAN Party
rows.short_description: Experience in-person gaming, online! LAN Party is designed to be the perfect compliment to your gaming group. Whether you're playing the same game competitively, cooperatively, or playing different games entirely, LAN Party makes communicating and sharing gameplay so much easier.
rows.description_html: Experience a LAN party like never before! LAN Party is designed to be the perfect compliment to your gaming group. Whether you're playing the latest FPS cooperatively, competing against each other in an RTS, or playing different games entirely, LAN Party makes communicating and sharing gameplay so much easier. Fully customize your unique gaming room and gaming setup, select your avatar, and invite your friends to hang out and play games or have a watch party in your virtual space. Welcome to the next era of online gaming, where the excitement, energy, and camaraderie of a LAN party meets the freedom of the virtual world. Stream Gameplay Experience the excitement of the game together through seamless in-room gameplay streaming. Open your friend's gameplay stream to cheer them on and broadcast your stream to a virtual screen so you can all watch together. Watch Content With Friends Use a shared video screen and have a watch party with your friends. Our streaming infrastructure ensures that videos are always synced between viewers. Have Full Control Over Your Avatar Express yourself exactly as you want with full control over your avatar. Find the perfect avatar on our marketplace or easily upload your own design. We give you the freedom to fully customize all aspects of your avatar including its scale, animations, and emotes. Create A Unique Gaming Environment Fully customize your unique gaming environment. We encourage creativity by allowing you to choose your room layout, lighting, furniture, and much more. Make your virtual space as unique as the gamers who visit it. Marketplace Our in-app marketplace allows our community to share its creations. Easily download avatars, furniture, decor, and other items to design your perfect space, or upload your creations to share with others.

rows.name: Drift.Wav
rows.short_description: Drift.Wav is a casual drifting game with a synthwave inspired aesthetic. This game is not meant to replicate / simulate actual drift mechanics, but more serve as a fun & relaxing game where you can slide in a synthwave inspired world. See if you can drift your way to the top of the leaderboard!
rows.description_html: This is a game all about relaxing and hitting some cool drifts. Try the different modes and drift your way to the top of leaderboard, if you can... Drift or drive to earn cash and save up for one of the 15 cars to choose from—one of them being a little more unique than usual. Also, there are several built-in playlists that you can select and drift to in any mode! Please note this game is still a work in progress and I do update constantly. As a solo dev I love any and all feedback in attempts to improve and truly make this a better game for everyone < 3 Special Controls ( Not essential but a whole lotta fun ) Super Jump: Hold 'L SHIFT' to activate slo-motion then hold 'SPACE' or 'F' to super jump ;) Flip Mid-Air: While high up in the air. Hold S to bring speed below 50 then hold 'E' to start flipping Custom Playlists In addition, there is a custom playlist feature that allows you to drift to any playlist you want while watching the visual waveforms of the song move around you! This feature works with .Wav and .Mp3 from what I have tested.

rows.name: BattleCore Arena
rows.short_description: BattleCore Arena is a free-to-play, peer-to-peer platform shooter where gravity mastery is the key to victory. Compete in quick PvP battles, using weapons and abilities to eject your opponents out of the arena.
rows.description_html: In BattleCore Arena, compete in fast-paced, peer-to-peer battles with your friends using responsive controls that mix shooting, platforming, physics mastery, and team strategy! Team up to dash, jump, and use your trusted weapons and abilities to eject your opponents from the arena. Enjoy two exciting game modes with friends for short yet epic matches! Download and play for free now! MASTER PHYSICS Physics will be your greatest ally or your worst enemy! Perform mind-blowing aerial maneuvers and mix the jump, double jump, directional dash, and gravity to gain the upper hand! DOMINATE THE ARENA Experience two unique battle modes to fight with your team or roll against them: - BACKUP: Be the last team standing in this 3v3 Team Death Match where you share lives with your teammates. - Q-BALL: Catch and keep the Q-Ball to lead your team to victory. Teamwork will be key in this highly competitive mode. BUILD YOUR OWN CORE Personalize your Core’s appearance! Choose your Armor, customize your Lights, Banner, and Elimination Explosion to impose your style. Unlock over a hundred cosmetics as you progress. Rely on unique weapons and abilities to be the most powerful Core of the arena. Gear up for upcoming battles and create your own playstyle by selecting a ranged weapon and other game-changer perks! ROLL WITH OR AGAINST YOUR FRIENDS Download the game for free and host your own play sessions with your friends in peer-to-peer matches!

rows.name: Wizarre
rows.short_description: Wizarre is a turn-based multiplayer game. Build and customize your team of Wizards, select from over 100 different spells, and manage your time and mana. Play with friends, compete against other players, and climb the global leaderboard across devices with crossplay support.
rows.description_html: Enter the world of Wizarre, where strategy, spells, and teamwork are crucial to your journey. Are you ready to rise through the ranks, claim your rightful place at the pinnacle of the global leaderboard, and unleash the full potential of your inner Wizard? The adventure begins now, and the only limits are the ones you set for yourself. Assemble a formidable team of three Wizards, each with unique statistics, strengths, and abilities. The power of choice lies in your hands as you carefully select your team members, considering which combination of over 100 spells suits your tactical approach best. Will you choose a balanced mix of offensive, defensive, and ultimate spells or specialize in a specific magic school? The choice is yours. And, to add a touch of personal flair, customize your Wizards' appearance with an array of skins that you can unlock by levelling up your account and opening Lootballs. Duel your way to greatness in epic battles that pit your team of three mighty Wizards against opponents from across the globe. The action is turn-based, with each round lasting just 45 seconds. During your turn, you'll need to manage your Wizards' time and mana wisely. With a limited mana pool, every spell you cast matters, and choosing the right combination is crucial to victory. However, be cautious, for the more your Wizards fly, the faster your timer drops. This creates a dynamic balance between strategic aerial manoeuvres and conserving your precious time. With seven themed gameplay maps, each with unconventional challenges, Wizarre ensures endless excitement and strategic depth. Wizarre offers a truly magical experience with crossplay support, allowing you to take your outstanding adventures from PC to mobile devices and back. Whether on the go or seated at your gaming desk, you can engage in exciting battles against enemies worldwide. Challenge your friends or make new allies through the Play with Friend mode, where your skills are tested against opponents on various platforms. It's a world of endless possibilities where the magic never ends.

rows.name: Blue Ribbon Bake Off
rows.short_description: Blue Ribbon Bake Off is a new, original playing card game. Players work to gather ingredients to complete a recipe and win a blue ribbon at the county fair. Competitors use every trick in the cookbook to stop them. Who will be named the County's Best Baker?
rows.description_html: The county fair is up and running, which means that it is time for the Blue Ribbon Bake Off. Players are contestants at the fair vying for blue ribbons, using time tested recipes. To win a blue ribbon, contestants must be the first to gather ingredients needed to complete a recipe. Beware though, while players are gathering ingredients competitors are using every trick in the cookbook to try to stop them, including swiping ingredients, and even submarining recipes. In the high-stakes world of competitive cooking nothing is off the table. Object of the game: Collect ingredients needed to complete a recipe, while trying to stop other players from doing the same. The first player to successfully gather the needed supplies for a recipe is awarded a blue ribbon. Collect enough blue ribbons to be named the County's Best Baker. This version is single player, against three computer players.

rows.name: Infrared
rows.short_description: You find yourself lost in the middle of nowhere. The only way to leave is to fuel up your car. But to do so, you'll have to venture into this desolate forest to find a way to unlock the gas station. But, every bit of flesh in your body screams that you are not alone...
rows.description_html: You find yourself lost in the middle of nowhere. The only way to leave is to refuel your car. But to do so, you'll have to venture into this desolate forest to find a way to unlock the gas station. But, every bit of flesh in your body screams that you are not alone... As you embark on your journey into the forest, you will be equipped with both a flashlight and a camera. The latter is indispensable for your expedition, as it can capture infrared light, revealing hidden entities beyond the reach of your naked eye. However, amidst these extraordinary phenomena, a malevolent entity lurks. This entity becomes increasingly hostile as you draw closer to discovering the way into his church. Unfortunately, your only chance of survival lies within his church. Therefore, the closer you get to opening the church's door, the more cautious you must become. Nonetheless, there are ways to slow down this entity, and furthermore, there are ways to eliminate it. It all depends on your determination and courage to discover them. INFRARED is a survival horror first-person game with a PSX/PS1 style. The game doesn't save progress, which means you only have one chance to complete it, or you will have to restart from the beginning. The game features three endings: a good ending, a bad ending, and a secret ending. We recommend setting aside one hour for each playthrough to achieve each of the endings and fully experience the entire game. This game also adjusts certain graphical settings (frames per second) during gameplay to create a specific atmosphere.
rows.about_html: You find yourself lost in the middle of nowhere. The only way to leave is to refuel your car. But to do so, you'll have to venture into this desolate forest to find a way to unlock the gas station. But, every bit of flesh in your body screams that you are not alone... As you embark on your journey into the forest, you will be equipped with both a flashlight and a camera. The latter is indispensable for your expedition, as it can capture infrared light, revealing hidden entities beyond the reach of your naked eye. However, amidst these extraordinary phenomena, a malevolent entity lurks. This entity becomes increasingly hostile as you draw closer to discovering the way into his church. Unfortunately, your only chance of survival lies within his church. Therefore, the closer you get to opening the church's door, the more cautious you must become. Nonetheless, there are ways to slow down this entity, and furthermore, there are ways to eliminate it. It all depends on your determination and courage to discover them. INFRARED is a survival horror first-person game with a PSX/PS1 style. The game doesn't save progress, which means you only have one chance to complete it, or you will have to restart from the beginning. The game features three endings: a good ending, a bad ending, and a secret ending. We recommend setting aside one hour for each playthrough to achieve each of the endings and fully experience the entire game. This game also adjusts certain graphical settings (frames per second) during gameplay to create a specific atmosphere.

rows.name: Shenaniganza
rows.short_description: Outsmart friends in goofy hide-and-seek with crazy power-ups, vibrant cartoon aesthetics, and endless laughter. Form alliances, betray buddies, and experience multiplayer mayhem in this unpredictable, entertaining game. Get ready for a bonanza of fun – where laughs never stop!
rows.description_html: What is Shenaniganza? Shenaniganza is a videogame interpretation and remake of the real world game 'manhunt'. Manhunt is alike hide-and-seek, but with a thrilling twist. The Hiders become seekers! In the game you will find wacky powerups and silly skins that let you express your inner silly Billy! Abilities In Shenaniganza, there are several abilities, deploy a heat seeking monkey to find the seekers or weaponize the local banana supply and stun the seekers! Map Features Across the map you will find portals and other interactable mobility objects such as cannons. Use these to escape sticky situations and throw the seekers off course! Matchmaking Shenaniganza features a lobby based matchmaking system, you can either join private games through codes supplied by the game upon lobby creation, or you can choose to quick join a game / choose a public lobby from the lobby selection screen.

rows.name: One Night in Kawami
rows.short_description: Meet a new friend in the dreamlike City of Rivers. One Night in Kawami is a short visual novel about meeting new friends in an unknown city and possibly reshaping reality as you thought you knew it.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the City of Rivers! In One Night in Kawami , you play Max, who is about to meet an online acquaintance for the first time: Tanya. She will be your friendly guide in this metropolis where tradition and technology converge - but other than checking the sights, are there other reasons for this meetup? Only one way to find out... It's Your First Time In the Big City; Make It Count You will get a first look at a longer story in this short visual novel penned by Jigu ( Cobra Kai 2: Dojos Rising , Town of Zoz ). This fifteen-minute tale offers slightly different outcomes on the final stretch. (Feel free to save and load it before pressing the button. Once you get there, you will know.) Original Visuals by Brazilian Artists Featuring character art by SlowPumpkins and backgrounds by Nanda Doti , get ready to meet Kawami's coolest citizens... Dunking on Annoying Wannabes ... and some other guy, apparently? No one knows who he is or cares. Every city has one of those, I guess. Distorted Guitars! If you are as into indie & alternative rock as we are, put on your phones for this. One Night in Kawami features a curated soundtrack to explore the City of Rivers' nightlife. (Creative Commons, full credits in the game) Kawamian Voices Will Not Be Silenced The game features voice reactions by Jonna-Lynn Alonso, Dashawn Ricks, Vanessa Benoit, and casting director Aaron Moy - respectively, Tanya, Gilbert, Inga, and Mohawkadour. About One Night in Kawami This is Brand New Whatever 's first foray into in-house development and self-publishing. It is an expanded and improved remake of Out of Phase Synchronicity , an interactive fiction text adventure Jigu submitted to IntroComp 2020 .

rows.name: Vysions
rows.short_description: Welcome to Vysions, a world made of dreams, where puzzles are truth and you must bring meaning to their madness.
rows.description_html: Vysions is a first-person puzzle game that explores a series of dreams manifested as 3D worlds. Explore unique realms with cryptic machines, enigmatic symbols and riddles to unfold. 'We were alone in a distant void where time had no substance. Then a spark in the mind emerged. Light, thought, and the indecipherable struggles of the other world reaching out as Vysions.'

rows.name: The Great Exhibition of 1851 in VR
rows.short_description: Use your SteamVR system to visit the 1851 Great Exhibition in London's Hyde Park
rows.description_html: The Great Exhibition ran from May to October 1851 in London's Hyde Park, in a temporary building known as the Crystal Palace. Six million visitors passed through the turnstiles, to view over 100,000 individual exhibits. Now, over 170 years later, we are recreating the exhibition as an immersive VR experience. The simulation includes a narrator to describe each of the exhibits and the Crystal Palace building. Fire up your SteamVR system and explore the Great Exhibition... If no VR headset present will run in fallback mode (monitor / keyboard / mouse). Note: this is a large application and can take some time to start up.

rows.name: Mossy Pixels
rows.short_description: Destroy the mossy cover to reveal ancient drawings underneath! Watch the mysterious patterns get dissolved pixel-by-pixel and just... relax. :)
rows.description_html: Mossy Pixels is a 100% free point & click game, the main purpose of which is to help you wind down, relax, and enjoy the moment. Here's how you can play it: 1) Click anywhere on the mossy cover; 2) Watch as the moss slowly dissolves, following a pattern underneath; 3) Repeat points #1 and #2 until the entire drawing is visible; 4) Pat yourself on the back for a job well done! 5) Repeat this process for up to 150 mesmerizing patterns! :3

rows.name: Forgotten Hill The Third Axis
rows.short_description: Enter the twisted world of Forgotten Hill in a new third dimension
rows.description_html: Step into the dark and twisted world of Forgotten Hill, where horror and grotesque creatures lurk in every corner. As a member of the Third Axis organization, you have been sent on a dangerous mission to uncover the truth behind the disappearance of an important member. Explore the eerie surroundings, solve challenging puzzles, and interact with disturbing characters to unravel the mystery and survive the horror. With stunning 3D graphics, immersive sound effects, and a gripping storyline, Forgotten Hill The Third Axis offers a unique and terrifying experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Face a whole new dimension of horror in this new installment of Forgotten Hill, the horror point and click game series, for the first time in 3d! Features: Point-and-click gameplay that challenges your mind and your nerves. Creepy and grotesque atmosphere that will give you goosebumps. Mind-bending puzzles that will test your logic and creativity. Spine-tingling sound effects and music that enhance the horror. 3D graphics that bring the world of Forgotten Hill into a new dimension while maintaining the familiar atmosphere. Engaging storyline that will keep you hooked until the end. Are you ready to face your fears and uncover the secrets of Forgotten Hill in a new third dimension?

rows.description_html: The 77th: The Game is a first-person singleplayer puzzle game. To climb the ranks of the community and advance through the semi-linear narrative, you must solve the various diagetic puzzles. Use your creativity and attentiveness to get through the story and unveil all the game has to offer. Highly Challenging Puzzles Follow the clues, trust your instincts, and conquer some of the highly challenging puzzles featured. Can't find the answers? Keep the puzzles in the back of your mind to come back later, or try returning to them with a fresh mind. Achievements Unlock achievements by solving puzzles in specific ways and managing to perform certain actions. This awards you who have both skill and creativity. Can you unlock them all? Multiple Endings Reach the different endings by completing the game in various ways. Try out different actions in every playthrough, and be creative to reach ends, to see all the outcomes that could be. Underlying Lore Uncover the deep underlying lore. Pay attention to every detail to explore and understand the vast background of the community.

Yeah this is just a hobby project made by one person. I don't need to make this my job, I just like it when people play my game lol!

rows.name: Stamped: an anti-travel game
rows.short_description: Stamped follows the journeys of six young travelers whose paths intersect across Asian urban landscapes. Bound by pleasure-fueled self-destruction, the group flounders from city to city, confronting the grief and discrimination that caused them to travel in the first place.
rows.description_html: STAMPED: AN ANTI-TRAVEL GAME follows the journeys of six young, queer and racialized travelers whose paths intersect across Asian urban landscapes. Bound by pleasure-fueled self-destruction, the group flounders from one metropolis to another, confronting the mixture of grief, betrayal, and discrimination that caused them to travel in the first place. STAMPED features 3-4 hours of playtime through three game modes: poetic interactive fiction, visual novel banter, and point-and-click travel stories. The art style is a mixture of hand-drawn images, real oil paintings, digitally illustrated backgrounds, and of course, incredibly cute manga-style sprites. STAMPED is an adaptation of the novel of (nearly) the same name, Stamped: an anti-travel novel , which won the 2020 Creative Prose Book Award at the Association of Asian American Studies. Like the book, the game's six travelers are faced with ethical decisions concerning the shifts in power that can come with international travel and dwelling within histories of war, genocide, and colonial occupation. STAMPED asks how the excursions of young adulthood can shape our queer, messy and imperfect selves. Made with support from Analgesic Productions and the University of British Columbia.

rows.name: Bounty City: 3-Way Battle
rows.short_description: Bounty City is a multiplayer VR FPS game developed with a unique core concept of a three-way battle. It features diverse scenarios that require intense strategic gameplay.
rows.description_html: Bounty City is a multiplayer VR FPS game where three teams engage in simultaneous battles. With a distinctive bounty system, experience the immersive combat of the first three-way war in VR. Game Highlights 1. Strategic Three-Faction Battle System Most FPS games have two teams, but Bounty City introduces a thrilling three-way battle. Teams alternate between offense and defense, creating unpredictable and tense gameplay for a more engaging experience. 2. Fast-paced Battles on Diverse Battlefields Teams of two to three players experience fast-paced battles on medium and small-sized three-dimensional battlefields. The intricately designed landscapes encourage strategic and deep gameplay. Game Story The discovery of Trillium, a new substance, has transformed the world. Outlaws roam the streets, putting bounties on vital resources. Factions form, and virtual gunfights become a sport as players compete for rewards and bounties. Battlefields Experience dynamic battles in Bounty City's expanded arenas—residential neighborhoods and a former trillium trading organization's headquarters. Town: Navigate through residential battlegrounds with centralized defenses and strategic elevation changes. Office: Engage in intense battles within the corporate remnants, featuring duplex interiors and narrow corridors. Port: Prepare to face the hidden threats in the dark and intricate alley. Outpost: Prepare for close combat in a small battlefield with high obstacles. Trillium as a Paid Good Paid goods called Trillium offer character and weapon customization. Purchase with real money for a personalized battlefield experience. Achievement and Reward System Unlock characters, earn items, and experience a sense of accomplishment through various in-game challenges. Bounty City promises an exhilarating three-way battle experience with strategic depth, engaging storylines, and diverse characters. Join the virtual warfare today!

Outlaws roam the streets, putting bounties on vital resources. Factions form, and virtual gunfights become a sport as players compete for rewards and bounties. Battlefields Experience dynamic battles in Bounty City's expanded arenas—residential neighborhoods and a former trillium trading organization's headquarters. Town: Navigate through residential battlegrounds with centralized defenses and strategic elevation changes. Office: Engage in intense battles within the corporate remnants, featuring duplex interiors and narrow corridors. Port: Prepare to face the hidden threats in the dark and intricate alley. Outpost: Prepare for close combat in a small battlefield with high obstacles. Trillium as a Paid Good Paid goods called Trillium offer character and weapon customization. Purchase with real money for a personalized battlefield experience. rows.name: Arcane Fighters
rows.short_description: Arcane Fighters is 2D platform PvP where you can fight against your friends using magic, strategy and ... MAGIC! Choose from many unique spells and set up your build to outsmart opponents.
rows.description_html: SOUL Step into the world of Arcane Fighters, where nostalgia meets fun and competitiveness. It's a blast from the past that captures the spirit of sharing a keyboard with friends, all while relishing the joy of local multiplayer gaming. MULTIPLAYER Arcane Fighters is a thrilling 2D platform Player vs. Player (PvP) experience, where you can engage in magical battles against your friends, employing cunning strategies and MAGIC! Dive into the world of arcane warfare and choose from various unique spells, crafting your ultimate strategy to outwit and outmaneuver your opponents. SINGLEPLAYER Arcane fighters also have a single player. That is targeted at player scores against other players around the world. A player is going to fight against a few enemies with time getting harder to survive and get a better score. STORY It isn't just a game; it's a time machine to those memorable moments when laughter filled the room and the competition was fierce. In an era dominated by online play, Arcane Fighters harks back to when gathering around a single screen was the pinnacle of gaming excitement. Rediscover the thrill of shared controllers, the camaraderie of local play, and the joy of friendly rivalry with up to three friends. It's your chance to create new memories while treasuring the old ones. Arcane Fighters: More than a game, it's a celebration of the past and a doorway to the future.

rows.name: SurviBall
rows.short_description: Dive into SurviBall, a competitive 3D platform-puzzle game where speed and strategy merge, challenging you to master dynamic levels and climb the leaderboards.
rows.description_html: SurviBall is a fast-paced 3D platformer-puzzle game where precision, speed, and strategy roll into one Step into a world where agility meets intellect, and every second counts! SurviBall invites you to master its physics-driven puzzles as a dexterous ball, with a relentless focus on shaving off time to climb the leaderboards. Gameplay: Master the art of movement with abilities like slow motion and dynamic jumps. Face brain-teasing puzzles and intricate obstacles, all while striving to improve your leaderboard standing. Competitive Edge: SurviBall isn't just about finishing levels; it's about dominating them. Push your limits in our time-trial mode, record your best times, and rise through the ranks of the Steam leaderboards. Adventure Awaits: From mystical forests to neon-lit cyberpunk cities, each zone in SurviBall offers a unique blend of aesthetics and challenges, ensuring a fresh experience in every playthrough. Progress & Mastery: Over 50 levels await, each requiring a mix of skill, strategy, and quick thinking. Grow stronger, faster, and smarter as you navigate through this ever-evolving journey. Key Features: A thrilling blend of speed and strategy across diverse levels. Steam leaderboards to track and boast your high scores. Unlock a range of abilities, including slow motion and wings (among others), to enhance your gameplay. Personalize your ball with various unlockable cosmetics.

rows.name: Energy Tanks
rows.short_description: Fight for glory and bragging rights as you and another player face off to destroy shield generators and tanks in top-down battle arenas! Will you come out as the better tank?
rows.description_html: Energy Tanks is a 2 player top-down action tank game that requires the players to think on their toes about what they need to do and where they need to shoot. With fully interactable menus, players will easily understand the base controls of Energy Tanks. After selecting a map to battle each other in, the battle will start! Surrounding the maps are shield generators that help keep players’ shields active. Players will have to take out all the enemy shield generators to be able to destroy the opposing tank. Also on the maps are power ups to aid in achieving victory, each one giving different powers to change your battle plans. Once the final strike has been landed, players are able to restart the battle or choose a different map to play in. However, be careful about where you fire, you never know if your bullets are going to hit your own shield generator, or worse… 2 Player Local PvP 4 selectable maps 6 different power ups to give you an edge against the other player Bullets will ricochet off walls Friendly-fire is always active This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Reaplaced
rows.short_description: A supernatural Halloween whodunnit. Solve a chilling locked-room mystery before the grim reaper reveals the answer!
rows.description_html: Featured DLC Featured DLC About the Game The creators of mystery games Detective Butler , Methods , SoulSet , and Game of Fourtune have teamed up to create a short and spooky Halloween mystery for you to solve! Reaplaced is a linear murder mystery visual novel with only one ending. There are choices, but they only affect the order in which you experience the story -- nothing else. Your goal is to solve the mystery before the truth is revealed at the end of the game. As you play, clues will be added to your inventory to help you piece together the answer yourself. 25,000 words (2-3 hours of gameplay) A locked-room murder mystery to challenge your wits A CLUES system to help you uncover the truth Immersive sprite animations, backgrounds, and sound effects Accessibility options to customize your experience Award-winning original soundtrack Grea Perrim is a reaper of souls, and it's her duty to bring the deceased to the other side. But in the world of reapers, death isn't any kind of equalizer. The value of a soul is directly tied to the peculiarity of its death. Grea's supernatural senses bring her to a Halloween house party with three costumed guests. She soon finds the most valuable kind of soul: the victim of a locked-room murder. To reap the soul, Grea must unravel the identity of its killer and explain its death in full. Is this the work of a human? A witch? Or something else entirely...?

rows.name: Astral Party
rows.short_description: Astral Party is a multiplayer party game populated by cute anime girls! Choose your favorite character, strategize skills & cards, and roll the dice to destroy friendships in this unique board game.
rows.description_html: FOLLOW US Follow us for the latest info: Twitter: Neverland Entertainment, AstralParty_official YouTube: Neverland_Entmt, AstralParty_official Discord: Astral Party Presskit: Astral Party About the Game Astral Party is a board party game that supports online multiplayer with up to 4 players. This is a free to play game, with in-app purchases like skins, dress-ups that do not affect the gameplay balance. Board Party Game with Suspenses A board game like no other! 15 different panel effects, random effects and events make every game full of suspense and unpredictability. With the roll of dice, you always have chances to turn the tables at the last minute. Over 10 Cute Anime Girls This is an exciting dicing battle with vivid Characters, each with unique skills and beautiful illustration. 10 characters are available as the game launches, and will have more as updates add. 4-Person Online Matches or Single Play with AI Play how you want. Astral Party allows 1 to 4 players to compete online, or single-person play with AI. It's all the same friendship ruining fun. Dices & Cards & Battles & More The crux of Astral Party lies in its one-on-one dice-based combat system, with a myriad of cards, effects, skill, events, and more. Card plays can augment your attack, and the dice decides if it is dodged. Every attack is like a small gamble, and nothing is more chilling than the moment you presume victory is within your grasp. Monsters Spice Up the Game More As the game advances, monsters will surface on the board, some attacking players and others merely stealing coins. In the end, a formidable Boss will appear and relentlessly target the richest player. If it is you, be wary of other players’ 'backstabs'. (PS: Try beat the Boss to find out if there is reward dropping) Victory Condition Players rake in some coins to level up, and the first player hitting level 3 becomes the victor. Be quick to turn those shiny coins into levels, cause you never know if you are still rich in the next turn.

rows.description_html: Control both airplanes Experience the thrill of handling two aircraft simultaneously. Whether you prefer the precision of a keyboard or the intuitive feel of a gamepad, you'll be able to master the skies. Local Co-op and Steam Remote Play Team up with a friend and enjoy the excitement of local co-op gameplay, or take advantage of Steam's Remote Play to connect with friends from around the world. Coordinate your strategies, support each other in battle, and dominate the enemy forces together. Multiple Altitudes of Combat Engage in dynamic dogfights across various altitudes. Bomb factories from low-altitude or zoom into high-altitude duels, adapting your tactics to the changing battlefield and proving your supremacy in the air.

rows.name: Lost Chronicles
rows.short_description: Investigate the disappearance of a child and unravel the secrets of a deceptively quiet town called Forest Hill. “Lost Chronicles” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Object, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and challenging quests.
rows.description_html: Investigate the disappearance of a child and unravel the secrets of a deceptively quiet town called Forest Hill. “Lost Chronicles” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Object, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and challenging quests. Leonor arrives at Forest Hill to become the apprentice of the local elder, healer, and alchemist, Magnus. Not only will she have to befriend the locals and prove herself a worthy student, but she also has to dive into the secrets of a small town. Because shortly before her arrival, a series of mysterious crimes begins that will stand in her way to a brighter future. She bravely copes with one trouble after another, but their number is growing. Can she handle all the challenges that the adult world has prepared for her? - Investigate the mysterious disappearance of a child - Settle in a cozy little town and befriend its inhabitants - Get help from new friends in difficult quests - Solve lots of incredible puzzles and explore dozens of hidden object scenes - Gather amazing collections during your adventure - Enjoy stunning locations, magnificent graphics and exciting story

rows.name: Vivaldia 2
rows.short_description: Pitted against relentless robotic foes and navigating through dense and perilous jungles, scorching lava fields, and treacherous swamps, Vivaldia once again seems faced with an impossible challenge. With the fate of the land in her hands – will Vivaldia rise to the occasion?
rows.description_html: With the first iteration of Vivaldia, we gave our users the most powerful in-browser game available. We are about productivity and flexibility, but we are also all about fun. Vivaldia added a lot of fun! Vivaldia 2 is the much-awaited continuation of the Vivaldia game series. In this new chapter, the game is bigger, and the bosses are stronger. Nevertheless, our heroine is more determined than ever to take down the evil forces and save the world once again. Sometimes you just need a quick break, and to play a game. Falling out of the skies, ready to take on a new adventure, Vivaldia is back. After entering a portal and being teleported away, Vivaldia is transported to a Lost Valley, where she must continue her fight against evil. Embarking on a thrilling adventure, facing robots and prehistoric dinosaurs, Vivaldia must save a new world, this time from the clutches of the malevolent Robot Overlord. Pitted against relentless robotic foes and navigating through dense and perilous jungles, scorching lava fields, and treacherous swamps, Vivaldia once again seems faced with an impossible challenge. With the fate of the land in her hands – will Vivaldia rise to the occasion? How to play? Use keyboard controls: Arrows right and left to move. Arrow up to climb and trigger teleporters. Arrow down to crawl and climb down N-key or Spacebar to jump M-key to shoot Vivaldia 2 can also be played with a game controller.

rows.name: Welcome to the Karoshi Club
rows.short_description: If you're nervous about job searching and interviews, face your fears head-on in 'Welcome to the Karoshi Club' a Japanese horror business punk visual novel.
rows.description_html: Karoshi Club About the Game 'Welcome to the Karoshi Club' is a free visual novel set in the Japanese horror business punk in black and white manga style. The story follows Kenji Haishima, a former game developer, as he tries to find a new job and land an interview for the sales specialist position at a new company. As the player, you will face the consequences of your choices. Explore the 'Karoshi Club' world and uncover the terrifying truth. Enjoy a thrilling experience and immerse yourself in this unique visual novel. It is a fact that we are keen on expanding the universe of 'Karoshi Club' in collaboration with the gaming community. Therefore, 'Welcome to the Karoshi Club' is a free showcase of our primary product. We are looking to get feedback on the game to determine whether we are heading in the right direction and identify what we did well and what needs improvement. Job Interview Horror Simulator: Experience the fear of job searching in a new reality Art: This game's visual style is reminiscent of other famous horror manga artists Setting: The crisis in Japan during the 90s is relevant to modern times Our multinational indie team is a group of game developers impacted by layoffs in the gaming industry in 2023. However, we refused to give up and used this to create something of our own. We are determined to develop games and create specific worlds we are passionate about, and we hope you will love them just as much as we do. Listen to the stories from Kamishibai while you sit back.

rows.name: Know Your Limits
rows.short_description: Know Your Limits is a speed run game with speed limits. You can increase your speed by collecting coins, but it wouldn't be always the best choice. Go through all the obstacles and get your highest score!
rows.description_html: What if you got 300km/h maximum speed but cannot fully use it to clear the stage? There are lots of speed limits on your way of adventure. Know your limits or else you'll fall! Experience this unique speed game for FREE Features Play time less than 30 mins Composed of one Tutorial Stage and one Main Stage Relaxing beautiful sky and ambient

rows.name: Return to Northbury Grove
rows.short_description: Return to Northbury Grove is a thrilling VR experience and love letter to the slasher horror genre. Centered around immersive escape room gameplay, players are tasked with evading the terrifying Slasher of Specter Forest. Can you survive a horror movie?
rows.description_html: Liam Murphy is an aspiring actor looking to land the role of a lifetime at the infamous Rock the Warehouse music festival. Upon arriving at the desolate RTW concert grounds, Liam faces death itself after being kidnapped and thrown into the basement of the Spector Forest Slasher’s labyrinthian kill-house. Now, Liam must use his wits and bravery to survive the traps, trials, and tribulations that lay before him. Will he become the Slasher’s latest victim or will he escape to the fresh air of freedom? Find out by confronting death and your own fears in…Return to Northbury Grove! This immersive VR experience is a love letter to the slasher genre that elevates the terror and ratchets up the tension of the Northbury Grove franchise – so don’t make a sound, stay out of sight, and whatever you do, do not cross the Slasher. Let the blood curdling cries commence! Next-Level Immersion: Experience every pulse-pounding moment in full 360-degree VR. Physics First: The game is 100% physically simulated, from the player itself to almost every object and item found in all levels. Haunting Atmosphere: The unsettling ambiance of Specter Forest and other mysterious places come to life like never before as you live the experience with the maximum immersion Chilling Audio: Spatial Sound effects make you feel as if you're truly part of this living nightmare. Unpredictable Gameplay: Your choices matter. Make decisions that impact your survival in real-time. Adaptive AI: No two playthroughs are the same. The lurking terror adapts to your actions in real-time. Do you have what it takes to actually survive a horror movie? Modifier Mania: Total Darkness? Guns Everywhere? Happy the Humble Heifer? Play with modifiers, the real game starts once you beat it the first time!

rows.name: Sins OV Cigar
rows.short_description: Brutal Slice-Em-Up Gun and Scythe combat set in a deranged world. Playtime is an hour long, the game is a college project. Also known as Sins Of Cigar.
rows.description_html: Extreme melee/gun combat with a focus on player aggressiveness and risk/reward mechanics. Features agile movement and brutal melee combat Richad Cigar, quadrillionaire and head of the Cigar corporation, has been dealt a military invasion by a rival splinter company organized by a former friend, Tony Robusto. Cigar seeks to capture Robusto himself. In thousands of years, not one normal or healthy person has set foot in this continent dominated by corrupt business. Also known as Sins Of Cigar.

rows.name: Kottabos VR
rows.short_description: This is a VR trip into the ancient world – playing Kottabos, the all-time favorite Greek party game. Prove your skill by throwing the dregs of wine from your cup at the metal disk on the pole in front of you, or fling your drops at the little cups floating in a bowl.
rows.description_html: This is a VR trip into the ancient world – playing Kottabos, the all-time favorite Greek party game. All the items you see around you are 3D reconstructions of actual ancient furniture, pottery, and Kottabos targets from museums. This historical game is harder than it looks! In ancient Greece Kottabos was a popular party game in which players threw the dregs from the bottom of their cup at targets. These included a disk on the top of a pole and cups floating in a bowl of water. They competed for adoration, praise, and respect of the other party-goers. Prove your skill by throwing the dregs of wine from your cup at the metal disk on the pole in front of you, or fling your drops at the little cups floating in a bowl. If the disk or the cups go down, your luck goes up! A round of applause, an extra dessert, or the favor of Aphrodite herself will come to the winners. Game Features: Physics-driven gameplay in VR. Controller momentum and trigger button throws the dregs. Aim at the different targets, and get higher scores based on strength of hit and placement on the target. Three different levels of gameplay. Tutorial level. Track your high scores. Educational! Learn about Kottabos, the real Greek party game. Free! Use for classes. rows.name: Aviators
rows.short_description: An educational adventure game about Polish air personnel during World War II. Meet the pilots of the 1586 Special Destiny Squadron and join them on incredible assignments. Explore and solve puzzles to learn more about the history of Polish aviation.
rows.description_html: DISCOVER THE HISTORY OF THE POLISH AIR FORCE DURING WORLD WAR II Take the role of a Polish aviation ace from World War II and engage in aerial battles with the Luftwaffe! Learn the story of the legendary Polish 1586 Special Destiny Squadron and join them on incredible missions. Repel the attacks of the German air force, operate devices on board the Halifax MK, communicate with the local partisan unit “Armia Krajowa”, and assist the Warsaw Uprising! Break through the German A2 fortifications, destroy 88 mm artillery positions, and complete the mission with a car escape Key Features: A story based on real events and characters from the Polish Air Force during World War II. A blend of exploration, aerial combat, and logical puzzles. A journal module containing a comprehensive compendium of historical knowledge referenced in 'Aviators.' An immersive soundtrack, 'The Aviators' Suite,' featuring compositions by Przemysław Treszczotka inspired by the music of Karol Szymanowski and Mieczysław Karłowicz.

rows.name: Life Makeover
rows.short_description: Explore Life Makeover: Unleash your style, dye outfits, and design freely. Dive into unlimited dress-up, build your dream home - all for free.
rows.description_html: Life Makeover is a liberating fashion game where you have the freedom to express your unique style. Customize your virtual persona, experiment with various fashion choices, and dive into the joy of unlimited dress-up possibilities with fashion dye and do-it-yourself (DIY) options. It's your chance to create your own fashion show! Plus, you can even design and build your dream home for free. [Unleash Your Unique Persona] - Customize Every Detail Take command of your virtual character and let your style shine. Customize facial features, body shape, and skin tone to break free from conventions and express yourself in your own extraordinary way. [Elevate Designs with Limitless Wardrobe] - Powered by UE4 Engine Experience an extensive wardrobe for every occasion, each design flawlessly detailed. Fueled by the cutting-edge UE4 engine and a range of 3D materials, your creations will be impeccably crafted, down to the smallest stitch and embroidery. [Express with Color, Lead with Style] - The Power of Fashion Dye Unleash your creativity through the fashion dye feature. Color different parts of your outfits with hundreds of combinations, from dazzling iridescence to perfectly coordinated hues. Be a trailblazer in setting new trends and embody the essence of beauty. [Your Designs, Your Brand] - DIY Garment Studio Step into the shoes of a fashion designer. From fabric selection to pattern making, cutting, and printing, oversee every aspect of the creative process. Your designs, your choices, your brand. [Beyond Fashion, Craft Your Ideal Home] - Unleash a Dream Lifestyle Personalize your living space with a diverse selection of furniture. Embrace a lifestyle of reading, dancing, working out, hosting parties, raising pets, and much more in your ideal home. [Uncover Mysteries and Memories] - Immersive Stories with Live2D Cards Delve into captivating stories and memories brought to life with Live2D cards. Concealed beneath exquisite costumes lie mysteries and clues waiting to be unraveled. Are you prepared to uncover the truth? [Connect, Create, and Celebrate] - Thrive in a Community of Designers Join a dynamic community of designers in a boundless universe. Share makeup and outfit ideas, visit friends' homes, host afternoon tea gatherings, and enhance house decor for stunning photos. Forge new friendships and connect with others in the world of Life Makeover. [Your Journey to Infinite Possibilities] - Beauty, and Freedom In Life Makeover, you're not just a player; you're a creator. Come and infuse your life with inspiration and imagination. Embrace a world where diversity and freedom reign supreme! FAQ:

rows.name: My Horse: Bonded Spirits - Prologue
rows.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version. Build a bond with your horse and gain its trust. Develop yours and the horse’s skills. Discover the surrounding open world. Complete tasks and take part in competitions. Rebuild a run-down stud farm!
rows.description_html: Welcome to the Prologue of My Horse: Bonded Spirits! The prologue is only part of the full game and is completely free. Every player will be able to play it and see what awaits them in the full version of the game. Your story Begin your adventure as the reluctant future heir of a stud farm. Prove that you are more than just a spoiled brat. Start from scratch and learn how to keep and manage a stud farm; it will be a challenge that will prove incredibly rewarding – return the stud farm to its former glory! Along your journey, discover that nothing is as lasting as the bond with your horses! Manage your stud farm and return it to its former glory! Your stud farm is not in a good shape – your job is to rebuild it, which will require quite a bit of skill and knowledge about keeping a stud farm. Develop your skills and gain knowledge to bring the farm up to scratch and learn how to maintain it. Manage your employees and other horses. Watch the stud farm transform from a ruin into a home for you and your horses. Your horse isn’t the only friend you can make! Saddle up and explore the idyllic open world of Chestnut Glen and its surrounding landscape. Help rebuild the run-down stud farm by trotting around and meeting the village’s residents – hang out with them and complete tasks for them to improve your and the stud farm’s reputation. Remember, not everybody you meet will want to be friends with you. Some people don’t even like horses! Your dream horse In My Horse: Bonded Spirits - Prologue, you can change not only your appearance but also your horse’s and the stud farm’s. Choose various accessories, hairstyles, and saddles for your horse, so that you can gallop through the world in style. Place decorations and renovate the stud farm to beautify not only the stables but also the whole surrounding area! Prove yourself in various competitions Do you think the bond with your horse is strong enough to win competitions? The more trust there is between the two of you, the more easily your horse will learn new skills and the less afraid they will be of new challenges.

rows.name: Love Alone Death
rows.short_description: Build relationship with the characters. Your choices might earn you favor from one character, but disdain from another. Use items to solve problems. Confront various endings. Choose one person and face the end with them.
rows.description_html: Embark on a hand-drawn, story-driven, point-and-click game. Unravel the story, discover items, and get to know characters whose endings depend on your choices. Humans have suddenly disappeared from the world, and those who remain are sticking together. You, who always struggled to be with others, now face the choice of whom to spend your final moments with. Game Features: - Various Ways to Solve Problems: Your choices affect character relationships. - Multiple Endings: Choose one person to spend your final moments with, play the romance route, go for the all-inclusive ending, or even confront the end alone. Collect all endings and complete the challenges. - Warning: Occasional disturbing elements such as corpses, mice, blood, vomit, and severed heads may appear without warning.

rows.name: Corked
rows.short_description: A Ski and Snowboard game for skiers and snowboarders. Get Corked.
rows.description_html: A ski and snowboard game for skiers and snowboarders. inspired by multiple generations of actions sports games such as Amped2 and the THPS series, corked is half arcade, half ski simulator blending a realistic physics based trick system with fun and easy to play challenges and terrain. Explore the mountain, find creative lines through a rail run or get first tracks through some pow, interacting with other riders, tourists and ski patrol along the way.

rows.name: Tulip
rows.short_description: You are a very sad bunny. You cannot stop crying. You might have to drink something gross. You are Tulip. Wander through a storybook countryside, gather ingredients for a strange brew, and get to know your adorable animal neighbors in an odd quest to alleviate your incurable sadness.
rows.description_html: You are a very sad bunny. You cannot stop crying. You might have to drink something gross. You are Tulip. Wander through a storybook countryside, gather ingredients for a strange brew, and get to know your adorable animal neighbors in an odd quest to alleviate your incurable sadness. . TAKE WEIRD ADVICE FROM A MAGAZINE Guide Tulip on their quest to heal their heartbreak using Miss Kitty's advice column -- and it's odd (and unsubstantiated) tea recipe. EXPLORE THE COUNTRYSIDE Six beautifully illustrated levels for Tulip to hop through while completing their ingredients list, with adorable (and sometimes helpful) neighbors to interact with. PLAY MINIGAMES Put together bouquets, harvest herbs from Tulip's garden, and solve short music puzzles to help Tulip find what they need. DRINK SOMETHING GROSS Once every item is found, put together the final concoction in a tea brewing minigame.

rows.name: The Consumist Journey
rows.short_description: The Consumist Journey is a surreal exploration game where you play as a strange character on a quest to explore the capitalist and consumerist paradigms of modern society. Navigate through bizarre and nonsensical environments, solve puzzles, and interact with eccentric characters.
rows.description_html: The Consumist Journey is a surreal exploration game where you play as a torso-headed character on a quest to explore the capitalist and consumerist paradigms of modern society. Navigate through bizarre and nonsensical environments, solve puzzles, and interact with eccentric characters to learn more about the world and your place in it. Along the way, you'll confront challenging questions about the nature of consumerism, capitalism, and the human condition. Key Features: Explore a surreal and nonsensical world: The Consumist Journey features a unique and imaginative art style that creates a surreal and thought-provoking world to explore. Play as a torso-headed character: Your character is a torso with a head, but don't let that stop you from exploring and solving puzzles. Unravel the mysteries of capitalism and consumerism: Through your interactions with the world and its inhabitants, you'll learn more about the capitalist and consumerist paradigms of modern society. Confront challenging questions: The Consumist Journey is a game that asks difficult questions about the nature of our world. What is the true cost of our consumerism? What is our place in a capitalist society? If you're a fan of surreal exploration games, thought-provoking narratives, and challenging questions, then this is the game for you.

rows.name: Sorrows End
rows.short_description: A fantasy turn-based RPG, Made with RPG Maker MV. It utilizes a side view battle system, contains scenes that may be frightening and scenes of anguish. Sorrows End is a heart-wrenching tale of loss.
rows.description_html: When the King of Dicleus is assassinated, the Diclean army razes their neighboring kingdom of Jesagris in retaliation for actions Jesagris never committed, creating many orphans. Sorrows End follows the story of one said orphan and her quest to find a way to prevent such tragedies from occurring again. Will she make friends? Will she save others? Will there be a talking cat? Yes to all! Expect 8-12 hours of gameplay. Contains fantasy violence, frightening themes and themes of anguish. Features include character customization, choices that matter, three endings, and partial controller support.

rows.name: Ultimate pirates
rows.short_description: Abandoned MMO set in Pirates world. Absolutely FREE! NO in-app purchases, you can find gems by killing monsters. NO premium content. Official ABANDONWARE: no updates, no bug fixes, no improvements, no support, no empty promises. The game provided AS IS.
rows.description_html: About this game: A city building / strategy MMO game. Start from a small island, build a small town first and develop it to a big city. Build pirate ships, starting from small shallops and ending huge Ships of the line, Galleons and fast Frigates, manage multiple fleets performing tasks such as killing monsters and plundering other cities. Hunt other pirates by intercepting their fleets on their way. Steal their gold, weapons and other resources. This is an MMO game, which means you can play with your friends, or find new ones in the game. Form alliances, chat with your teammates, organize raids to kill huge monsters together, join with your friends to perform more powerful attacks. This is a RPG as well: you can play an evil pirate, who attacks everyone, steals from everyone or you can be a honest pirate, who helps their friends, revenge their enemies or, you can even choose to never participate in battles and be a peaceful pirate, who grows carrots, it's up to you! DISCLAIMER: (PLEASE read it BEFORE YOU PLAY ) My name is Artem, and I am the game designer and lead developer of this game. This game is a gift to all players who want to try something new absolutely for FREE. There are no purchase fees, no in-app purchases (IAPs), and no ads. We do not accept any donations or payments from players. There is no way for any player to pay us money. We earn nothing from this game. Moreover, this is an online game, and we, as developers, pay for the servers. Keeping this game online and operational without any form of monetization costs us money. In the end, this game is not just unprofitable; it results in a net loss for us. You might be wondering why anyone in their right mind would release a game without any monetization and continue to pay for servers. Due to a non-disclosure agreement (NDA), I cannot reveal all the details of the unfortunate story of how this game was launched and why it was shut down. However, I can tell you that we spent almost 4 years developing this game, and players who liked it could only enjoy it for a couple of months. These events and their aftermath had a devastating impact on my mental health. I am in much better shape now, but I am still dealing with the consequences to this day. Spending 4 years of my life working hard on this game and then keeping it hidden from players was one of the many reasons that led to this situation. We cannot launch this game with a profit, but we can launch it without one. So, here we are. Because the game is unprofitable, consider it official ABANDONWARE and don't say I didn't warn you! Do not expect any updates or support, and do not expect this game to stay online forever. Accept the game AS IS, with all its flaws, bugs, and imperfections. It has some :) However, this game has many similarities with our other games, so, in case you need an advice, we have an amazing community of players who could probably help you on our forums and Discord. From our end we will try to guarantee the servers of the game will be up and running as long as our company exists and could handle the costs. I hope you will find the game enjoyable at least for some time and its unique mechanics will provide you with either adrenaline in PvP or a chill in PvE (whatever you choose to take). Stay healthy and happy, Sincerely yours, Artem Shpytiak

rows.name: Impossible Bunny Challenge
rows.short_description: Surf the wind as a Bunny and race against three other Bunnies to collect checkpoint balls. The game features a robust racing AI that is very challenging to beat. You’ll have to learn quickly if you want to beat the Impossible Bunny Challenge!
rows.description_html: Impossible Bunny Challenge is a fun and free game that lets you surf the wind as a Bunny and race against three other Bunnies to collect checkpoint balls. The game features a tough racing AI that learned how to win by itself using machine learning. It is intentionally harder to control your Bunny, so you’ll have to learn quickly to beat the competition at their own game. You can also customize the Bunnies trail effects for extra fun. Choose from different range of effects to make your Bunny stand out from the crowd. Or just sit back and watch the action in spectator mode from a total of 3 levels including the Moon. Best played with your own music playing in the background! Can you master your Bunny's controls to beat the Impossible Bunny Challenge? Download the game for free today and see if you can outrace the smartest, fastest, & cutest wind surfing Bunnies in the world!

rows.name: Bistro Blitz
rows.short_description: Work with a friend to feed the hungry customers at your bistro, but be mindful of keeping them happy.
rows.description_html: Bistro Blitz Step into the chaotic and hilarious world of 'Bistro Blitz,' where you and a partner embark on a culinary adventure like no other. Team up to run a bustling restaurant, with one player assuming the role of the visionary chef and the other as the mischievous waiter. Here's the twist: the waiter holds the secret desires of each customer close to their apron, while the chef wields the power to turn those cravings into delectable dishes. Coordination and communication are the keys to success, but who says you can't spice things up a bit? Delight in the pandemonium of intentionally mixing up orders and serving up culinary chaos, all while trying to keep the restaurant's reputation intact. 'Bistro Blitz' is not just a game – it's a recipe for laughter, collaboration, and maybe a dash of delightful mayhem. This is a multiplayer only game. Gameplay Overview You and a friend are running a restaurant together. One player will be the chef and the other will be the waiter. The waiter is the only one that can take and see customer's orders, and the chef is the only one that can make the dishes. You need to work together and communicate in order to make the meals that the customers want. Key Features Create your own custom meals Take orders from customers Earn money by fulfilling orders Credits Programming, Testing, & World Design - Ethan Barlevy Music - Levy Barlevy This is a student project. Because of this, there is no guarantee of updates after release. Also, the core of this project was made in 8 weeks so there are likely multiple bugs. FAQ Why are the minimum requirements so high? I am only able to test on my computer so I only checked on that system. The game will probably run with lower specs but I can not confirm that it will work. What do I do if the interactions break? This can usually be fixed if you walk away then back towards whatever you were trying to interact with. If that still doesn't work, you need to throw away whatever you are holding and try again.

rows.name: Pellet Packer: Micro Munch
rows.short_description: Chomp your way up the ranks in 'Pellet Packer: Micro Munch'! A chaotic strategy survival game where everything- including your own control method- is your enemy.
rows.description_html: Chomp your way up the ranks in 'Pellet Packer: Micro Munch'! 'Pellet Packer: Micro Munch' is a chaotic strategy survival game where everything- including your own control method- is your enemy. Only true survivors can take on this challenge and get all the crowns, trophies and milestones! Plant your defenses, collect micros and be the first to win three rounds! Play fast-paced match based gameplay with a large focus realtime strategy. Explore the 5 different game modes including Match Mode, Endurance Mode, Gluttony Mode, VS Mode and Blockbuster Mode. Completionists will especially enjoy all of the unlockable content in this game. As you rank up, you can unlock achievements, such as trophies, milestones and gold crowns! You can also unlock new ways to customize your game, as well as ranking up your Gold Mode! Originally released February 1st, 2021 Special thanks to SheepTester for code/exporting help

rows.name: Pellet Packer: Cookie Crunch
rows.short_description: Crunch your way around fun, colourful worlds in 'Pellet Packer: Cookie Crunch'!
rows.description_html: Platforming with a mouse has never been so fun! Chomper and Chaser are back like you've never seen them before! This time, they explore delicious new worlds in Pellet Packer: Cookie Crunch! Play through all-new platforming levels that cleverly remix the same movement mechanics and controls from the original Pellet Packer: Micro Munch! Use the cookies scattered around the stage to traverse, show off your quick wits and reflexes to pass tricky obstacles, explore the stage to find all 6 Chaser defences in each one and advance to the next level-- but watch out!! Every 5 levels, there's a boss battle- utilizing the same physics as the original Pellet Packer: Micro Munch!! Can you complete this crunchy quest? With a substantial main quest and a large amount of post-game content, this extremely replayable game feels like biting into a warm, freshly baked cookie- and once you get a taste of this treat, you'll be eating it up for a while!! Originally released February 1st, 2022 Special thanks to SheepTester for code/exporting help
