rows.name: One Way Road: Firehunt
rows.short_description: Firehunt is a prologue for the main story One Way Road. Take part in space battles as you travel across the galaxy and fight to save humanity. This cinematic narrative driven action-focused space shooter, will take you on a journey into the near future, and put the destiny of mankind in your hands.
rows.description_html: The player will take control of a spaceship as the captain of Space Fleet Command, James Dekker. Together with a team of recruits, on a battle-worn ship, you will look into the most remote corners of the galaxy, engage in fierce space combat, fight with entire fleets, and protect not only the Earth but all of humanity. A captivating storyline. Experience a world where moral dilemmas can turn friends and allies into enemies, and utterly devastate worlds. Discover what it means to be in charge of your team from the perspective of a hardened and sometimes cynical war veteran. Build a branching narrative that will determine not only the fate of the main characters, but the survival of the entire universe as well. Cinematic experience. Almost seamlessly blending interactive cutscenes with gameplay One Way Road delivers one of the most cinematic, expansive and life-like journeys through the Galaxy war. The game’s on-screen direction will keep you engaged till the end credits roll. Progression system. As you travel, you will earn Experience points that can be used to upgrade your ship's systems and install new equipment. It is up to you to adjust your ship to suit your style of play or to adapt yourself and master your chosen battle tactics. Explore the galaxy's far reaches. Engage in space combat and battle on planet surfaces. Drive a spaceship through dense asteroid fields, chase down a hurling comet, or explore a gigantic space station that's full of dark labyrinths. Gameplay mechanics intertwined. The game is blending several action mechanics in order to create an action packed space story. - The Scroll Shooter mode allows you to control a Starfleet heavy cruiser that is powerful enough to take out entire fleets. - The Top-down Shooter mode puts you in control of a small, nimble space-fighter jet. - The Tube Shooter mode enables you to chase the enemy, destroying everything that stands in your way.

rows.name: Definya 2D MMORPG
rows.short_description: Fantasy 2D Retro Pixel Anime MMORPG — Crafting, Open-World, Sandbox — PVP & PvE
rows.description_html: Definya: Dive into the Ultimate MMORPG Experience with Deep Customization and Dynamic Gameplay! Embark on an unforgettable adventure in Definya, where immersive MMORPG elements meet the freedom of an open-world RPG. Forge your path with robust features that offer endless possibilities for every player. 🛡️ Dynamic Guild System: Join or create powerful guilds to collaborate with friends and players worldwide. Engage in guild quests, participate in large-scale battles, and build a community that thrives together. 💎 Gem Customization: Personalize your gear like never before! Enhance your weapons and armor with unique gems, each providing distinct abilities and boosts. Tailor your equipment to match your playstyle and dominate the battlefield. 🌐 Sandbox Economy: Experience a living, breathing economy driven by player interactions. Trade, craft, and build your wealth in a system where your actions directly impact the game world. Whether you’re a trader, crafter, or entrepreneur, Definya offers opportunities for everyone. 🌾 Farming & Resource Management: Cultivate your land, harvest resources, and manage your farms to support your adventures. Engage in agriculture, animal husbandry, and resource gathering to sustain yourself and contribute to the economy. 🌍 Expansive Open World & Dungeon Exploration: Traverse diverse landscapes, discover hidden treasures, and conquer challenging dungeons. Each area is meticulously crafted to provide unique experiences and formidable foes. ⚔️ Rich MMO RPG Depth: Immerse yourself in a world filled with intricate quests, engaging storylines, and dynamic events. Whether you prefer solo adventures or cooperative missions, Definya caters to all playstyles with depth and variety. 📱 Cross-Platform Accessibility: Play seamlessly across mobile and browser platforms. Definya ensures a smooth and consistent experience, allowing you to adventure anytime, anywhere. ⭐ Community-Driven Development: Your voice matters! Participate in shaping Definya’s future with regular updates, community events, and responsive support. Join a vibrant community that’s as passionate about the game as you are. ⭐ Reviews 'Definya offers unparalleled customization and a thriving economy. I love how my guild and I can truly make an impact!' – Alex Turner 'The gem system is incredibly deep, allowing me to tailor my gear to fit my playstyle perfectly. Highly recommend!' – Maya Singh 'From farming to dungeon crawling, Definya has something for everyone. The open-world is stunning and full of life.' – Carlos Ramirez 'Joining a guild in Definya has been the highlight of my MMORPG experience. The teamwork and community are fantastic!' – Elena Petrova Join the Definya community today and experience the pinnacle of modern MMORPG gameplay. Whether you're customizing your gear, building your empire, or exploring vast new territories, Definya offers endless adventures waiting for you!

rows.name: Touhou Meijinka ~ Song of Divine Tempest
rows.short_description: A thunderous concert appears...
rows.description_html: It is raining and pouring. It's not your average thunderstorm, but a primordial one. This storm doesn't seem to stop. At the same time, the storm is also producing gospel chanting, leading to people being attracted to the concert. The Land of Illusions ends up becoming empty, giving the local bands no opportunity to perform for their people. Based on an original screenplay by Emiko Hosokawa, you take control of one of four humanoids to set out and find the source of the concert. Originally based on a fangame album featuring an original score by Chuhou Joutai creator Susumu Takajima, you must traverse six stages of varying terrain to find the concert's mastermind. Whether you're alone or with a friend*, your own danmaku is imperative. This will not be an easy journey - you must dodge your enemies' danmaku and overcome their spell cards. *Additional accessories may be required for local multiplayer modes. Features Four playable characters spanning different backgrounds Four difficulty modes with different spell cards A six-stage main game plus a post-game extra stage A series of original characters created by Susumu Takajima and Emiko Hosokawa to fight against 1990s-style musical score by Susumu Takajima Controller support Co-op mode

rows.name: Cave Heroes
rows.short_description: Lead a party of Cave Heroes to explore dungeons, battle monsters and defeat tough archdemons. Build your village, collect loot, rescue pets and much more in this idle RPG.
rows.description_html: Cave Heroes Cave Heroes is a challenging idle game where you explore dungeons, fight demons and face powerfull bosses. Descending into the depths of the caves, you will find forgotten knowledge, learn to use Dark Mana, collect powerful loot and absorb the power of the Archdemons. Improve You Village Unlock new buildings, hire workers, veterans and archmages and watch your heroes' stats grow. Perform Dark Rituals, idle to accumulate resources, build more buildings and watch as previously invincible enemies are defeated in one blow. Collect Loot Fight in quests to collect artifacts, capture Dark Equipment from bosses, complete tasks to achieve Rewards to improve your heroes further. Tame Pets and Unlock Skins Play mini games to rescue pets, tame them to get help on your journey. Unlock 20+ powerful and cute skins. Beat Dark Lord Reach the Dark Fortress and defeat the Dark Lord, ending his ruthless raids forever.

rows.name: Grog
rows.short_description: Grog is a First-Person, 2-8 player online multiplayer party game where you compete against your friends in various Australian-inspired minigames to see who the greatest Aussie dad is.
rows.description_html: Grog is a First-Person online party game where 2-8 players compete in many Australian-dad-inspired minigames to see who is truly the greatest Aussie dad. Minigames Compete in various minigames against your friends to earn points. Whoever has the most points after all minigames are complete, wins! Here are some of the challenges you will compete in: BBQ off Cook as much meat as possible within the time limit. Make sure you don't burn the meat though! Lawnmowing Mow a lawn... More than the others Beer Collecting You are in desperate need of some beer. Run around and collect any beer you can find before the other Dads find it! Camping Collect important materials located around the map and improve your campsite before it's too dark! Surfing Look back to your glory days and bring back your exceptional surfing skills. Use these old-school skills to stay in the water and avoid waves for as long as possible! Line Waiting You've been dragged to go shopping with your wife, and now you're waiting in line at the checkout. However, there are still so many cool dad things located around the store, so you'll have to sneak out of line and collect them without your wife knowing! Home Improvements Your home is in desperate need of some new improvements, so you're going to build a deck. Scavage through the hardware store and find the items you need to craft the perfect deck for your house. Parkour You've just finished camping out in the middle of nowhere, but now you need to make it back home. Parkour your way through the wilderness, hopping over rivers, and weaving through trees to make it back to your beloved home! Powerups You need some essential upgrades to help you compete against the other dads, so you go shopping. Use your time and points wisely to select the powerups that will give you the greatest advantage in your next minigames. Character Customisation Make your dad look stylish! Create your unique look by customising the colours of your shirt, shoes, skin, shorts, or beard! Also earn shoes, hats, and body accessories while playing Grog to improve your style. rows.name: Humpi and Hemicube
rows.short_description: A sokoban-style puzzle game where everything has its own gravity. Because of this, you can walk on the wall and other things can stay on the wall. You can teleport in this game. Other characters will move when you move, so make a strategy and use this to your advantage to solve puzzles.
rows.description_html: Step into a mind-bending world where gravity dances to your tune! In this 3d puzzle adventure, you'll navigate through a mesmerizing realm where every object possesses its own gravitational pull. Twist, teleport and turn your way through gravity-defying challenges that'll test your wits and spatial reasoning. It's like sokoban met a zero-g playground, offering a fresh twist as you walk on walls, manipulate gravity and teleport your way to triumph. Get ready to shift your perspective and embrace a gravity all your own! it's monument valley meets sokoban If you like any of this game, you will definitely like this one. Features: ⩥ Wall walking ⩥ Teleports ⩥ Elevators ⩥ NPC's (it moves when you move) Push boxes and make your way through these mind-bending levels . But be careful where you push those box, sometime there will be no way to push them again. So think like a mastermind and find the solution. Portals are great; we all love them, but what will happen if you're stuck in an endless loop? Play and find out for yourself. Just remember to think outside the box, and solutions will come to you.

rows.name: Royale King
rows.short_description: Win and be the royal king only you! Think right and jump at the right time.. Only one can win! Be it you!
rows.description_html: Enjoy a lot of fun in this popular game where you have to face the traps and time your jump correctly. It's never been more fun to jump and run ahead of your opponents and leave them behind. Be the royal king and enjoy your victory. Avoid the chasm and water or lava. Prove that you can time your jump correctly. You don't have to be the first at the finish line, but above all to survive, and still, it's about first place. Each map is different and has a challenge for you. Are you ready to conquer the unexpected? Prove that you can handle every challenge the game has to offer. The game includes multiple maps and the option to create your own server. Invite your whole family or friends and challenge them to a duel. Be a royal king. There is only one!

rows.name: Dumball Rush
rows.short_description: Dumball Rush is an online racing party game from 2 to 8 players with a 3D third person view. The player controls a snowball that is racing against other players. Roll in the snow to be bigger and faster! Avoid obstacles and activate gifts to take advantage and win the race!
rows.description_html: Welcome to the crazy world of Dumball Rush! Get ready to hit the icy slopes in this online multiplayer party game with your friends (and even your enemies, if they dare). Join a crazy competition of 2 to 8 players , where your Dumballs, live snowballs with hilarious faces and wacky voices, are ready to fight! Take control of your Dumball and roll towards victory by avoiding obstacles and activating powers that will upset the race. It’s snow madness, and no one is immune to the craziest twists and turns! Discover thousands of completely crazy combinations by customizing your Dumball. For this you can change: Its color Its eyes Its mouth And even its voice! Make your friends jealous with the unique look of your Dumball and make sure she is the star of the tracks. Dive into frantic races, explore the Balltown Village for wild snow football matches, or get into completely frosty ice sumo fights! So, ready to hit the slopes with your friends and live Dumball's adventures? Join us in the shattered universe of Dumball Rush and we’ll be on the starting line!

rows.name: Alone in Space (by RetroVem)
rows.short_description: Explore this short 2D sci-fi adventure game with an interactive game environment, interesting plot, a score system and (at least) two endings!
rows.description_html: INTRO Explore this short sci-fi adventure game with lots of interactivity, interesting plot, a score system and (at least) two endings ;) STORY You are Alexander, the captain of the ship Santa Maria being sent out on a mission to explore the Proxima Centaury planetary system, specifically the Proxima Centauri b exoplanet. But before you would reach your destination, something goes wrong and you have to gather information about what happened while discovering more about yourself, your crew and your ship. SENSE POINTS (SP) Try to keep your mind calm and healthy: the more sense points you have, the better, if it reaches zero, you lose your sanity and the game is over. SCORE For certain actions, you gain scores and in the end, you will see how many more you could have got. Aim for the highest and check everything! CONTROLS AND OPTIONS Arrow keys or left click to move, space bar or left click to interact. Press Esc for the inventory and character screen and to save your game! To always run, press Esc and enable Always Dash in the Options! You can also set volume for sound effects, music etc. under Options. Controllers should be OK but I could only do limited testing, therefore the partial support only. MESSAGE FROM THE CREATOR This is an old project of mine, created entirely by me and now released it here. I wish I had more resources and money to make it better and prettier - please accept the game as is, expect no further updates. Originally planned to make a much larger game but quickly realized I would never finish it. So let me offer you this short but complete game, I hope despite its shortcomings, you will enjoy playing it.

rows.name: Groove that Goob
rows.short_description: Abduct the Milky Way’s Oracle Jukebox located at the top floor of a penthouse party as the shapeshifting, absorbent Goob, fully equipped with a ravenous appetite for melodies, mankind, and mosh pits.
rows.description_html: Not so long ago… The party-loving Globulons threw a rave so wild that it shattered their cherished Oracle Jukebox––the sole source of music in the Mixolydian Galaxy. To restore cosmic harmony, a lone Globulon named Goob emerges, setting its sights on abducting the Milky Way's source of sound. To do this, Goob must sneak to the top of Astral Ace’s penthouse party in a towering spacescraper. In this top-down, rhythm-stealth game, players groove their way across vibrant dance floors, evade wild partygoers, and absorb dancers to inherit their unique rhythms. Dance like Everyone's Watching Engage in rhythm-stealth gameplay, where each level unfolds a rhythmic adventure. Move consistently to the beat, and elevate your dance style by switching up rhythms through the absorption of fellow dancers. The cosmic party comes alive with Dynamic Dance-Offs, triggered when Goob slips up in front of other dancers. Prove your party prowess in these encounters by matching button inputs with precision and hopefully evading detection. An Absorbent Alien Attacks Unleash Goob's shapeshifting power by absorbing unsuspecting dancers strategically. Goob will not only copy their appearance but also their unique rhythms; use this power wisely to navigate across dangerous dance tiles with cunning and creativity. Groove that Goob invites you to a galaxy where rhythm meets stealth. Dance your way through the vibrant disco, face off in deadly dances, and absorb the essence of the party to orchestrate a cosmic comeback!

rows.name: T.I.M.E
rows.short_description: T.I.M.E is a First-Person, Arena, Boomer Shooter that pits players against each other in a one-on-one contest. Players compete in a round-based first to 3 wins system that is balanced through time rewinding set by the round loser to balance the scales of skill against strategy.
rows.description_html: T.I.M.E is a First-Person, Arena, Boomer Shooter that pits players against each other in a one-on-one contest. Players compete in a round-based first to 3 wins system that is balanced through time rewinding set by the round loser to balance the scales of skill against strategy. Disclaimer This game was a short-term project built over 4 months from scratch (Design, systems, art etc.) by 6 students learning their craft. We are proud of the experience created, and as is the nature of game development, we wish some things could be done differently, but that is life. You may find minor bugs, issues, complaints and wish some things were done differently. But we respectfully ask you to try enjoy the unique experience crafted and take it for what it is. Thank you taking the time ( heh heh heh ) to play our game and even read this. Gameplay The gameplay consists of Online/Networked 1v1 lobbies. In a best-of-five format with one life per round, eliminate your opponent 3 times, you win! However, once an opponent is beaten and the round ends, the loser gets to rewind to any point in time that has previously occurred, this is where the next round will start. Enemy flanked you last round? Rewind so it doesn't happen next time. Enemy picked up the weapon you were after? Rewind and set a trap for them. Not everything is sided for the losing player though, if you win a round, you're one step closer to victory and you also get to choose what Power Weapon is in play. The ultimate way to test pure skill, the removal of 'I would have' or 'I should have'. Now you can, no more excuses! Story T.I.M.E is set in an oppressive alternate reality of a centralized totalitarian government that has failed to succeed in its Utopian plan. Their failure has fractured their diesel-guzzling and highly industrialized society. With no way back on track to their Utopian plan and infighting set in, the top brass have decided to buy themselves some time to make amends. Their solution clouded by idealism, smog, and desperation is to rewind time to a point where they can find out where it all went wrong. With the singular goal of trying to steer the future by correcting this point of divergence. Unfortunately, no one can agree on where things went wrong and who is responsible. This results in conflict among factions of the regime, causing deeper paradoxes, alternate timelines, and crippling confusion. Thrust into the shoes of the upper echelons of the military superpower in their final days the player must deal with their opposition & their time loop. Rewind to alter the outcomes of the future and correct the past, learn from mistakes, and speculate on where this new altered future leads. Rewind until there is peace, rewind to save their Utopia! Combat Wield Diesel-fueled armaments against your former comrades to secure a future for your faction of the regime. Find and use powerups strategically, or brute force a win with a golden power weapon. Rewind Manipulate time at the end of each round, moving yourself into a better position for the next round. Create a paradox that generates new weapons and/or powerups in the combat that tip the scales to your advantage.

rows.name: The Good Plague
rows.short_description: Uncover a goofy medieval world and its offbeat humor. Choose your hero and challenge your friends and family through a diverse range of minigames in order to escape a plagued kingdom to safety. Playable in local multiplayer from 2 to 4 players.
rows.description_html: The Good Plague is a party game to have fun with friends and family, taking place in an imaginary medieval kingdom contaminated by the plague. Play as one of four characters desperately trying to flee the country : The Bard The Thief The Plague Doctor The Warrior Everyone has his own backstory, perks and disadvantages to aid during the game. In order to win, you will have to triumph over the challenges that await during this hazardous journey. The Board: The game board consists of different Points of Interest where you will have to choose where to go in order to earn some money or heal yourself. Mini-games: After each board phase, challenge your opponents in an array of minigames which defines who will play first during the next board phase. Objets: Between each board and minigames phase, you have the possibility to spend your money and buy items. These will aid in your journey or allow you to hinder your opponents.

rows.name: United Penguin Kingdom: Huddle up
rows.short_description: This free version of the United Penguin Kingdom covers the content from one year of in-game time. A city-building game where you build a penguin settlement and satisfy the various needs of your penguins while dealing with seals and killer whales.
rows.description_html: Build your settlement and satisfy the needs of your penguins with better food, elegant decorations, entertainment venues, high-tech coolers, and luxury houses while dealing with killer whales and thief seals. Design your penguin settlement Shape a settlement worthy of your penguins. Set up new energy generators to activate more houses, workplaces, and coolers. Build workplaces to produce materials, food, and medicine. Protect your settlement Build defense towers against killer whales and thief seals. Killer whales attack your buildings and try to destroy them. Seals come to the food storages to steal food. Happy and educated penguins Build some entertainment venues and let your penguins enjoy skating in the ice rinks, watching films at cinemas, playing video games in the game centers, racing in the karting tracks, exercising at gyms and in the fight clubs, visiting the museums, doing yoga, etc. Don't forget to focus on the spirituality of your penguins and increase their happiness with shrines and wishing wells. Focus on education and provide enough seats for your penguins at schools, high schools, and libraries. Make a huddle-up call to gather all your penguins and celebrate together. Focus on economy Please be careful with spending your gold and focus on finding ways to earn more. Purchase or make barter to reach rare resources, sell your products to increase wealth, and grow your settlement. If you become the king, you can use continuous trades with the help of your bazaars. Become the King Reputation score is the overall evaluation of your settlement in the kingdom. Meet the requirements, improve your reputation, and cheer up your penguins to level up from a village to a king. Become the king to explore new lands, find new settlements, and decide their joining approval to the kingdom.

rows.name: Raiders of Valhalla - Prologue
rows.short_description: Lead a fearless horde of Viking dwarves, strengthen them with legendary equipment, conquer unknown lands, and witness the colossal destruction they leave behind. How far will you be able to take your warriors? The journey to glory begins now!
rows.description_html: ' Raiders of Valhalla: Prologue ' is a free demo for ' Raiders of Valhalla '. In this sneak peek, take charge of a fearless horde of Viking dwarves as they fight valiantly for Valhalla. Fulfill the divine mission bestowed upon you and gear up for epic battles, all while relishing the chance to immerse yourself in the action and strategy that awaits you! Unlock an extensive and diverse selection of equipment, ranging from humble to legendary , and enhance each piece to its utmost potential to harness unmatched power and capabilities Build an army of dwarves with a diverse array of warrior classes , where warriors of the same class can provide group buffs, and each class possesses unique and distinct abilities that set them apart from one another!' Challenge and conquer mighty bosses of immense power ! Defeating these formidable adversaries demands not only sheer strength but also fearless warriors and strategic mastery. Conquer multiple villages nestled in incredibly wild locales! These villages come in different tiers , each offering varying challenges such as the number of enemies, formidable bosses, and unique regions to explore. MAIN FEATURES IN THIS DEMO: • Explore villages of varying levels and challenges. • Build an army of dwarves with unique abilities. • Upgrade equipment to strengthen your troops. • Confront powerful bosses to earn rewards. • Collect coins as loot after raids. • Utilize synergy among warriors of the same class. SEE WHAT AWAITS YOU IN THE FULL GAME: Core Gameplay Elements: • Dwarf Clan Management • City Invasions • Character Classes and Progression • Tactical Challenges Mechanics and Strategy: • Special Abilities and Blessings • Boss Battles • Reinforcements and Battle Strategy • Viking Ship Progression and Narrative: • Resource Gathering • Progression Manager • Story Integration Progression and Customization: • Equipment Enhancement • Legendary Weapons • Forge System • Pet Companions • Skill Tree Development And much more in the full game! Check the Raiders of Valhalla page on Steam!

rows.name: Cycle Idle RPG
rows.short_description: An RPG where your character is constantly grinding - even when you're offline!
rows.description_html: An RPG where your character fights automatically, even when you're offline! Gain levels, craft equipment, and optimize your build to face stronger enemies who'll challenge your character's power in different ways! As you advance, you'll unlock new ways to help you strengthen your character - you can focus on growing your garden of beneficial plants, growing your knowledge of monsters in the Bestiary, or creating a powerful deck in the card-based minigame! There are a dozen different subsystems you'll unlock as you advance that'll keep shaking up how you play!

rows.name: I commissioned some cats 0
rows.short_description: Play for free! I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.
rows.description_html: Recommended for you About the Game A hidden object game where you must find all the cats and wool to complete each level. Key features: 🖼️ 15 Unique artworks ❓ 1500+ Hidden objects total 🐈 750+ Cats 🧶 750+ Wool 💡 ∞ Unlimited hints if you get stuck ♻️ Restore a small number of hidden objects to a painting so you can find them again! 🎵 Music for each artwork ⌨️ Use your keyboard to move/zoom in if you have no scroll wheel 💾 3x save slots 🗑️ Reset progress entirely and play again 🕒 Timer included to show how long you took to complete each level Context: The brief was simple. I commissioned artists to create a fantasy world, and hide as many cats and wool as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 15 art pieces to choose from, you will have a lot of searching to do. Controls: Use your mouse to move around the image and zoom in / out. When you find a cat or wool, click it and it will disappear. You can also use WASD to move and the arrow keys to zoom. Difficulty: A full range of difficulty is included, but all levels start unlocked, your progress is saved as you play, and you can use hints if you get stuck. Get immersed: Each painting has its own music to help you connect with the world, as you search for everything. Replayable You can restore a small number of hidden objects back into a painting so you can find them again! It’s much harder when there are only a few hidden objects left (especially randomly). You can also use up to 3 save slots so you can replay without progress loss. Alternatively, you can reset your progress for the entire game if you’d like to start over.

rows.name: Bring Me that Shawarma
rows.short_description: A visual novel about shawarma, consisting of multiple episodes.
rows.description_html: In this visual novel you’ll find out: how dangerous white sauce can be, what humanization of shawarma looks like, whose yelling is heard on the streets of Samara at night, and what secrets hide within the kitchens of elite shawarma shops. WHERE THE STORY BEGINS... Episode 2: Fear and Loathing in Samara Gray days, work, depression... Sometimes it feels like there's nothing that can make you happy. Only shawarma can help chase away the sorrow and bring back the colors of the world. But what to do if you suddenly find out that your favorite shawarma shop is open for one final day? Episode 3: Bring Me that Shawarma Roman is an ordinary courier from not the most prestigious food delivery company. Lately, strange things have been happening in the city: animals have begun to behave differently and the people around them seem to be in a sinister conspiracy. Will our protagonist be able to deliver the shawarma and still stay alive? You can find a full description of each episode in the game. 6 MAIN AND 2 BONUS EPISODES ARE AVAILABLE NOW FEATURES An episodic visual novel within the same universe consisting of these genres: thrash, comedy, aliens, horror, thriller and some food horror/body horror High-quality anime-style graphics combined with real-life photos and environments An anxious dark atmosphere, which will be conveyed to the player through unusual sounds and visual effects Screen resolution 1440x1080 px (4:3 aspect ratio)

rows.name: EX-XDRiVER
rows.short_description: EX-XDRiVER is a futuristic arcade-style rhythm game with racing game elements. Master precise gameplay over tracks from a growing list of artists, and use drifting to your advantage to sweep the competition!
rows.description_html: In the distant future, the CYBERACE cybernetic research enterprise is holding their very first 'EX-XDRiVER Championship,' a racing championship with a priceless reward—any cybernetic enhancement that the winner desires. With such an enticing reward, contestants have traveled from around the world to compete in a high stakes, winner-take-all tournament in hopes to make their deepest desires come true. RIDE THE NEON CIRCUIT Immerse yourself in a futuristic landscape of neon, sleek raceways and an addicting high-energy soundtrack. Enjoy a track list with over 15 artists providing a wide variety of original music & licensed songs! PUSH THE LIMITS OF RACING Traditional rhythm game gameplay will be easy to learn but require mastery and practice as you tackle technical high-level tracks. Obtain 'LIMITs' from hitting notes and drifts as accurately as you can—go for perfect scores, faster finish times, and world records! HONE YOUR SKILLS, COMPETE FOR GLORY Play solo in an arcade-style credits mode to unlock songs for Free Play—or if you're feeling competitive, connect online and race against others to see who deserves the title of XDRV Champion!

rows.name: FireChess
rows.short_description: Unleash a new level of chess tactics with mages that can create fires, freeze opponents, introduce fog of war and more. Capture gold spaces to earn income which can be used to strengthen your army!
rows.description_html: FireChess is a chess-like game that includes elements of economy and spell casting. Join the discord here: Players earn a base gold each turn. They earn additional gold when occupying gold spaces. Gold can be used to purchase pieces from the shop and place them on the board. Special mage pieces can move and use abilities but cannot capture. Double-clicking on a mage allows a player to use their special ability. Fire Mage - Creates a fire in an unoccupied space. Pieces that move through fire are removed. Frost Mage - Freezes a unit. Frozen pieces cannot move or use abilities during this time. Fog Mage - Creates a 3x3 fog area. Pieces inside a fog space are invisible to opponents. Kinetic - Force a piece to move over 1 space to any unoccupied square. Waymaker - Spawns a portal tunnel. Pieces can move through the portals covering large distances. Pawns can even be promoted after moving through a portal to the last rank! Swapper - Swaps 2 pieces. These can be ally or enemy pieces. Scout - Can't capture but can't be taken either, except by kings. Scouts can clear fog and fire. This game is in active development. We are a small team and any ideas or feedback are much appreciated! You can provide feedback via email: firechessgaming@gmail.com or through our discord channel. More pieces to come!

rows.name: Methods: The Illusion Murders
rows.short_description: Detective Red July must stop a serial killer who patterns his murders after optical illusions in this mystery visual novel set in the world of Methods.
rows.description_html: Now available for free, discover a mystery story set in the world of Methods: The Detective Competition . Red July, an up-and-coming celebrity detective, is challenged by The Illusion Killer — a serial killer who patterns his murders after optical illusions. However, in the course of solving the murder, Red July's famous method — which lets her instantly solve any crime — stops working. Now the race is on to stop the killer before it's too late! The game is a mystery visual novel that lets you examine evidence with a short interactive puzzle mini-game. Featuring Interactive game Original soundtrack Dynamic Storytelling Distinctive Artwork Immersive Game World Unique DLC to Methods: The Detective Competition (100 detectives VS 100 Criminals) Playing Methods: The Detective Competition first is highly recommended, but not required to understand the story.

rows.name: Crush Link TD
rows.short_description: A Tower Defense game with new mechanics in virtual setting about online dating. Your task is to protect your base preventing spam from getting into your inbox. Build towers in marked places to stop spam.
rows.description_html: DON'T WASTE YOUR CHANCE! Your task is to protect your base preventing spam from getting into your inbox. Build towers in marked places to stop spam. Crush Link TD is an unusual Tower Defense strategy game where you will meet unexpected mobs, defeat various bosses, upgrade virtual towers, earn in-game achievements and arrange a date with your crush. STORY You have a popular profile in the Crush Link dating app and receive hundreds of messages every day. On the eve of St. Valentine's Day you find your crush. After a short chat you decide to meet tomorrow evening and agree on everything in the morning. The next morning you discover that the chat with your crush is lost among other messages. It's time to clean up all this spam. MESSAGE FROM THE DEVELOPMENT TEAM We are an international indie team with different experience, background, beliefs, and characters. The game was inspired by classics of the tower defense genre. The concept was created within a local game jam with the topic of St. Valentine’s Day. During the development process, we moved away from romance as the main theme, maintaining references to this topic, but giving preference to the interests of a wider audience, such as virtual networks and online dating. The initial idea was to give up the typical fantasy setting of the genre and bring a new twist to gameplay. That’s how mechanics of path changing and moving towers with losing one level appeared. Another feature of the game is the developing storyline. The Player is to discover a chat of two individuals who met on the dating app, liked each other, and are trying to set up a romantic date. In the texts and naming of game objects we tried to implement references to famous game titles, sitcoms, and media classics. Intentionally we filled the game with self-irony and humor but it’s up to you to judge if it worked. The title itself refers to the main objective of the game – to build a link with the Crush by deleting spam and finding their message. Finally we are proud of our visual and sound. Everything in the game is handmade by 4TEAMGB members except for avatars that were made with a third-party avatar creator engine and later edited by our artist. Neon lights are the visual core, and you can hear motives of the 80’s and notes of lo-fi and synthwave in our electronic soundtracks. We put all our love and passion into Crush Link TD and hope that you will enjoy it. Your feedback is very appreciated. Thank you! 4TEAMGB

rows.name: The Legend of Lumina
rows.short_description: A block pushing puzzle game with metroidvania style progression, set in a serene forest world.
rows.description_html: Explore an ancient forest, push blocks to solve puzzles, and search for a way to end the curse on your land. The Legend of Lumina is a sokoban style puzzle game with non-linear progression. It's inspired by early Zelda games, with an emphasis on puzzle solving instead of combat. There are ~50 areas to explore, with nearly all having puzzles, many of which can be solved in different ways.

rows.name: FairiTeller
rows.short_description: A story-based retro RPG: built upon impactful decisions, intense battles and challenging puzzles.
rows.description_html: A story-based retro RPG: built upon impactful decisions, intense battles and challenging puzzles. Every life form that dwells within this world is comprised of two halves: Yang - One's physical body, and Yin - One's life force. Over time, creatures learned to harness this life force, and developed the Five Manifests of Yin : Shroud - To envelop one's body in Yin; boosting attributes like strength, immunity, speed, etc. Create - To form a worldly item from Yin. Summon - To conjure a creature from Yin. Orient - To control the position of objects through Yin. Mutate - To change the form of one's Yin into one of the four elements. However, playing as a Fairi, you are unable to use Yin whatsoever. Instead you must overcome fights, puzzles and decisions all whilst searching for your place in this world. The road will not be easy, as the majority of the population capable of using Yin frowns upon the Fairi kind. Thankfully, a partner will soon join you, one capable of gifting the basics of Yin unto you. Both your decisions will shape the personality of the other...

rows.short_description: A 2D action and puzzle platformer where you play as a lab experiment trying to escape an evil scientist's laboratory. Fire projectiles that propel you backward to evade and fend off threats. Solve puzzles to escape the facility and save Nasu.
rows.description_html: Project Nasu is a 2D action and puzzle platformer where you play as a lab experiment trying to escape an evil scientist’s laboratory. Play as Nasu, using his snout to fire projectiles that propel you backward to evade, and fend off threats. Solve puzzles by activating platforms and deactivating lasers to ultimately escape the facility and save Nasu. Master the movement - Learn to propel yourself in all directions while simultaneously avoiding dangers. 15 unique levels - Play through 15 fun and challenging levels to test your skills. rows.name: EOS RAGNAROK
rows.short_description: Echo of Soul is a free-to-play Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Game with a fast-paced action combat, various character customizations and no subscription fee required. Travel the vast open world, compete in PvP modes, and explore EoS.
rows.description_html: The Twisted Dimensions lurk beyond mortal perception and defy common comprehension. Multi realms exist atop one another, bleeding energies across shared boundaries, and threatening to tear each other apart. Only the Gods can even comprehend the nature of this threat, and only the Soulkeepers, those chosen by the Goddess Frigg, can stand against it. The Frigga Union of Soulkeepers, hitherto tasked with persuit of the vile Naez, now work to research and unravel the paradox of the Twisted Dimensions before this mass of shattered realms consumes itself. They discovered that Naez originates from the Soul of Agony. The original task of the Soulkeepers was to seek out the taint of the corrupted blood of the Primal Giants, enemies of the Gods, and return the Giants to the Soul Stream. Thus would the world remain in balance. Naez used the power of Soul of Agony to direct the extracted souls into herself instead of the Soul Stream. Thus, the flow of souls was disrupted, and the boundaries between the worlds weakened. To counter the damage inflicted by Naez, Souls of Chaos must be gathered and delivered to the Soul Stream. The Frigga Union is focused on this task, holding the doom of the world at bay, until the time comes to attack the threat at its source…

rows.name: Pestilence
rows.short_description: Pestilence is a first-person stealth game in which you play as the Lord of the Pestilence, a betrayed God who seeks revenge against his brothers. Make use of your uncanny abilities to infiltrate this Spanish inspired city and infect their leaders.
rows.description_html: Pestilence is a first-person stealth game in which you play as the Lord of the Pestilence, a betrayed God who seeks revenge against his brothers. To accomplish this, you will need to kill your brothers' Judges , the ruling caste of the city of Trumana. You will traverse the town's shadows as a malevolent force, using your uncanny ability to possess and sow chaos between its people. FEATURES Find your next host Take advantage of your possession powers to infiltrate Trumana's souls, becoming the puppeteer of their destiny. Each citizen has access to certain locations depending on their archetype. Infiltrate and reclaim what is yours Experience heart-pounding stealth gameplay where you use a diverse set of abilities to outsmart your siblings' relentless followers. Create distractions with the infection, scan your surroundings with the pulse, get into hard-to-reach areas by teleporting. Combine these skills to find new ways to overcome each situation. Find how your legacy has changed Play as the villain and delve into the depths of Trumana's dark past, where ancient conflicts and sibling rivalries shape the present. This game is a university project by videogame students at U-tad.

rows.name: Fairytale Fables
rows.short_description: Dive into a fantastical autobattler where fairytales and legends collide! Choose your hero and assemble your team of characters, items and treasures to outwit opponents in strategic battles where positioning matters. Will you be the last one standing in this enchanted PvP arena?
rows.description_html: Dive into a fantastical autobattler where fairytales and legends collide! Choose your hero and assemble your team of characters, items and treasures to outwit opponents in strategic battles where positioning matters. Will you be the last one standing in this enchanted PvP arena? Strategic Gameplay Choose your Hero carefully at the start of each game, as each Hero plays differently. Earn gold to buy characters and items, cast spells and find treasures in the Shop Phase, then watch your choices come to life in automatic fights. Level up to find even more powerful characters and spells in your shops. Match 3 Find three copies of a character to forge a stronger version and gain a potent treasure of their level. Master this core mechanic to dominate in this strategic turn-based autobattler set in a mythical realm. The right treasure can tip the scales in your favor! Replayability Spice up the game with the Chaos Queue, featuring random rule-changes like dual heroes or expanded boards for massive replayability. Set your own rules in Custom Games and battle it out with up to 100 players!

rows.name: Prophan Escape
rows.short_description: In Prophan Escape you have to get five coper statues which are in random places around a labirynth to complete each level, it's that simple... Oh, yeah, there are also two antropomorphic weird cubes with realistic extremities that want to kill you, so you will have to avoid that weird guys.
rows.description_html: INFORMATION ABOUT THE GAME: DESCRIPTION: 'Prophan Escape' is a game that combines horror with an absurd sense of humor. Imagine the typical game about 'The Backrooms', and now imagine that, with the same horror aura, but full of shitpost... That is Prophan Escape. GAMEPLAY: In 'Prophan Escape,' your objective is to collect five copper statues scattered throughout a labyrinth to complete each level. It's that simple... Well, there are also two anthropomorphic, peculiar cubes with realistic limbs that are out to get you. So, you'll need to avoid these strange characters. After completing each level, you will receive a 'tartortilla,' a peculiar food item that reveals a piece of the game's lore. PLOT: 'You have just awoken in a strange place that looks like a labyrinth but you have no idea of how you got there. The only thing you know is that you must find your way out, and quickly.' FEATURES -Immersive 90s VHS atmosphere. -Simple mechanics. -Approximately 2 hours of gameplay. -A thrilling lore behind the game. -5 levels (including a tutorial). -Tense horror gameplay. -Challenging labyrinths. -Silly comedy and humor. -And also sexy legs.

rows.name: Goblet of Mercy
rows.short_description: A short interactive dark fantasy story in which you meet an egomaniacal empress and must try to survive the encounter through the choices you make.
rows.description_html: “It is said that her ego has its own country...” Story Goblet of Mercy is a short interactive dark fantasy tale about your encounter with a woman whose ego is so big she made her own perfect world to contain it. It began with Halloween, a time when the veil between worlds is thin. Your friend Judy invited you out to a themed party at the local library. A Halloween event, a good friend, a lot of weird books for sale. Judy might have been in a shifty mood, but there was no need to worry. Really. What could go wrong? Features Short (30-45 min, average reading speed) Vampires Certain... details ... change in second and third playthroughs 4 Endings Ending variations based on player choices Choices matter Animated hand-painted characters More off the wall at times than scary, with elements of psychological horror

rows.name: Rumble Club
rows.short_description: Punch your friends for free! Battle solo or squad up in clumsy chaos across an ever-changing slate of game modes with up to 20 players.
rows.description_html: Don’t Fall. Don’t Stumble. RUMBLE! Enter the Rumble Club arena, a hilarious physics-based multiplayer Battle Royale. Grab your squad, or charge into the slapstick arena solo against 19 other players. Punch, push, throw, and bait your opponents—and maybe your friends, too… Fly in on Captain Punch’s Sky Yacht, get bopped into the arena, and find powerful and ridiculous Gadgets to battle with. With constantly changing game modes, get ready to mix it up with your friends, from eating cupcakes to being the last Punchie standing. But not everything is winning. You’ll also want to look good while doing it. PHYSICS FUN FOR EVERYONE! Send foes flying with a well-timed haymaker. Got them down for the count? Throw them into the goop to finish them off. Just watch out for that massive wrecking ball swinging right towards you! BRING A GADGET TO A FISTFIGHT! Not all battles are won with your fists. Find silly gadgets on the battlefield for an advantage. Boombox? Punch Tank? A Giant Menacing Magic Donut? Try them all! LOOK GOOD, PUNCH GOOD! Collect and choose between tons of cosmetics. Fancy a Tuxedo? Wizard Hat? Mankini? Or maybe that hat with the safari flaps—I’m sure you can pull it off. GAME MODES GALORE! New game modes and arenas are added each season and mixed up daily! Dive into each one solo or with friends and battle to be the true champion of the arena! RUMBLE WITH YOUR FRIENDS! Message your friends and meet them on the battleground. Work together to complete fun Quests to earn rewards and unlock exclusive cosmetics!

rows.name: Wonder Ball
rows.short_description: An action 3D platformer with fast-paced gameplay and low-poly style graphics, inspired by the greatest classics of the genre. Full of platforming levels, combat arenas, many collectibles and secrets. Explore five worlds of Cyberland and save them from the malicious Virus and its army of bots!
rows.description_html: Main features Explore Cyberland : Discover five worlds packed with platforming levels, combat arenas, and secrets. Collectibles & Upgrades : Gather coins, gems, and microchips to upgrade Wonder Ball's abilities. Customizable Gameplay : Adjust settings, including compass markers, camera, and controls. Time Attack & Survival Mode : Unlock arcade modes with online leaderboards. Achievements & Stats : Earn achievements that add extra challenges and goals. Optimized for Handheld : Play on devices like the Steam Deck with full controller support. Enhanced Visuals : Features FSR, DLSS, and DLAA support for improved performance and graphics. Story Peaceful worlds of Cyberland are under attack by the malicious Virus and its army of bots! Now it’s up to you to take control of Wonder Ball and save Cyberland before it’s too late! Core Gameplay Many of the greatest classics of the platforming genre are filled with crates or some other blocks to destroy. Wonder Ball stays true to this beloved mechanic and gives players multiple options on how to deal with crates. You can dash, slam, or use Wonder Ball’s attack ability to destroy them! Explore Cyberland Wonder Ball is an action-packed 3D platformer where you explore five worlds of Cyberland. Every world is essentially a massive hub, full of platforming levels, combat arenas, many collectibles, and secrets. Choose your level of exploring at the start of the game or change it anytime during gameplay by customizing markers shown on the compass. Or turn the compass off completely and become a true explorer! Every hub is filled with numerous collectibles of different kinds. Collecting coins will help you get extra repair kits and gems will grant you extra shields which will become vital while fighting in combat arenas. Collected microchips can be used to upgrade Wonder Ball’s abilities and become a real threat to the Virus and its bots. Combat Arenas Battle against an army of bots spawned by the Virus in combat arenas of increasing difficulty and earn all the medals! Platforming Levels Challenges built to test your platforming skills with an optional reward for destroying all crates. Time Attack & Survival Mode As you progress through the game's main story mode, you will unlock two arcade modes featuring online leaderboards. Challenge yourself to achieve the best time on all platforming levels in Time Attack mode, or battle through waves of bots in Survival mode to get the highest score across all combat tiers. Customize your game experience Wonder Ball offers a variety of gameplay settings. You can customize the compass, camera, key bindings, and all sorts of graphics settings as well. My game also comes equipped with support for FSR, DLSS, and DLAA. Note: The performance improvement gained from upscaling technology may vary depending on the hardware used.

rows.name: Traders and Tricksters
rows.short_description: An online multiplayer board game with a twist: Gather all the cards or trick others into getting fake cards.
rows.description_html: Traders and Tricksters is an online multiplayer board game. The goal of this game is to gather the 10 numerical cards (from 1 to 10) to get the highest score by trading your duplicate cards. However there are Trickster(s) among players which can offer fake cards that are not tradable and have negative points. After the round is complete, you'll get to guess and vote for the Trickster(s) among you to redeem your lost points. After multiple rounds, whoever reaches the max score will win the game.

rows.short_description: take the role of spider guy and escape the cheese place!

rows.name: Mazes and Labyrinths
rows.short_description: Mazes and Labyrinths is a single screen puzzle game set in the fantasy world of Antinomia. Use your wits, powers, and even the enemies themselves to solve over 70 deceptively difficult mazes, or create your own levels and puzzles to challenge your friends.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Mazes and Labyrinths, a deceptively difficult single screen puzzle game set in the fantasy world of Antinomia. Play as Will and Ari as you battle the prophet Sybilla and the invading Omniety, an alien being reshaping the planet to its whims. Use your wits, powers, and even the enemies themselves to find an exit to every maze and save Antinomia and its people from certain destruction. Created by OnlineVideoSurfer, Mazes and Labyrinths features over 70 puzzles in the main campaign plus a robust level editor to make and play your own levels. For more dedicated players, most levels also feature a bonus medal to truly test your ability to break the game. The goal is an almost arcade-puzzle experience, with short, bite-sized levels and simple graphics that nevertheless disguise deeply complex, rule-based design. Learning the intricacies of the powerups, the enemies, and the full implications of your abilities is essential to both mastering the campaign and making your own mazes for others. There are no pay to win mechanics, no in-game currencies, nor any other monetization features to diminish the game. This is a free game made by one person for anyone that wants challenging yet thoughtful puzzles or desires to make their own levels. Persevere and overcome the challenges and you will hopefully find a rewarding puzzle game that, by the endgame, will push your reasoning to its limits. For everyone that tries, I wish you luck.

rows.name: Nonogram Nights
rows.short_description: Nonogram Nights is a spooky puzzler where you use logic to uncover a mysterious picture.
rows.description_html: NONOGRAM NIGHTS is a spooky puzzler where you use logic to uncover a mysterious picture. A nonogram, also known as a picross or griddler, involves using number clues to reveal a hidden picture in a grid of squares. The numbers along the side indicate how many consecutively shaded squares appear in each row or column. Solving the puzzle slowly unveils a mysterious image, but watch out—the pictures are spooky! Every NONOGRAM NIGHTS puzzle is uniquely solvable, so you never have to guess for a solution. Explore a haunted mansion in adventure mode . Solve 20+ spooky puzzles to defeat the monsters that lurk around every corner. In random mode , you can play an infinite number of (solvable!) puzzles that are different each time. The game also features a quick tutorial, an options menu, and some secrets! This game is completely free. It has no ads.

rows.name: Party PooperZ
rows.short_description: Party Pooperz is an awesome chaotic partygame, where you compete against your friends. The fate of tonight's party theme rests on your shoulders, steal guests and use items to make your party the most popular. Let the battle for the most legendary party begin!
rows.description_html: About this game Party Pooperz is an awesome chaotic party game, where you compete against your friends. The fate of tonight’s party theme rests on your shoulders, steal guests and use items to make your party the most popular. Let the battle for the most legendary party begin! Donna, Matt, John and Molly live together and have decided to throw an epic party, one that their friends will remember forever. However, there’s a slight problem - they can’t settle on the music genre for the party. They have a really big fight about what’s the coolest choice. Is Donna correct with her preference for disco, or perhaps Molly, who’s a big fan of DnB, is onto something? Or could John be right, and jazz is the way to go? In this game, you and your friends get to decide the best music genre together! Settle the battle by hosting competing parties in the same room at the same time. Use a pizza item to lure party guests to your party, or throw a bottle to make your friend a little dizzy ;). Or… you can simply throw the party guests to your party and just force them into liking your party! Can you ‘throw’ the biggest party? Pick Up and Play This game is designed for everyone to enjoy. You only need to use two buttons: a button to move and a button to throw party people, pick up, and use items! This way, even people who don't often play games can join in. Choose Your Music Genre Party Pooperz is a game that explores the question of the best music genre. What music genres do your friends like? Disco, hip hop, jazz, or something wilder? Choose your favorite and throw the best party! Throw a party by throwing people! In this game, you can throw people to your party and let others see which party they would enjoy the most. Whack-a-Friend In Party Pooperz, it's not just about partying – it's about a good-natured brawl! Got a buddy you're dying to give a playful wallop? Wield a guitar or a candy stick and spread some party cheer right across their noggin. Use Items Sabotage other players using various items. Use a matras to defend yourself from other players. Be strategic to make the most of this item! What's a party without pizza? Use the pizza item to attract people to your party. Make other players too dizzy to control their movements with the bottle item. Throw it at other players to use it. Use the water pistol to shoot away other players from your party or to bring party people to your party. Put on some good shoes and dance all night long. These shoes make you move a lot quicker!

rows.name: CyVenge
rows.short_description: CyVenge is a fast paced and action packed rougelite arena shooter. Choose from many upgradable weapons and abilities and help Cy fight against numerous waves of enemies!
rows.description_html: Welcome to the intergalactic battleground! Immerse yourself in a sci-fi setting where waves of relentless robots, known as Xul'Gorgs, threaten the galaxy. As a member of the Intergalactic Peacemaker, your mission is clear: survive endless waves, defeat mini-bosses, confront the ultimate end boss, and emerge victorious. Arena Shooter Dynamics: Engage in fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled combat as you navigate through different arenas, facing the hordes of Xul'Gorgs. The gameplay is centered around defeating enemies with epic guns and helpful abilities. Gain strength through failure and return stronger on your next run to defeat the endboss. Protagonist - Cy: Take control of Cy, a skilled operative from the Intergalactic Peacemaker. Customize Cy's loadout by choosing from a wide array of weapons and abilities, each offering unique advantages to suit your preferred playstyle. Randomized Items: Keep each playthrough fresh and unpredictable with a pool of 60 different items. Adapt your strategy on the fly by randomly acquiring items during your journey, enhancing your arsenal and augmenting Cy's capabilities. Boss Battles: Confront powerful mini-bosses and a formidable end boss, each presenting unique challenges. Your skills will be put to the test as you progress through increasingly difficult encounters. Difficulty Settings: Tailor the experience to your skill level with 6 difficulty tiers. Whether you're a seasoned veteran or a newcomer looking for a challenge, find the right balance to keep the gameplay exciting and rewarding. Furthermore you can in- or decrease specific parts of the game with modificators to gain more or less EXP and Money. Early Access Focus: In Early Access, we aim to refine and expand upon these core mechanics based on player feedback. Your insights will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of this rogue-lite arena shooter, ensuring an engaging and ever-evolving experience for all players. Join us in the battle against the Xul'Gorgs and help us make this intergalactic adventure truly unforgettable!

rows.name: Niwa - Japanese Garden Simulator
rows.short_description: Niwa - Japanese Garden Simulator is a gardening simulator that gives you the freedom to design your own zen gardens. Set in Kyoto, Japan, you are tasked with learning authentic Japanese gardening techniques and applying them to realistic reproductions of historical locations in the city.
rows.description_html: Niwa - Japanese Garden Simulator is a gardening simulator set in Kyoto, Japan, the birthplace of zen gardens. By playing Niwa - Japanese Garden Simulator you will learn authentic Japanese gardening techniques and how to apply them to realistic reproductions of historical locations in the city. You will learn the basic elements of traditional garden composition: stones, plants and water. Then use these techniques to create your own gardens. Learn from a master As a new apprentice to a famous gardening company, you will be tasked with creating, repairing and updating public and private gardens. Each level has a number of tasks for you to complete where you will gain unique skills and insightful knowledge about these special locations. Experience various kinds of gardens There are a large variety of Japanese garden types, and your work will bring you to each of them: dry gardens, temple gardens, tsubo-niwas, tea gardens and moss gardens. Feast your eyes The Visual aspect is important to enjoying Japanese gardens. The game also includes a photo mode, which allows you to take photographs of your garden creations and share them with friends. Niwa - Japanese Garden Simulator attempts to simulate as closely as possible the true look of plants, stones and the surroundings so that photos come out looking like the real thing. Relax amongst the soothing landscapes Escape from your urban life and find refuge amongst nature. Unwind and discover the calming ambiance of your garden.

rows.name: Betrayal Beach
rows.short_description: Crashed on a strange island, survivors must forage, craft, and complete objectives to stay alive. But ferocious beasts, harsh weather, and secret saboteurs seek to make sure they never escape. Betray your friends or survive the island in Betrayal Beach, a 4-8 player social deduction survival game.
rows.description_html: Betrayal Beach is an online social deduction survival game for 4-8 players. Crash landed on a strange island, a group of survivors must work together to survive long enough for rescue to come. However, 1-2 players are working as saboteurs. Blending in with the survivors of the crash, their goal is to make sure none leave the island alive. Collect resource cards to contribute to objectives or keep yourself alive. Craft useful gear, such as spears to fend off animal attacks or a basket to carry more resources. Manage your health, hunger, and limited inventory space. Deliberate with fellow survivors and vote to exile the saboteur from camp. Play as 3 unique roles with extra abilities. Blend in with the survivors to gain their trust. Sabotage objectives to stall the survivors' progress and put them in danger. Unleash Suffering by activating strange totems and opening mysterious caches. Lie , deceive, betray, and sow chaos! Play as 2 unique roles with extra abilities. Each day is separated into timed phases. Forage during the day and deliberate exile at night. Vote to exile possible saboteurs and throw them into a volcano. Built-in voice and text chat to communicate with fellow survivors or saboteurs. Choose your character's look from a variety of styles. Unlock seat cosmetics through achievements. More to come!

rows.name: Archery Showdown
rows.short_description: Archery Showdown is a local PvP platformer where you can challange with your friends in an archery-balistic 2D fighting!
rows.description_html: Who Will Be the Archer Master? Archery Showdown is a classic 2D pixel art platformer where you can challange with your friends in an archery-balistic 2D fighting! * GAMEPAD IS REQUIRED FOR LOCAL PVP! The Game Archery Showdown tests your aim in an epic duel to the last arrow! Grab your bow, tighten the string and get ready to fire! In this exciting 1vs1 game, you will be thrown into a breathtaking arena, where you and your opponent will compete in thrilling archery duels. Challenge yourself in breathtaking environments, from mysterious forests to medieval dungeons and much more. Test your archery skills as you aim and shoot arrows with precision. The target is your opponent, and the objective is only one: to hit him before he does the same! It will be a test of skill, reactivity and cold blood. Archery Showdown is a challenging experience suitable for players of all ages, with pixelart graphics, intuitive controls and ever-changing challenges. Whether you're a newbie or an arc veteran, this game will captivate you from start to finish. Features Play online with Steam Remote Play! 2D platformer in a cute pixel art world! Archery balistic shooting with arrows and powerups. Vast set of arenas to compete. Play with gamepad or keyboard.

Lovecraft and by The Tell-Tale Heart of Edgar Allan Poe, where we play the role of a skittish doctor chosen by the cult of Delator to be the last sacrifice. Instead of running away, you must find the heart of Delator and end your nightmares before they end up consuming you. Explore and unravel the secrets of this town through puzzles and don't let the enemies get to you with the help of your lamp. *Hide from the gaze of Delator Hide from the cosmic entity making use of stealth to keep moving forward with your sanity intact. *Hallucinations Enter a different plane of reality to engage in intricate puzzles and where everything is how it used to be.

Fight your way to riches by slaying foes, obtaining/combining unique abilities and finding forgotten treasures.
rows.description_html: As a power hungry adventurer you set out to the forgotten dungeons to test both your might and your luck. Treacherous enemies, dangerous traps and ever changing dungeon floors are all out to stop you in your tracks. Do you have what it takes to make it out alive again and again? The dungeons are full of loot, enemies and greedy shopkeepers. Gather enough wealth to acquire stronger weapons and abilities to take on harder dungeons with even better loot. Key features: Dynamically generated dungeons Different objectives for dungeon floors Fight over 8 different enemies! Slay your foes with over 10 unique weapons! Mix and match special abilities! Secret rooms, if you have a keen eye Grow stronger by completing sequences of dungeon floors without dying Perish and lose everything you have gained, be careful!

rows.name: Pelagos: A Marine Adventure
rows.short_description: Dive into Pelagos: Snap, Learn & Explore Marine Ecosystems!
rows.description_html: Dive deep into the mesmerizing world of Pelagos! Crafted with Unity 3D, this marine photography game takes you on a tranquil journey through the enchanting California Kelp Forests. You'll be swimming through the debut level, surrounded by the unique flora and fauna of this vibrant biome. As you explore, you'll have the chance to photograph a myriad of marine creatures. And here's the cool part: every time you snap a photo, you'll learn the name of the organism and save it in your very own in-game gallery. Whether it's a playful sea otter or the towering kelp canopies, every shot you take adds to your collection. But 'Pelagos' isn't just about capturing the beauty of the marine world. As you navigate the kelp forests, you'll stumble upon discarded trash—a stark reminder of the pollution threatening these pristine waters. Your mission? Photograph all the hidden trash. It's not just about cleaning up; there's a special surprise waiting for you once you capture it all! And if you think you've seen it all, think again! Replay the levels to discover new angles, hidden species, and secret spots. And keep an eye out—the Great Barrier Reef level is coming soon! So, are you ready to dive in, learn, and make a difference? It's a 'gotta photograph 'em all' kind of adventure in Pelagos!

rows.name: Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters
rows.short_description: Experience the award-winning space saga. Travel to hyperspace, discover alien worlds, and meet an eclectic cast of characters. Find out what happened after the Ur-Quan invasion. And if the war still rages, fight for Earth and the Alliance of Free Stars!
rows.description_html: You are the captain Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters ® is a classic space game that captures the charm of retro science-fiction, space combat, and high adventure. Your story begins as the captain of the last human starship, with Earth trapped under a hostile forcefield. You are the last hope for humanity in a fight for control of the galaxy, as you explore thousands of unknown worlds and get dozens of quirky aliens to help. Meet fascinating alien characters ​The galaxy is thriving with alien species, each with unique mysteries and motives. Meet an eclectic cast of characters, brought to life with full English voiceover. Ask sharp questions, make new friends, and exchange colorful insults. Adventure through HyperSpace Discover a vibrant galaxy filled with wonder, terror, and absurdity. Explore thousands of uncharted worlds across hundreds of stars, and gather important resources and technology. Battle your rivals in starship combat Build your fleet and battle enemy starships, facing off against friends or the computer-controlled AI. Play action-packed Super Melee as its own mode, or as part of the single-player adventure – or choose automated combat to stay focused on the story. Experience a sci-fi classic – for free! As a celebrated piece of gaming history, Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters ® has also received wide acclaim for its story, characters, and setting. It was created as a love letter to classic science fiction like Douglas Adams, David Brin, and Jack Vance. In turn, its setting inspired a new wave of game creators, including the visionaries behind Mass Effect , No Man’s Sky , Subnautica , Starfield , Fallout , and Stellaris – to name just a few. In 2002, the game was released under an open source license thanks to the generosity of Paul Reiche and Fred Ford. It continues to be available to play as a free download, for game historians and fans to enjoy. Game features Experience an open-world adventure, venturing through space to defeat the invading Ur-Quan and its hierarchy of battle thralls. Travel through extra-dimensional HyperSpace and discover nearly 500 unknown star systems filled with alien worlds. Fight enemies in fast-paced space battles with 25 different starships, each with its own unique attacks and powers. Befriend, threaten, or fight a diverse cast of aliens with unique personalities, from scary, to funny, to just plain weird. Explore thousands of planets, collecting resources and technology to upgrade your flagship and grow your fleet. Play standalone Super Melee to practice space combat against AI opponents or to duel against a friend. Mod and tinker with freely available, open-source code and content.

rows.name: The Holyburn Witches
rows.short_description: Collect enough firewood during the day to build a bonfire at night. If it goes out, the witches come. Can you endure enough days and nights to survive the Holyburn Witches?
rows.description_html: A pure survival-horror experience, featuring real panoramic photographs that capture the fear and solitude of being alone in a haunted forest. The thick atmosphere will crawl under your skin, and every nerve-wracking moment will leave you desperate for escape. In the once tranquil village of Holyburn, Maine, a series of horrific incidents left scars that still linger. Unexplained sounds and sightings haunt the desolate forests near this derelict town. Can you survive to unravel the mystery steeped in a history of ritualistic horrors?

rows.short_description: A stealth horror survival game
rows.description_html: A stealth horror survival game, that takes place on the alien planet, Aviar. Use your 'eyes' to navigate your way through the dark forest, avoiding the other entities. Make your great escape, if you can...

rows.name: Aimcademy
rows.short_description: Aimcademy is a science-based aim trainer. The combination of sport science and gaming leads to the most efficient way of training in gaming. Unleash your true potential!
rows.description_html: Aimcademy is a science-based aim trainer which combines gaming with sport science! This leads to the most efficient way of training by embracing variation and personalization instead of repetition and cookie-cutter tasks. Train in the most efficient way by using the power of science! Use our innovative technique-training to improve your aiming skills. We introduce variety in the way you play in order to increase the learning speed. Always train in your personal sweet spot where the task is not too hard and not too easy. Make the most progress in the least amount of time with a training tailored to you. Monthly challenges let you compete and compare against your friends and the world. Show What You Are Made Of!

rows.name: Killmaiden
rows.short_description: A fast paced singleplayer arena shooter. Choose one of three goals to win each stage, try different maidens and defeat 10 bosses on the way to meet the devil on stage 66. What's the highest score you can reach?
rows.description_html: Fight your way through 66 levels. Choose one of three goals in each level: Defend yourself until the entire map is purified Destroy all enemy portals Find the key and escape Kill all ten bosses on your way to meet the devil himself. Each boss has a more or less complex level. Find out how you can beat them. Choose from 39 skills, organized into three main groups and three additional weapon groups to upgrade them. Each difficulty has its own Steam leader board, see if you can break the high score and reach the top.

rows.name: STEAMRUSH
rows.short_description: STEAMRUSH is a third-person Boss Rush game featuring fast-paced melee combat against unique bosses, punctuated by exploration segments that gradually unveil the captivating story of the isolated city-state of Haze.
rows.description_html: Fast-Paced Melee Combat: Engage in intense melee combat that keeps your heart racing. Quick reflexes and expertly timed slashes, parries, jumps and dodges are essential as you face challenging foes. Strategic Parrying: Master the art of parrying to gain the upper hand in battles. Perfecting this skill is your ticket to success in STEAMRUSH's combat system. Diverse Boss Fights: Battle formidable bosses, each with their own unique combat mechanics. Adapt your approach and come up with winning strategies to defeat these challenging adversaries. Discover the Story: Explore the city and find collectibles that shed light on Haze's mysterious narrative. These hidden gems provide insight into the city's secrets and add depth to your gaming experience. STEAMRUSH promises an exciting blend of action, strategy, and storytelling, all within the intriguing backdrop of Haze. Will you complete your mission to uncover the city's mysteries and conquer its dangerous inhabitants? Steamrush is part of the Big Ones, an initiative of AIV - Accademia Italiana Videogiochi aimed at adding a production experience to the teaching carried out in the various courses, from the creation of the game concept to commercial publishing. The objective of the Big Ones is to give students the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues from other courses in the development of a video game project in which everyone can put the skills acquired during the lessons to the test and at the same time perfect their soft skills.
