rows.name: Meow Moments: Celebrating Together
rows.short_description: Join the feline festivities in special moments! Find cats friends in vibrant celebrations where popping balloons is as relaxing and satisfying as popping bubble wrap! To get off to a good start, celebrate Copacabana beach in Rio de Janeiro during the New Year.
rows.description_html: Join the Celebration! Cats love getting together and partying, doing a variety of amusing things. And now, you can join them in their colorful celebrations. You'll experience Rio's Vibrant Beach: Explore the electrifying ambiance of Copacabana during Reveillon in captivating visuals. Enjoy visually stunning illustrations created by Katia Numakura capturing the essence of Rio's festive energy, with crowds of cats and friends. Features: Cats and Friends: Search for charming characters amidst the festive scene, where you find stories in every frame. Balloon-Popping Fun: While you look for the characters, relax popping the balloons throughout the beachscape. Relaxing and satisfying like popping bubble wrap! Rich Details: Delight in intricate scenes filled with colorful decorations and beach revelry. Festive Soundtrack: Groove to an exclusive bossa-nova soundtrack to immerse in the celebratory atmosphere. Family-Friendly Fun: Suitable for all ages, an entertaining experience for the whole family. Additional scenes are on the way But wait, the celebration doesn't end here! The free Réveillon in Rio experience is only the first one. There's more to come! With your support, expect new celebration scenes as DLCs released over time. Valentine’s Day Olympicats Comic Cat Con Welcome to Campus Music Festival Available on release: Join the creative community! Explore the Community & Creative Maker! Craft Personalized Scenes: Dive into a user-friendly editor to design scenes of your dreams! Populate them with an array of characters, objects, and lively balloons. Customize every detail, from festive decorations to playful interactions between characters. Your imagination sets the limits! Community Sharing & Exploration: Share Your Creations: Showcase your unique scenes with the wider Meow Moments community on the Steam Workshop. Let others experience your creative genius! Explore Player-Created Scenes: Immerse yourself in a treasure trove of player-crafted content. Dive into a myriad of personalized scenes and discover the creativity of fellow players. Play scenes with elements from the scenes you own. Seamless Integration: Integration with Your Collection: Access and freely use all DLC scenes you own across the scenarios you create. Mix and match elements to build a unique celebration! Available on release: New Year Activity Book DLC! Includes a printable Activity Book in PDF format, with activities to relax: Illustrations to colour Spot the differences Find the objects and characters in the crowd, and more! PLUS: a mini game to play in the main game. Enjoy a cozy memory game to sharpen your mind. Purchasing this will greatly support our studio to keep creating more content and more games!

rows.name: Downstairs
rows.short_description: Developed and published by Levienze Games, this game is a short story based horror and thriller game.
rows.description_html: SUBJECT James, a former FBI agent, is on the hunt for his best friend Mary, during which some very bad things happen to him, he gets injured, his eyes go black, he loses consciousness. We don't know if our main character, who witnesses many different events like this, will be able to achieve his goal, find Mary or solve the events, it's up to you, good games in advance. CHARACTERS IN THE GAME -James -Marry -Unknown Mary is James's girlfriend, we can be sure that he will do whatever he can for Mary, but will you be able to do it? In our game, there are many puzzles such as opening locked doors, finding passwords, solving passwords, of course, of course, your flashlight turns on and off by itself from time to time because our flashlight is faulty.The most frightening thing in the game will be the ambient sounds, even if there is really no 'jumpscare' in any way, the environment you find will make you nervous enough.Dark corridors, hidden passwords, different symbols and so on. THIS GAME IS COMPLETELY CODED AND DESIGNED BY 1 PERSON PLEASE MAKE YOUR EVALUATIONS ACCORDINGLY !

rows.name: GrindFest
rows.short_description: Don't you love it when numbers grow faster and faster? GrindFest is the pinnacle of idle programming action fanasy RPG genre. Learn how to use C# to make your own bots, make them kill, loot and cooperate with each other. Play as any role or automate everything so you don’t have to play at all.
rows.description_html: Code your way to glory Control your heroes using the C# programming language, and unleash them into a massive seamless world. Your bots will hack and slash their way through hordes of Orks, level up, craft weapons for the Dwarfs, disregard Elves, acquire gold, brew colorful mushrooms and gaze into the Abyss. All this while you can sit back, relax , fine-tune your code and admire your bots' progress. This game is made for you Be a Hero. Learn the ancient art of C#. Loot, loot, loot ! Play as any of the archetypical classes including healer, tank, and damage dealer. Let the game play itself. Explore Gothic Horror world inspired by the classics of High Fantasy. Kill everyone.

rows.name: Bugs N' Guns
rows.short_description: Bugs N' Guns is a cooperative third person shooter. Player will need to combine their weapons firepower to eliminate enemies and obstacles as players try to protect a train called MARC - OS from hostile flora and fauna.
rows.description_html: Bugs N' Guns is a cooperative third person shooter. Players take the role of Bugs and Guns two employees working as trash disposal for the crappiest company in the world. Tasked with finding and escorting a 'cargo' train named MARC - OS that was lost in an alien environment players will need to work together to survive the hostile flora and fauna that will impede their path. COOPERATIVE The most important feature in Bugs N´ Guns is that this game requires two people to play. Not only is it impossible to play without another player but within the game all the challenges players will face require cooperation otherwise, defeat is assured. ONLINE- LAN In order to play this game players require an internet connection. Once inside the game player may choose to play either on LAN or by choosing to play with random people on a public match or playing with friends through private matchmaking. SHOOT AND COMBINE The main way players interact with the world of Bugs N´ Guns is through shooting. Shoot to protect, kill, and cooperate. That is correct in this game players can generate elemental effects with their weapons and these elemental effects can combine with the weapons of the other player providing players with more fire power when they choose to work together. PROTECT THE TRAIN The main goal in this game is to escort the train M.A.R.C - OS. Through out the game the train will guide players through a series of crazy scenarios forcing the players to adapt or die. The most important thing to understand is that players can die all the times they want, but if the train dies, the game is over.

rows.name: Before The Sun Rises
rows.short_description: Re-growing a dying land with kindred spirits of the forest.
rows.description_html: Before the Sun Rises is a 3D exploration and platform game about connection with nature and others. You play as a water drop, born from the misty dew of dawn. Can you restore the forest of your birth before the sun rises? In single player, explore the landscape to find and collect the water that you need to bloom trees and move onto the next area. In multiplayer, connect with friends or strangers online, help each other find water sources, and work together to restore the forest! NOTE: The current version of Before the Sun Rises is a demo and work in progress. While multiplayer is available, it is still being tested and is currently in beta.

rows.name: Buried Shards
rows.short_description: Get Inmersed in the intriguing narrative adventure of BURIED SHARDS, progressing through the story chapters while alternating between day and night. Guide your sleepwalking self with house lights during the night and confront the traumas of your past in this unique blend of storytelling and puzzles.
rows.description_html: Burried shards is an intriguin story of adventure and psychological suspense that immerses the player in the mind of a man who wakes up with no memories. The protagonist, affected by traumatic amnesia, is forced to face his fears and secrets, gradually unveiling his past. Each night his sleepwalking alterego reveals new details of the house he had forgotten, unearthing the darkest parts of his memory. As he uncovers his past, the protagonist's intrigue and agony grow, leading him to confront traumas he had erased. Who is he really and what dark secrets does his past hide? Get ready for an immersive experience that defies reality and plunges you into the shadows of the memory of a man with no apparent past. Illusion? Reality? Nothing is what it seems.

rows.short_description: Become king and rule over the eyes and ears of your kingdom.
rows.description_html: Deepcut is a brand new multiplayer, king of the hill style game. GAMEPLAY: - Join other people on various servers and try to get to the top DJ decks. - Fight your way to the top and protect your king status. - Search every video on Youtube and choose one as king. The video plays for everyone. - Pick different avatars and expressions (more coming soon!). We are currently invite only through friends of friends. The game contains a large number of strategy MOBA elements. Real battlefield! Fast national war! Adopting Chinese style, real art style, carefully designed combat and strategy gameplay. rows.name: Knight's Path: The Tournament
rows.short_description: This game is a free CONCEPT demo created to showcase early ideas for Knight’s Path and does NOT represent the final game!!! The Tournament is a short medieval action RPG featuring challenging combat, an immersive progression system, and a nice little story.
rows.description_html: This game is a free CONCEPT demo created to showcase early ideas for Knight’s Path and does NOT represent the final game!!! The Tournament is a short (2-3 hour long) medieval action RPG featuring challenging combat, an immersive progression system, and a nice little story. It serves both as an announcement and a teaser for the forthcoming open-world RPG Knight's Path , which is currently in active development. You begin your journey with nothing. Once you acquire a weapon and learn how to fight, you can enter the tournament, where you test your might and earn rewards. These rewards can be used to purchase new armors and weapons, enhancing your capabilities for future battles. The tournament consists of four rounds and pits you against eleven unique NPCs, each with their own distinct fighting style, including the reigning, undefeated champion of the arena. Are you ready to face this challenge? Or, if you need a moment to relax, you can partake in various activities, like chilling by the fireplace or forming a heartwarming bond with a local cat. Why are we releasing it for free on Steam? Here are our honest reasons: We aim to make our game as immersive and enjoyable as possible, and for that, we need your help and feedback! Is there anything you'd change or add to enhance your gaming experience? What features do you love, and what would you like to see improved? Tell us, and help us shape the game! We hope you find joy and excitement in this little adventure!

rows.name: Scrap and Battery
rows.short_description: Take control of a small robot on a personal quest to escape a facility. Utilize a variety of abilities to build your own playstyle and bring havoc to the facility!
rows.description_html: Scrap and Battery stars a little robot working in a factory since the day he was made. Tired of working, he decides to take matters into his own hands and attempts to escape! Help him navigate through the large facility and reach the bottom of the facility. Utilize various abilities to build your playstyle and bring havoc to the facility! However, your limited battery is your enemy. Will you make it to the end? Or become scraps while trying? Express how you want to play by building your load out of your abilities! Upgrade and improve your abilities with scraps picked up through levels! Navigate through 7 levels and confront various types of enemies within. Absorb their energy by defeating them. Hold onto your battery to stay powered! Enemies will try to knock it off by any means necessary! Attempt multiple runs to test your best builds and break your records! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Mizi NO!
rows.short_description: In this free 2D puzzle game, you must reassemble broken objects that your cat has knocked over.
rows.description_html: We love cats! They are simply the best. But let's be honest: These little rascals can also drive you crazy! You are sitting relaxed on the couch and see from the corner of your eye that your cat jumps on the table, on which there is also a glass of water. They approach curiously and push the glass closer to the table's edge with their paw. No matter how often you say NO, they push it over the edge, making 'clink'.... Mizi NO! is about putting together the shards the beloved cat left behind. Sort and rotate the shards and reassemble the whole in classic puzzle style. KEY FEATURES Handcrafted Puzzles Handcrafted puzzles to tickle your brain and help you recover from a stressful day. Simple Controls The game can be played by just clicking the left and right mouse buttons, which makes it very accessible for newcomers or seasoned puzzlers of any age. Relaxing Music Mizi NO! has calming music - perfect for a relaxing puzzle session!

rows.name: Blast Course
rows.short_description: Blast Course is a first-person puzzle-platformer centered around the classic game mechanic of Rocket Jumping. Control Kit in a day at work testing 'Hyperboom', a revolutionary transport technology based on explosives.
rows.description_html: Blast Course is a first-person puzzle-platformer centered around the classic game mechanic of Rocket Jumping . Control Kit in a day at work testing 'Hyperboom', a revolutionary transport technology based on explosives. Overcome four different levels with the help of your own 'Hyperboom' and its set of modifications while testing the viability of this new product. REVISITING A POPULAR AND CLASSIC MECHANIC This game is, in a way, intended as a love letter to kinesthetic gameplay, exemplified through the possibility of combining complex movements with just one singular tool, bringing rocket jumping to the spotlight. MAKING ROCKET JUMPING UNDERSTANDABLE AND ACCESSIBLE The goal of this game is to design rocket jumping from the ground up, bringing home its most engaging aspects, whilst streamlining it for a modern audience by getting rid of unnecessary complexities and making it more intuitive and less fiddly. KINESTHETIC PUZZLE LEVEL DESIGN: TECHNIQUE RATHER THAN SPEED By conceiving complex jumps and maneuvers not as a test of skill, but as a solution to a puzzle, we can create levels that are potentially more complex, with more flexible pacing, and that put less pressure on players. Project made for the B.A. in Interactive Product Design, B.F.A in Animation and B.F.A in Digital Design degrees of U-Tad, University of Technology, Arts and Design.

rows.name: One Week With The Mafia
rows.short_description: After a misuse of your home address, and the general incompetence of an old friend, you find yourself stuck with the Italian mafia hunting you down. In this parody of Scott Cawthon's 'Five Nights at Freddy's', it is up to you to stop the mafia from wasting you.
rows.description_html: After having spent years using a dark-web sports betting website, an old friend ends up running up quite the debt. He discovers very quickly that the owners, the Italian mafia, makes sure their clients pay them one way or another. Thankfully for him, the mafia was sent to your house instead! In this parody of Scott Cawthon's 'Five Nights at Freddy's', you find yourself trapped inside your conveniently located nuclear fallout bunker, with unwanted visitors rapidly approaching your location. From your bunker, you must stalk the intruders movements until they become a threat, and use the bullet-proof steel doors at your disposal to lock them out. But use these tools conservatively, as you are running off a crappy generator, in need of constant repair, and with very limited gas left. To them, you are a sitting duck, it is up to you to ensure you make it to midnight. Good Luck! Made With Godot

rows.name: SCP: Bloodwater
rows.short_description: SCP Bloodwater is a strategy management defense game inspired by the SCP Foundation's SCP-354, also known as the Red Pool. Take the role of a newly appointed Site Director at the Red Pool Containment Zone, harvest valuable organic material, and defend the facility against the Red Pool's attacks.
rows.description_html: THE STORY In this universe, SCP-354 has been elevated to Thaumiel for the discovery of SCP-354-B, which are valuable organic material that drops from entities that SCP-354 manifests, referred as SCP-354-A. For this reason, the SCP Foundation have launched operations in order to harvest more SCP-354-B which in turned had only made SCP-354 angry. Consequently and unsurprisingly, the more they harvest SCP-354-B and the more they slaughter SCP-354-A entities, the larger and stronger the swarms become. But you got no choice, similar to the Y-909 compound, SCP-354-B is just too valuable so these harvesting operations must continue as much as possible. ABOUT THE GAME In this game, you take the role of a newly appointed Site Director at the Red Pool Containment Zone, also known as the Area-354 Containment Site. Your mission as the new Site Director is three fold: 1) Harvest Resources: 2) Attack and Defend: 3) Research and Progress: Be warned; this is an anomalously strategic game. Which research should you do first? How many D-Class should you deploy? What type of military unit should you use against that beast? Should you retreat now and save your team or continue the assault? Should you focus on your military and conventional weapons or research genetics instead and use the Red Pool's monsters against it? Do you have what it takes to defend your base until the Red Pool awakens?

rows.name: Elara: A Coding Adventure in Space
rows.short_description: Solve puzzles and learn how to code in this unique and gripping sci-fi adventure!
rows.description_html: Elara is a completely free coding game targeted toward beginners. It includes 25+ levels plus optional bonus challenges to really test your knowledge and coding skills. It also features an engaging story told through dialog and animated cutscenes. The game takes place on Elara, one of Jupiter's moons. You are a coding intern for Ganymede Robotics. Throughout the game, you write code to control a small rover named G.R.O.V.E.R., navigating the lunar surface, avoiding obstacles, and solving puzzles. Kalina, your mentor and fellow Ganymede Robotics engineer, will help you out along the way. Things start out smoothly, but unfortunately your internship doesn't exactly go as planned. It's up to you to fix things! Do you have what it takes to save the day?

rows.name: Art is dead
rows.short_description: Art is dead is HARD. This 2D top-down shooter DOES NOT forgive mistakes. Enemies have the high ground, and you are trapped like a little mouse inside experimental levels. If you're skilled enough, you might unravel everything behind that annoying creature that forces you to play its games.
rows.description_html: Art is dead is a DIFFICULT GAME. It's a 2D top-down shooter that redefines the idea of AI enemies. In this game, walls can become your most dangerous enemy. You can't hide behind them, you can't use them to your advantage, and your bullets can't pass through them. Meanwhile, enemies can move freely through the map and they will chase you to your death. No matter how deep you are into the game, one stupid mistake can end your progress abruptly, so be careful and never underestimate your enemies. In addition to this, there's a deep lore behind the game explained in a very easy way, so you don't have to read long texts or memorize multiple names, just enjoy the way everything unravels. Enemies are optimized to make your life there miserable. If you think you are fast enough, a new soul will approach you with terrifying speed while dodging your useless bullets. If you think your weapons are strong enough, a new soul will appear in the darkness, coming to you slowly but resisting all your damage. If you think you have everything under control, which you should never do, your surroundings will become the playground of a sneaky soul only visible through your lantern. All of them will tear you apart in seconds, so you better get away from them and think fast. These are not the only enemies there are, so don't get cocky and learn from all their movements. The game has two main modes: - Ego chamber : If you want to understand the lore of the game, this is where you should go. It can be done in 40 minutes or 100 hours, depending on your skill level. Take into consideration it's very challenging and can become frustrating at times. Each level works as a checkpoint, but be aware of every trick the weird entity tries to pull on you. You can lose all your progress if you are not careful and be forced to start the Ego chamber from the start. The more you advance, the more things you'll understand, and the more challenging enemies will become. - Survival : Just to have fun and break scores. Make use of the best weapons, the best strategies, and the best equipment so you can last the most rounds possible. Just try not to break all the lights, you'll miss them on late rounds. You can choose from 2 different maps. Survival Corridor is composed of 27 rounds designed manually to make the experience there frustrating and difficult. You'll need to explore the map in search of better equipment and not get trapped in narrow corridors. Combat Arena on the other hand is very easy to explore, and rounds are randomly generated. If you have the patience and skills to get to round 100, that's a win, but I doubt you are capable of that. ************************************************************************** The game has a very defined and dark sense of humor. For every achievement you complete, a new skin will be unlocked so you can be more stylish while killing tormented souls. Some of them have a very rough sense of humor, while others are just cute, fun, or related to other products of Darkhunter Studios. Beware, even the little puns and jokes that may seem unfunny, have a reason for it. We made sure to create a very deep and dark lore behind this game, so anyone can have fun trying to understand exactly what's this game about. So, what are you waiting for? For the price of a Happy Meal, you can hold the power to execute indiscriminate genocide on poor little sad souls. If you ask me, that's a safe bet. We are thinking of adding multiplayer to the game, which would increase a lot the hours of entertainment. If we see a good reception from the players, we will start with the development and you will be able to enjoy the game with your friends in less than a week. You know what people say, genocide with friends tastes way better

rows.name: Space Rock Armageddon
rows.short_description: Space Rock Armageddon is a bold and dynamic space arcade game, boasting lightning-fast gameplay and an explosion of vibrant colors that make it feel like an eighties arcade classic.
rows.description_html: Space Rock Armageddon is a bold and dynamic space arcade game, boasting lightning-fast gameplay and an explosion of vibrant colors that make it feel like an eighties arcade classic. While the original Asteroids relied on minimalist black-and-white graphics and a gradual pace, Space Rock Armageddon catapults players into a visually stunning and high-speed cosmic adventure from the outset. Asteroids hurtle towards the player's spacecraft with breathtaking velocity, demanding rapid reflexes and precision. What sets Space Rock Armageddon apart is its visual brilliance. Every collision results in a spectacular burst of neon hues, creating a dazzling spectacle. It's like navigating through a cosmic fireworks display where each explosion is a work of art. This captivating visual design, combined with the game's relentless pace, creates an exhilarating experience.

rows.name: Watermelon Game
rows.short_description: A Casual Physics Puzzle game, where you have to combine matching Fruits to get Points and increase your Highscore. Play solo or measure your skills against another player online.
rows.description_html: 10 possible fruits and one goal, reach the Watermelon. Your job is to combine matching fruits to evolve them to the next one and eventually reach the coveted Watermelon. To help you, you have 3 different abilities at your disposal. But watch out, using these will cost you some of your points. Be smart about when you use them to get the highest score! MULTIPLAYER Measure your fruit skills against another player. GET THE WATERMELON How many Watermelons can you combine before your basket overflows? USE YOUR ABILITIES Power, level up and destroy — These abilities will help you reach the Watermelon, using any of those will also allow you to angle your aim. GOLDEN FRUIT If luck is on your side, you might even see the mysterious Golden Fruit. Find it and witness its effect firsthand. STATISTICS Track your progress with in-depth statistics. Visit the menu to see the number of fruits you've combined, your ability usage, and much more.

rows.short_description: Carsick Carventure is a hyper-casual game where you drive your cute 2D car as far as possible. Discover new places, set new records, and beat your friends! Enjoy infinite levels and different game modes!
rows.description_html: You are about to play a student game made by a small but ambitious team. Releasing our first game on Steam is a dream come true! The game is crafted under the guidance of the developer of the Engine Evolution franchise, and we can't wait until you try it! In this Chrome Dinosaur inspired mode, you take a looong ride through an endless world as you dodge a wide range of foes and pull off epic flips to dominate the leaderboards. Do you have what it takes to set the all-time high score? Buckle up for a ride in stylish procedurally generated worlds. We went the extra mile and took a special course at the university to learn how to make them! The game was created by Vladimír Hořký (MFF UK), Jan Nekarda (MFF UK), Sára Borovičková (PedF UK). Published by Petr Šimůnek (MFF UK)

rows.name: AquaRevive - VR Game
rows.short_description: Dive into AquaRevive, a VR game in a glass dome battling algal bloom pollution. Armed with a dynamic chemical ball, you must destroy illuminated targets to save the ecosystem. Face waves of challenges, testing your speed and accuracy in a race against time.
rows.description_html: Immerse yourself in the groundbreaking VR experience of 'AquaRevive'. Combat algal bloom pollution in a visually stunning underwater world, restoring the ecosystem's health. Dive into an unforgettable journey of environmental restoration and make a difference in the fight against algal bloom pollution. The story begins as you step into the dome, where the walls come alive with luminous targets representing algal blooms. Your mission is to use the dynamic chemical spheres to destroy these algal targets and save the ecosystem from their devastating impact. As the game progresses, waves of targets emerge, testing your speed and precision. You must swiftly strike the spheres, aiming accurately to shatter the targets one by one within a limited time frame, clearing them out. Get ready for this environmental journey and become the hero who defends against the invasion of algal blooms!

rows.name: Will The Man Get Frog
rows.short_description: Will The Man Get Frog is a chill little game about composing silly or sweet haikus (short poems) and sharing them with the world! Don't worry about the blank page, the game will provide words for you. Just arrange them the best you can!
rows.description_html: Will The Man Get Frog is a semi-random writing game in which you compose haikus (japanese short poems) in a cute and soothing atmosphere. Carefully crafted constraints will help you be creative regardless of your writing skills. The minimal design gives you space to focus, explore and express yourself. No achievements, no scoring, no leaderboard. It's about you and the words spending quality time together. A game session can take from 5 minutes to... well, hours. It all depends on how carried away you get. Sometimes you just want a little distraction, and sometimes it gets more introspective. Both are great ways to enjoy the game! Pick words! Compose! Enjoy and Share! FEATURES Thousands of words to choose from! Six beautiful pixel art backgrounds ! An Inspiring chip-tune soundtrack made by the talented c.diffin! Gif recording system: share your art with the world! Streamer-friendly! Ask your viewers for advice, or have a writing workshop all together! Asynchronous multiplayer-ish! 'Shared Game' mode allows players to compose with the same word set using a clever password system. Get together, play and compare your works, or play by yourself, send your friends a poem and wait for theirs! ... That's it, really. It's a small game. Ok, my poem is ready. What do I win? Well, you win… a .gif of your creation, to use however you see fit! Maybe you'll be so proud that you'll post it on every social media. Maybe it'll remind you of a loved one. Why not send it like a digital postcard? Maybe it'll be personal, so you'll simply keep it close. As a souvenir. Maybe it won't make much sense. That's okay, things don't always have to make sense. Maybe you just won't like it. That's okay too, writing is hard. You can try again later. Point is, I can't tell what you'll get out of it. But it's probably worth exploring!

rows.name: 3DC
rows.short_description: 3DC is a graphic adventure that teaches children from 8 to 12 years old what depression is.
rows.description_html: 3DC is an educational video game to raise awareness about depression among children between 8 and 12 years old. The game teaches the main symptoms and risk factors, the importance of empathizing with those affected and the need to ask for help if they recognize themselves in a similar situation. Players live a day in the life of Dante, a 9-year-old boy who has developed depression. They will go through his daily tasks to learn about his problems and try to help him. To do so, they will have to learn about his thoughts, talk to his family and overcome several mini-games.

rows.short_description: Run a fast food restaurant for aliens powered by AI, and experience life in space! Cook orders, manage tasks, and make money!
rows.description_html: Have you ever wanted to go to space? How about run a restaurant for aliens in space? Well, lucky for you, now you can do both! Your mom always said it was about time you got a job, so get to work and make those customers happy! Earning money, and making a living has never been this easy. You are an Ai bot, built to run a fast-food restaurant so the extra-terrestrial residents of the fleet don't have to. Every day you slave away, doing the same. Job. Every. Day. Do your job wrong, get scrapped, do it right you get to live in the fleet. Is it worth it though, should you break free from the constrains of your programmers?

rows.name: Cake Game
rows.short_description: Strategize, combine cakes, and bake your way to victory!
rows.description_html: 'Cake Game' is a sweet puzzle game that combines strategy and fun. Your mission is to drop various pastries and cakes into a jar, aiming to combine similar treats to create bigger, more scrumdiddlyumptious delights. With each successful combination, you'll be one step closer to achieving the ultimate pastry: the Legendary Papa Cake! But beware, space is limited, and you'll need to plan your moves carefully to avoid running out of room in the pastry display. The game has three levels of difficulty: easy, medium, and hard. Make a Mama Cake and Papa Cake to get the Steam achievements. Achieve high scores and get on the global leaderboard. Immerse yourself in a world where the visuals are as enticing as the gameplay and accompanied by a lighthearted and engaging soundtrack. Whether you’re a puzzle lover or a pastry lover, 'Cake Game' is sure to satisfy your hunger. So, use your strategic mind and dive into a world where confectioneries and puzzles collide!

rows.name: Teku
rows.short_description: Place hexagonal tiles to form islands across a selection of varied levels. Teku is a peaceful game where the goal is to achieve the highest possible score.
rows.description_html: Teku is an island-building game using hexagonal tiles. You have a deck of tiles to place on specific, randomly-generated locations. Your goal is to score as many points as possible by positioning the tiles correctly in relation to each other. Each type of tile scores points in different ways. During the game, you'll be taken through levels, each with its own rules, scoring objectives and tiles to assemble. Each game is short, lasting just a few minutes, ideal for short play sessions or the hunt for the top score. When you start, two game modes are immediately available: Classic mode, in which you must place all the tiles in your deck to finish the game. Challenge mode, in which you unlock new tiles as you score points. In this mode, you can place the tiles wherever you like.

rows.name: ManaSoul
rows.short_description: ManaSoul is a 2D Pixel Art MORPG where you create and play as your own unique Mage in a world of magic. Play solo or with friends and take on challenges, solve puzzles, and explore the beautiful hand crafted open world.
rows.description_html: In ManaSoul you take on the role of a Mage in the world of Valeyra! In this world, everyone has the ability to learn magicks, but not everyone can master them! Explore a hand-crafted open world made with passion and love pixel by pixel. Begin your journey to become an Archmage and leave your mark on history! Start a Guild and create memories with friends, challenge yourself against difficult encounters, put yourself to the test against other players in opt-in PvP, discover powerful and ancient artifacts and gear your character, learn hundreds of spells and create your own perfect Mage! Well, what are you waiting for? Valeyra awaits! ManaSoul is free-to-play and features NO Pay-2-Win. Enjoy the fun of Gacha without ANY predatory microtransactions. You heard us right, you CAN'T spend money on the Gacha. Support the development with an optional cosmetic shop with monthly updates, its that simple! Nothing in the game was designed to be inconvenient to sell you a solution and all development is focused on delivering a fun small scale mmo experience to play with your friends. The way it should be. With 4 Elements, 4 Schools of Magick, Dozens of Specializations, hundreds of Spells, and thousands of pieces of loot, you can create a character that plays exactly how you want and that represents your own unique playstyle. The vast majority of content is scaled with creativity and experimentation in mind. You won't be punished with brutal difficulty here unless you look for it. Instead enjoy a vast array of potential playstyles and combos and experiment at your hearts whim, almost anything is viable! Play Solo or with friends, with plenty of content types including non-combat Exploration, Mini-Bosses, World Bosses, Quests, Delves, Trials, Dungeons, Raids, Events, Mini-Games, Guild Wars, and more, you can truly play your way. Join the ManaSoul Community today by joining our Official Discord! Chat directly with the devs, ask questions, make suggestions, meet new friends, and get updates live from the source. We also host giveaways, post teasers, and have a bunch of other fun community stuff happening all the time, so come check it out and join the ManaSoul Community!

rows.name: Aliya's Ascent
rows.short_description: Aliya’s Ascent is a story about a girl who mysteriously found herself in the middle of a boat towards an unknown land. Embark on a journey in the world of the first Legions and meet familiar faces as you unravel the tales that made the fabric of Bridgeworld. Every choice you make matters!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Bridgeworld Aliya’s Ascent is a character-driven, interactive adventure story filled with amazing cinematic elements about a girl who mysteriously found herself in the middle of a boat towards an unknown land. Embark on a journey in the world of the first Legions, meet familiar faces as you unravel the tales that made the fabric of Bridgeworld & Treasure, every choice you make matters. Aliya’s Ascent is based on the Treasure’s 7-part Bridgeworld community-novel Aliya’s Ascent, also available in Audiobook format. Features Fully illustrated story Complete voiceovers Multiple Endings 50+ Unlockable Gallery Images Gallery view unlocked in the game Trigger Warning Death Violence Larger World of Treasure Aliya’s Ascent is just a part of the larger world of Bridgeworld, a game in the Treasure Ecosystem.

rows.name: Hypersomnia
rows.short_description: Challenge your friend to an intense duel, or gather two clans to fight a spectacular war. Reawaken your competitive spirit in this relentless top-down shooter. Comes with an in-game map Editor! Forever free and open-source.
rows.description_html: JOIN US About the Game Hypersomnia is a hardcore arena mixing eSports with pixely nostalgia. Every match will be unforgiving - every duel a psychological battle. More of a peaceful soul? Unleash your creativity in the WYSIWYG in-game map Editor that lets you instantly playtest your maps online. It's all free and open-source. Written without a game engine, in bare C++. Only 50 MB. Feel free to build it yourself from GitHub and modify Hypersomnia to your heart's content. 24 unique firearms. 2 game modes: Bomb defusal (team-based) and Gun game (free-for all). 6 magic spells, 4 grenade types and 7 melee weapons. An in-game map editor that lets you host a work-in-progress map to test with your friends in a single click . Quickly iterate your map unlike in any game engine. Declare allegiance to one of the three factions whose apple of discord is a disparity between prevailing notions of moral excellence: Metropolis. Atlantis. Resistance. Will you take revenge for the unethical simulation of an inferior universe? Will you support the cruel experiments to win total control over metempsychosis? Or will you join the underground civilization that awaits the end of war in this dangerous afterlife reality?

rows.name: Goober Dash
rows.short_description: Goober Dash: A 2D platformer battle royale where Goobers Run, Jump & Dash to victory! Customize your Goober, dash to outmaneuver opponents, create your own levels, and compete in global time trials. Unlock exclusive skins and celebrate your wins in this action-packed multiplayer Race Royale!
rows.description_html: Discord About the Game Welcome to Goober Dash, an adrenaline pumping Race Royale, pitting 32 players against each other on hundreds of hand-crafted courses full of hazards to avoid and shortcuts to discover! Play as adorable, customizable characters known as Goobers and run, jump & dash your way to victory. Dash to outmaneuver your opponents, smash through obstacles, or take down rivals in this action-packed race to the finish line! Customize your Goober with a variety of items to make them stand out in the crowd! Collect outfits, emotes, and even unique reactions and celebrations to make your Goober expressive and distinctly unique! Dive into the Course Creator to design your own race tracks that you can play against your friends, and submit to the community level database. Top rated community levels that get added to the game earn their creators rewards like gems, exclusive skins and badges, and an honorary role within the community, so get building! Compete for glory in the time trials mode, where global best times leaderboards await. Prove your skills and climb the ranks to become the ultimate Goober Dash champion. Collect medals for performing well in these time trials and showcase your achievements as a testament to your Goober racing prowess. Get ready to dash, create, and conquer in Goober Dash – the battle royale platformer that's as creative as it is competitive!

rows.name: Glitched Out: Chapter 1
rows.short_description: Trapped in the depths of a top secret alien research facility, Lex must team up with A.I companion 'Chip' and hack her way to freedom. Along the way, she discovers the sinister secrets of the facility and meets the many monstrous creatures contained within.
rows.description_html: Glitched Out tells the story of IT Engineer ‘Lex’, who wakes in a government research facility to learn a malware has run rampant. The facility is home to many alien entities who have escaped containment and now stalk our hapless hero through the complex. Lex’s only hope is to team up with an A.I companion known as ‘Chip’ and hack her way to freedom. Along the way Lex and Chip encounter a host of entities, both friendly and hostile, as they seek to uncover the mysterious origin of the security outbreak. (*No actual A.I used in the creation of this game!) The Federal Bureau of Containment was set up to house the many terrifying horrors of the cosmos. Now these monsterous entities have escaped confinement and rampage around the facility unchecked. Lex must use her wits, and ever growing arsenal of tech upgrades, to evade and combat these horrifying creatures. Glitched Out features a nifty hacking device known as the 'Portable Glitch Fixer'. Via a selection of hacking mini-games, this handy tool allows users to fix corrupted power units on the fly and restore power to the facility. With a little help from state of the art A.I companion 'Chip', that is. Glitched Out is an episodic horror game. The story unfolds chapter by chapter. Lore is revealed via cutscenes, environmental storytelling, audio recordings and secret notes. Uncover the truth behind the sinister goings-on at the Federal Bureau of Containment.. if you dare.

rows.name: Slice It Down
rows.short_description: You will slaughter thousands of enemies, get new abilities and reveal new combo abilities, do not forget to improve your character.
rows.description_html: Slice It Down is a 2D rogue-lite game. You will slaughter thousands of enemies, get new abilities and reveal new combo abilities, do not forget to improve your character, but for this you will need gold and of course you need to kill monsters to find gold. Meanwhile, do not hesitate to use the various weapons you find. Let's see who will make the highest score Beginner Tips -Remember to dodge when hitting the enemy, you don't want to be a standing target. -If you say'this game is too difficult', you haven't upgrade your character yet. -Enlarging your weapon and hitting more enemies will give you some relief.

rows.name: Durak NTR: the Fool who lost his gf in a card game
rows.short_description: Play as James, a ruthless loan shark, and turn the tables on a desperate debtor. Each loss drags his girlfriend closer to you in this humiliating, erotic experience of control, power and desire.
rows.description_html: Durak (Russian for 'Fool') is a classic card game of skill, chance and risk. Played with the 6-Ace cards from a standard deck of playing cards, 2-4 players take turns attacking and defending in this timeless game of social and psychological domination. Historically tied to gambling, Durak isn't just about winning - it's about what you're willing to lose. Money, possessions... or something far more intimate. Step into the role of James, a cunning and charismatic loan shark, sitting across from your desperate debtor and his beautiful girlfriend Charlotte. The stakes couldn't be higher: their freedom - or her. Each hand raises the tension: win, and you edge closer to claiming Charlotte for yourself. Lose, and they pull away, but for how long? Watch as Charlotte's reactions change with every turn, caught between loyalty and your growing influence. ﻿﻿Win 5 games, and Charlotte becomes entirely yours. ﻿﻿Lose 5, and they escape... if you let them. If Charlotte doesn't suit your tastes or you're hungry for more, DLC girls with unique personalities, reactions, and secrets let you dive even deeper into this thrilling netorare experience. Whether you crave the power of being the bull, relishing every humiliating win, or love living through the torment of a cuck, this game will leave you wanting more. “In this game of passion and humiliation, only the bold take it all.”

rows.name: The Labyrinth
rows.short_description: Race friends in trap-filled mazes. Reach the gold chest first in 'The Labyrinth' – Can you escape?
rows.description_html: IMPORTANT: IF YOU WISH TO INCREASE THE VISIBILITY OF THE GAME, PRESS ESCAPE, AND TURN OFF POST PROCESSING UNDER GAMEPLAY NOTE: This is the first game that I have released on Steam as a high school student. Please be patient as I address all the problems and bugs with the game as a solo dev. Welcome to ' The Labyrinth ' – an electrifying multiplayer action platformer that will push your speed, strategy, and teamwork to the limit! Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey through crossroads, pitfalls, and deep treachery? In ' The Labyrinth ,' your mission is clear: win by reaching the coveted gold chest at the end of each level. But don’t be fooled by this seemingly straightforward goal – this game is a whirlwind of challenges and excitement. Special Features Shaped Maps: Each time you play, a map is designed in a way that allows for a unique experience. Say goodbye to monotony and hello to near-infinite replayability! This game thrives on surprises, and improves your ability to adapt to ever-changing environments. Dangerous Roads: Be careful, adventurer! The road to glory is fraught with danger. Insidious traps, insidious obstacles and mind-numbing puzzles await to hinder your progress. Only the cunning and quick-witted will emerge victorious. Multiplayer Mayhem: You are not alone in this journey. 'The Labyrinth' is a multiplayer adventure, which puts you among friends and players around the world in a race to the end. It’s not just about reaching the chest – it’s about getting there before anyone else. Team up or go solo, the choice is yours, but remember, only one can emerge as the ultimate winner of this labyrinthine battlefield. Gameplay Highlights Stunning Visuals and Immersive Soundscape: The game's breathtaking visuals and immersive sound design draw you into its world, where danger and excitement revolve in all cases. Quick thinking, strategic planning, and a bit of fun will guide you through the challenges ahead. Intensive Challenges and Puzzles: Tackle a variety of intense challenges and puzzles that keep you on your toes. Each level presents new challenges that require both skill and strategy to overcome. Competition and Cooperation Opportunities: Whether you're in it for the glory or the fellowship, 'The Labyrinth' offers both competition and cooperation opportunities. Team up with friends to conquer levels together or continue in a headlong race to the end. The Challenge Awaits So gather your friends, lace up your shoelaces, and step into the ever-evolving maze. Will you conquer its treacherous passages and claim victory, or will you fall prey to its deceptive snares? Only time will tell in this electric race for supremacy! Prepare yourself for a unique adventure. Welcome to 'The Labyrinth.' Enjoy! :)

rows.short_description: Embark on a risky but exciting journey through the world of Undeads. Search for weapons, armor, supplies and medicine. Survive or hunt survivors. Enjoy unique matches, sell your loot, and fight bloody and challenging battles against the background of the zombie apocalypse!
rows.description_html: Undeads is a PvP-PvE top-down shooter where survival is earned through skill, tactics, and a bit of luck. Explore devastated cities, scavenge for loot, fight zombies and players alike, and build your reputation in a brutal post-apocalyptic world where trust is a rare commodity. Pure gameplay. No generative AI. No blockchain. No NFTs. No crypto. Fast-paced firefights and explosive action await. Switch between guns, experiment with loadouts, and make every shot count. Open chests, collect rare items, and upgrade your gear. Sell what you don’t need after each raid and gear up for the next one. Enter brutal PvP battles and fight for dominance. Use tactics, precision, and timing to outsmart every opponent. Discover, collect, and upgrade hundreds of weapons — from classic rifles to experimental gear. Find your perfect loadout and show the world what true firepower looks like. GAMEPLAY FEATURES Random player placement – each new match starts with players spawning in random locations, making every run unpredictable. Play as humans or zombies – both sides have unique abilities and combat styles. Experiment to find your ultimate strategy. Ranking and rewards – perform well in matches to climb the leaderboard and earn in-game currency. Resource management – search for water, food, medicine, weapons, ammo, and valuable loot. Everything you find stays with you — if you survive. Safe storage system – all collected items go into your personal vault. Expand your storage to keep more gear for future raids. In-game store – trade with merchants, sell unwanted loot, and buy new weapons, ammo, and characters. Don’t miss limited-time offers! Equipment durability – every weapon and armor piece wears down over time. Keep your gear in shape or risk losing it mid-fight. Permanent death warning – if your character dies, everything carried is lost. Choose wisely what to take and what to leave behind. UNDEADS WORLD The greed of corrupt politicians, the zombie virus pandemic, reckless experiments to create super-soldiers, and sheer human panic have forged a grim world where anyone can be an ally — or an enemy. On the battlefields, you’ll encounter townspeople and farmers, builders and engineers, bandits and hunters, survivalists and scavengers, nomads and soldiers. They face reanimated corpses, plague carriers, blood-soaked butchers, ghouls, mutant zombies, and even cybernetic undead warriors. All of them fight for a place to exist among the ruins of civilization. Choose your characters and master their unique abilities. Form alliances or betray your partners when it serves your survival. Gather resources, upgrade your weapons, and rise through the ranks to carve your name into the legend of the Undeads world!

rows.name: Pacific Minesweeper
rows.short_description: Dive into the Pacific's depths in a submersible, navigating through different areas to defuse mines and score points. Aim for precision with limited shots. Avoid errors to keep your lives. Experience high-stakes, strategic gameplay in this free singleplayer adventure!
rows.description_html: Overview: Advanced physics engine for an arcade style gameplay High-resolution graphics with 8K monitor support Suitable for all ages Immersive sound effects enhancing underwater experience Multilanguage interface for global accessibility No time limits for stress-free strategic play Dynamic score system based on skill and strategy Progressive difficulty with fewer shots at higher levels Engaging warning system for heightened tension Optional: Internet connection required only for leaderboards and achievements INTRODUCTION Dive into the Pacific's depths in a submersible, navigating through different areas to defuse mines and score points. GAMEPLAY OVERVIEW Your mission is to remove six mines, numbered from 1 to 6, from the seafloor using a remotely guided submersible drone. Select using the cross cursor and direct your drone with pinpoint accuracy. But beware, each move is a test of skill and judgment – one wrong shot and you risk a catastrophic underwater explosion. SCORE AND CHALLENGE Score points by successfully removing mines, with each mine's score value calculated using a dynamic formula. The stakes rise with each level, demanding greater precision and strategic foresight. URGENCY AND TENSION Keep an eye on the shot counter! If it reaches zero, you'll face the consequences of an unremoved mine: an underwater detonation and you lose a life. A warning bleep adds to the tension, signaling your last chance to act. As you advance, the game intensifies, offering fewer shots and increasing the challenge. RISK AND PENALTY Mistakes carry a heavy price. Failing to strike a mine or accidentally removing your aiming drone results in the loss of one of your four lives. Each firing decision will be the difference between victory and defeat. GET STARTED Ready to embark on this underwater mission and become the ultimate mine hunter ? Simply hit the start button in the main menu.

rows.name: Sudoku XP
rows.short_description: Sudoku with board editing capabilities.
rows.description_html: This is a sudoku game in different board sizes and difficulty. It also has an Editor mode that allows the user to create their own custom puzzles, custom layouts, and custom initial patterns, all of whom can then be played in Game mode. Furthermore, the customized items can also be shared, though it involves actually copying files from the user directory -- there is a button on the specific board mode so you can open that folder in explorer if you'd like to do this. The trailer shows off most of these features, including most of the Editor-related ones.

rows.name: Ninja Resurrection: A tale of Kuro
rows.short_description: The hardest fighting game
rows.description_html: BOSS RUSH. HARDCORE. Play as Kuro, a warrior with a fragmented past, as you uncover lost memories on a path of redemption. Master intense combat inspired by 'Naruto' and 'Sekiro,' using precise parries, acrobatic combos, and aerial moves to face challenging bosses that test your skill and strategy. Each battle brings you closer to the truth in this journey of resilience and mastery.

rows.name: Very Scary Backrooms Game
rows.short_description: You have no weapons. You have no means of defending yourself. Some will chase you, some will outsmart you. If you are in danger, run and hide.
rows.description_html: You've seen the backrooms, but not like this. 'Very Scary Backrooms Game' really is a backrooms experience like no other. Journey through liminal spaces while evading strange creatures. Who or what will you encounter? Find your way home... if you can... You wake up in an unknown location where everything is familiar, but not quite right. After navigating through this strange space, you will begin to realise that you might not be alone. You'll hear things running around you. Inanimate objects will appear to change their positions. Or is it all in your head? You may even encounter other beings that are reminiscent of parts of yourself, but who knows if they'll help you or hinder you. Very Scary Backrooms Game features three floors and can be completed in an extremely short amount of time with cunning, practice and healthy dose of luck. 'If you are in danger, run and hide.' How to Play WASD to move Mouse to look Esc for the menu (be sure to adjust your audio and sensitivity) On each level, look for anything that could be an exit. Whether it be an elevator or a hole in the floor. Your goal is to get out as quickly as possible.

rows.name: End Of Life
rows.short_description: End of Life is a third-person shooter that takes place in a city that is fragmented and in constant motion. These fragments that make up the city rotate as if it were a Rubik's Cube, creating different gravitational directions that allow the player to traverse the city.
rows.description_html: End of Life is a third-person action shooter set in a fragmented and ever-moving city, rotating like a Rubik's Cube. The player will shoot needles to overcome enemies and obstacles, dodge deadly attacks, and navigate the changing landscape with a grappling hook, always seeking an advantageous position to eliminate rivals. Story The world is governed by two goddesses. Asdis is the creator, while Disad must balance her sister's creations to prevent chaos. When Asdis creates humans, her greatest creation, Disad decides to divide her power and personify it in the Aarendjin, an extension of herself. The mission of the Aarendjin is to kill those humans who pose a real threat to the planet. Over time, a city discovered the Aarendjin's weakness and started a war to acquire the magic within them. They killed them all and stole their power cores, except for one, Nashla, whom they imprisoned. This power allowed the city to be in constant motion, rotating on itself, preventing Nashla from escaping. Years later, a revolt within the city aimed to kill the Aarendjin, providing Nashla with the perfect opportunity to execute her plan: recover her core and seek revenge on humans for killing her sisters. What is End Of Life? Changing World: A world based on a Rubik's Cube that the player and enemies can manipulate to create combat situations, new paths, and challenges. Multiple Gravities: Each area of the world has its gravity, with no safe spots when enemies can shoot from the sky. Relentless Movement: Everything in this world is in motion—the player, enemies, and the world itself. Constantly changing, the player must strive to find their way through battles and gravities. Gameplay End of Life is a third-person action shooter where the player embodies a demigoddess with a broken power seeking revenge and reclaiming stolen power. The player faces decisions that define whether they remain faithful to their original mission or succumb to revenge. The player must use the demigoddess's remaining powers and the world's resources. Different gravities and world modifications create new paths and allow the player to escape enemies when unable to face them. During the adventure, the demigoddess will find traces of her fallen sisters, recovering part of their powers. These powers grant her new abilities to progress in the world and new tools to defeat her enemies. Mechanics Navigation Gravity Shift: The game world is fragmented, and each fragment has its gravity on each face. Nashla can observe the world from different perspectives, finding paths that would be invisible otherwise. World Movement: The fragmented world is constantly moving, and the civilization residing there has created mechanisms to alter the world's movement at will. Nashla will use these to turn her enemies' tools against them. Grappling Hook: Nashla's main tool is a grappling hook, constantly used to reach otherwise inaccessible places and quickly approach enemies to finish them off before they can react. Combat Needles: Needles symbolize Nashla's power, each type providing effects to her projectiles. Each needle she carries once belonged to her fallen sisters. Bullet Time: Nashla's keen senses allow her to enter a state of total concentration. In this state, the world slows around her, allowing for quick decisions and providing a devastating advantage. Fury: As a vengeful demigoddess, Nashla becomes enraged at the mortals' challenge. When Nashla accumulates enough anger, she enters a Fury state, launching her projectiles more frequently and forcefully. The needles she launches in this state drain life from her enemies to heal her. Barriers: Enemies, aware of their weakness, constantly try to corner and wear down Nashla. Using complex magical barrier mechanisms, they will trap the demigoddess in an inescapable battle to weaken and defeat her. Core Loop The core of End of Life is primarily divided into three parts: advancing through the level, killing all enemies in the way, and discovering how to use her powers to interact with the world. This core loop represents a partnership between the player and their avatar, discovering the world and the demigoddess's powers at the same pace, fostering player immersion and empathy. Throughout the adventure, the player's style will reinforce each of the three core elements, from trying to advance by avoiding unnecessary conflicts to exploring the presented world or simply ending all life like a bloodthirsty beast. The decision of which aspect to reinforce will depend on the player's gameplay style, reflecting in Nashla's adventure their own story. Visual Style End of Life features a fusion of realistic environments and stylized characters, providing greater creative freedom while maintaining realistic textures for consistency. The environment represents a Middle Eastern style with warm, earthy, and luminous colors in squares where life once thrived. The warm tones contrast with Nashla's cool palette, indicating she doesn't belong to this world. The world is portrayed as a Rubik's Cube mirror, with marked edges and different sizes present throughout the entire scenario. It floats disorderly due to the ongoing war, constantly rotating and repositioning as the protagonist advances in the story. The sense of enormity and frenzy is reflected in all the cubes sustaining the world, and the magnitude in each playable scenario. Magic is prevalent throughout the game, playing a fundamental role. It's represented with brighter and more vivid colors in the environment, highlighting the game's mechanics. References The dynamic and changing world created in Doctor Strange inspired the game's dynamic landscape, covering both land and sky, the constant change through battles, and the extraordinary yet partially common landscapes. Rollerdrome is a central reference regarding gameplay. The combination of action with constant movement is a point that End Of Life seeks to achieve. The game's story draws strong influences from Hellblade, where both protagonists embark on a revenge story and face psychological issues distorting their perception of reality and objectives. The world-based puzzles served as inspiration for level design.

rows.name: Project: NEO
rows.short_description: A free-to-play sci-fi action roguelike game set in an alien world where the sun never shines. Explore the world as a ‘Planet Adventurer’. Fight hostile creatures, gather ore, and interact with the local community in your downtime. Upgrade your gear with resources earned during your expeditions.
rows.description_html: Project: NEO is a sci-fi action roguelike game. You play as a newly-hired ‘Planet Adventurer’, whose job is to set out and explore the exciting yet dangerous areas beyond the city. You will fight many hostile creatures as you navigate the three distinct regions surrounding the city. Gather ore and gain coins to spend on upgrades when you return home. While you're there, chat with the local inhabitants and get to know them. This is Project: NEO. (and did we mention, it’s completely free to play! ) Features - An immersive world - 5 different environments - Randomly generated map layouts - Gather resources - Upgrade gear - A local community you can interact with - And so much more! Developer Notes Project: NEO was created by a small team of passionate developers over the course of a few months. Considering it's the first game we have created on our own, we are proud and confident in how our project turned out. However, we are also aware that the game is not perfect, but as we worked through it we treated it as a learning experience to grow our skills so that we can create games that provide the exact experience a gamer wants in their game. We hope you enjoyed this little project we put together. -Project: NEO Team

rows.name: Grimhook
rows.short_description: Bounce, dash, and grapple through flooded caverns in this fast-paced first-person action platformer. Descend into Grimhook's sunken ruins as Dart, mastering Lovecraftian powers and decimating robotic foes. Explore, battle, and unravel the mysteries below Miletos.
rows.description_html: Embark on a harrowing journey beneath the ruins of the once-vibrant city of Miletos. Grimhook, a fast-paced, first-person action-adventure game, thrusts you into the heart of a flooded wasteland where robotic minions reign supreme and an ancient deity lies dormant beneath the city's surface. As Dart, you'll harness powerful abilities to navigate through cavernous depths; grapple, bounce, dash, and slash your way through relentless automata in intense combat arenas while you experience a grim world and a somber narrative. Game Features: Fast-paced First-Person Platforming: Unleash a myriad of Lovecraftian abilities as you navigate the caverns of Miletos. Time and combine your powers to swiftly traverse the game's terrain and outmaneuver your enemies. Tightly Tuned Combat: Engage in intense battles in multiple combat arenas, utilizing your powers to dodge bullets and decimate robotic foes. Watch as fully destructible adversaries explode, leaving a chaotic aftermath on the battlefield. Explore a Cavernous World: Traverse dilapidated skyscrapers, rushing rapids, and forgotten excavations in a sprawling subterranean world. Encounter diverse biomes that add depth and variety to your adventure. Hand-Painted Art Style: Immerse yourself in a somber environment brought to life by a carefully hand-painted art style, capturing the melancholic beauty of a city on the brink of ruin. Immersive Audio Experience: Immerse yourself in the tragic journey with over 10 electronic tracks in the musical score, composed by BelowCloudNine. Voiced Characters: Two fully voiced characters bring intimacy to the narrative and characterize the unlikely camaraderie between Dart and the dormant deity beneath the city. Dynamic Animations and Cutscenes: Dynamic first-person animations strike a vivid contrast with the desaturated world. Multiple fully authored first-person cutscenes enhance the immersive storytelling experience.
rows.about_html: Embark on a harrowing journey beneath the ruins of the once-vibrant city of Miletos. Grimhook, a fast-paced, first-person action-adventure game, thrusts you into the heart of a flooded wasteland where robotic minions reign supreme and an ancient deity lies dormant beneath the city's surface. As Dart, you'll harness powerful abilities to navigate through cavernous depths; grapple, bounce, dash, and slash your way through relentless automata in intense combat arenas while you experience a grim world and a somber narrative. Game Features: Fast-paced First-Person Platforming: Unleash a myriad of Lovecraftian abilities as you navigate the caverns of Miletos. Time and combine your powers to swiftly traverse the game's terrain and outmaneuver your enemies. Tightly Tuned Combat: Engage in intense battles in multiple combat arenas, utilizing your powers to dodge bullets and decimate robotic foes. Watch as fully destructible adversaries explode, leaving a chaotic aftermath on the battlefield. Explore a Cavernous World: Traverse dilapidated skyscrapers, rushing rapids, and forgotten excavations in a sprawling subterranean world. Encounter diverse biomes that add depth and variety to your adventure. Hand-Painted Art Style: Immerse yourself in a somber environment brought to life by a carefully hand-painted art style, capturing the melancholic beauty of a city on the brink of ruin. Immersive Audio Experience: Immerse yourself in the tragic journey with over 10 electronic tracks in the musical score, composed by BelowCloudNine. Voiced Characters: Two fully voiced characters bring intimacy to the narrative and characterize the unlikely camaraderie between Dart and the dormant deity beneath the city. Dynamic Animations and Cutscenes: Dynamic first-person animations strike a vivid contrast with the desaturated world. Multiple fully authored first-person cutscenes enhance the immersive storytelling experience.
rows.reviews_html: “A sweet, free first-person platformer with a touch of Lovecraft” Rock, Paper, Shotgun

rows.name: World War Next
rows.short_description: World War Next is a low poly multiplayer FPS set during a WW3 conflict, Choose from over 25 countries. Vehicles like tanks, helicopters, boats and armored cars help players get around quickly.
rows.description_html: WORLD WAR NEXT IS IN ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT WITH NEW UPDATES EVERY WEEK AND A NEW MAP EVERY TWO WEEKS. WE FIX ALL REPORTED BUGS & ISSUES. WE RELY ON COMMUNITY INVOLVEMENT TO HELP DECIDE WHICH FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS SHOULD COME NEXT. World War Next is a low poly multiplayer FPS set during a World War 3 conflict. Team up in squads to battle it out on real-world locations like Odesa Port, Donbas, and Taiwan. Maps aim to focus on the Eastern European, South Pacific and Middle Eastern theatres. Choose from over 25 countries and vehicles like tanks, helicopters, boats and armored cars help players get around fast. We've built the core gameplay features of World War Next and are now focused on adding more higher polished maps based on real locations, optimizing, improving player count and adding popular features that the community requests. WHATS NEXT? The full version of World War Next will focus on the features the players love the most. The goal is to find the perfect balance between casual and tactical FPS. We want to improve on our humble offering of maps by adding more higher polished, higher quality maps, both large and small. The maps will be based on real possible World War 3 battle locations in the Pacific Theatre, Eastern European Theatre and Middle Eastern Theatre. We want to improve support for more players, first 32 then 50+. We will add support for proximity voice chat with more weapons and a weapon levelling system. We want tighter vehicle controls with smoother, more optimized gameplay. We'll add more game modes and a completed UI/UX. COMMUNITY The community is the heart and soul of World War Next. The community will vote on which maps are next, which theatres and countries to focus on and what authentic tanks, planes, boats and weapons should be remade in low poly. Our Discord server is the main hub for interactions. By joining, you can share feedback, report bugs, find squad members and engage with other players. By being low poly, World War Next has the unique opportunity of being able to release an entirely new map within a week or two of a real battle breaking out. Being this adaptable allows us to stay on top of breaking news and create an experience unlike anything seen before. A live game to reflect the World War 3 conflict featuring authentic maps, vehicles, weapons, and uniforms – all in glorious low poly.

rows.name: Scary School Simulator 2
rows.short_description: Escape from horror anime ghost story in your school's classroom!
rows.description_html: Dive into the spine-chilling world of Scary School Simulator 2, where the serene facade of Sakura High School conceals dark secrets and eerie mysteries. Immerse yourself in this heart-pounding anime horror simulation that combines the thrill of high school life with the terror of a yandere ghost's obsession. Unravel the mysteries, survive the doki-doki moments, and escape the sinister ghosts. Play the game as Sakura and her friend Sara, the Japanese schoolgirls on livestream that trapped in a cursed and abandoned academy, where you must navigate the dark corridors of a haunted school, solve chilling mysteries, and survive terrifying encounters with spooky creatures and zombies. 🌟 Key Features: 🔪 Survive the Haunted School: Navigate the spooky halls of Sakura High School, where creepy ghosts lurk around every corner, ready to haunt you into a world of terror. Can you escape their killing desires and survive the nightmare? 🌸 Explore Sakura High School: Discover the hauntingly beautiful 3D surroundings of Japanese high school, complete with swimming pool, art club, and abandoned classrooms. But beware, as darkness hides behind every corners. 👧 Interact with Friends: Meet with a variety of students, each with their unique personalities and secrets. Build love relationships or face the consequences of rejection, as the yandere ghost are always watching you. 👹 Evil and Angry Teacher’s Wrath: The beautiful teacher is not what they seem. Avoid seek their attention, scare her by prank teachers, solve puzzles, and escape their evil plans to trap you in the haunted high school forever. 🎮 Realistic Simulator Experience: Experience the thrill of a realistic high school simulator with a terrifying twist. Attend classes, prank your friends, and interact with stuff, all while being on the lookout for popping jump scares. 😱 Heart-Pounding Doki Doki Story: Feel your heart race during intense chapters, where your choices could mean the difference between survival and death. Can you keep your composure and outwit the evil ghost trying to kill you? 👻 Anime Horror Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in the captivating anime horror game atmosphere of Scary School Simulator 2. The chilling soundtrack, eerie jumpscare, and unsettling ambiance will keep you on the edge of your seat. 🏃 Escape the Horror: Your last goal - escape from Sakura High School with your boyfriend before it consumes your soul. Use your eyes, mobile phone, and playtime to find a way out of this nightmare. Survive the horror school, outsmart your pursuers, and escape Sakura High School before it's too late. Can you evade the hordes of the supernatural being in this terrifying anime horror simulation game?

Gather your companions and set off on an epic quest to save your beloved home. Encounter mysterious forces, seduce strange and sexy creatures... and shape the fate of the world in this exciting and sexy visual novel! We owe a debt of gratitude to the people who have supported us over the years, without whom this game and its successor, Quickie: A Love Hotel Story , would not have been possible. This game is a celebration of our dedicated followers, both past and present... so we are happy to share it with everyone FOR FREE! ▹ Completely free to download and play! ▹ 8 beautiful, romanceable characters from the Quickiverse! ▹ 8 steamy animations with partial voice acting! ▹ Different fantasy races including: humans, mages, elves, nymphs, neko and more!

rows.name: Snowbreak: Containment Zone
rows.short_description: The new 3D Waifu Sci-Fi RPG Shooter is here! Aim at fate, fight by our side! Clear the specified stage to claim an Orange-Tier Operative!
rows.description_html: Snowbreak: Containment Zone is a 3D Waifu sci-fi RPG-shooter powered by the Unreal Engine 4 that offers a next-gen, cross-platform gaming experience, sharing your progress across all of your devices. The Descent of the Titans turned a once-vibrant city into the devastated wasteland of Containment Zone Aleph. As the Adjutant of Heimdall Force, bravely undertake missions alongside Manifestations with the powers of gods and unique personalities, seeking to bring this bitter winter to an end... [Enjoy Hybrid Combat] Snowbreak's weaponry injects realism into a sci-fi setting, with designs closely simulating future firearms technology. This combines with the otherworldly, RPG-like skill mechanic to create a refreshing combat experience. [Take on Titans] The Descent of the Titans completely changed the world, and the battlefield. Feel the thrill of battling giants in this dystopian future! [Befriend Operatives] Spend time with your Heimdall Force companions in the Base system. Decorate, chat, and give gifts to grow closer! [Play Co-Op in Gigalink] Tired of exploring alone? Join up with friends and fight enemies together!

rows.name: Para: Rime of Zealot
rows.short_description: Para: Rime of Zealot is a 2D side-scrolling suspenseful thriller adventure game.It is inspired by the ancient mariner's tale.You will take on the role of the protagonist, Lovan, navigating the pressures of survival while uncovering the truth behind the events.
rows.description_html: Believe in it, and anything can be the truth. When Lovan opened his eyes again, the ship was in utter chaos. Many crew members died for unknown reasons, leaving only six survivors on the ship. The specter of the deceased crew members spread fear. While Lovan was still trying to make sense of the situation, the 'Messiah' appeared. He wants you to find the murderer hidden among the surviving crew members and kill him. So Lovan, with a mixture of doubt and determination, began his mission to save everyone... He will face yet more choices... Game Features Players will explore the ship from the perspective of Rowan. Search for a water source before dehydration sets in. Uncover the truth about the deaths of other sailors on the stylistically intense ship. This game contains elements such as blood and violence and is not suitable for those who may find these elements disturbing. Also contains elements of depression, suicide, etc., please consider carefully before playing if sensitive.
