rows.name: Tails of War
rows.short_description: Command an army to face off against your feline foes in a game of strategy, wits, and whiskers. Capture cities, use special abilities, obtain Artifacts of Power, and spawn units in this turn-based battle for strategic dominance against your opponents - in both solo play and online multiplayer
rows.description_html: Command an army to face off against your feline foes in a game of strategy, wits, and whiskers. Champions Vibrant cast of 6 unique champions - Pick from six unique champions from the desert, grassland, and tundra kingdom. Discover their unique personalities through their voice acting. Use Your Specials to Turn the Tide of Battle - Each faction gives their champion a unique special ability. Spawn an ally from thin air to defend yourself as a tundra champion. Move an extra turn to get a kill on a faraway enemy as a grass champion. Teleport yourself out of harms way as a desert champion. Units Wide Array of 8 Different Units - Spawn from a selection of 8 different units on the ground and in the air! Utilize their strengths and weaknesses to gain an edge in combat. Strategy Position Your Units on Advantageous Terrains - Head into the mountains to escape an assassin. Use the cover of the forests to defend yourself from attacks. Give your units a boost - Capture Artifacts of Power and Key Locations to give yourself and your units a strategic edge. Artifacts of Power give buffs to the unit that captures it for as long as they live. Key Locations give entire team-wide buffs to whichever team holds the location. Multiplayer Play against a computer controlled opponent - or play against a friend in our online multiplayer mode ! Customize the match's rules to your liking! About Tails of War was created by a 45 person multidisciplinary team over two semesters at the University of Michigan's WolverineSoft Studio, a student games studio undertaking semester-long projects. It is an educational case study of Wargroove, and takes inspiration from its game mechanics as well as other games in the genre. Work on this project took place between May 2023 to January 2024.

rows.short_description: Find yourself in the center of a decisive battle for Russian lands. You are a 16th century Sagittarius. Repel the Crimean army, show valor and ingenuity in battle. Whether the enemy reaches Moscow or not depends on you!
rows.description_html: Only you stand between Moscow and the Crimean army. It's the 16th century. Your task is to protect Russian lands! Hurry up to prepare the southern borders of Rus' for an enemy attack. How to do it? - Solve numerous puzzles. Reveal the enemy's plan, show courage and ingenuity and turn the tide of the battle! — Develop defensive tactics with the defenders of the Epifansky fort! Can you quickly load an ancient arquebus in the heat of battle? - Find the enemy’s weak point and strike! Shoot accurately and quickly, there will be no second chance. 'The Gates of the Kulikovo Field. The Battle of Epifan' is a VR reconstruction created jointly with leading Russian historians. How was a 16th century gun loaded? What did the defenders of the southern borders of Rus' look like? How did you fight back a ruthless enemy? Become time travelers and get answers to these questions.

rows.short_description: Collect Gems, explore worlds, and party hardy. You’ll do it all in Fimbul’s Gemboree- a fast-paced adventure platformer. Play as Fimbul, a little ice dragon, and help him run, jump, and roll across lands to collect items that will let him into the best party on the block.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the enchanting world of 'Fimbul's Gemboree,' a delightful 3D platformer that invites players on an epic adventure with Fimbul, a charming small ice dragon on a quest for the ultimate party experience. In this whimsical journey, players will navigate through diverse landscapes, from sun-kissed beaches to mysterious rocky forests and even a towering mountainous pinball machine. As Fimbul, your mission is to collect sparkling gems and coveted tickets scattered throughout the vibrant environments. The more gems and tickets you gather, the closer you get to unlocking the grand entrance to the legendary Gemboree, the most exclusive and spectacular dragon celebration in the realm. Embark on an exploration-filled escapade, overcoming platforming challenges, solving puzzles, and encountering endearing snowmen, and treacherous tiki totems. Fimbul's cute personality and nimble abilities make every run, jump, and roll a joy to experience, adding a layer of charm to the immersive gameplay.

rows.name: Descent from Arkov's tower Prologue
rows.short_description: Highly moddable retro roguelike. Descend from Arkov's Tower - or die trying!
rows.description_html: Full release October 2024 This game is the prologue wishlist the full game here: Aside from 9 areas and 30 Levels the full release will also support lua scripts in mods. This means you have even more possibilities to create your story in this roguelike. It is also planned (even if not finally confirmed) that I will add Steam workshop support with the full release of the game. About the Game Warning contains 8-bit-ish Retro! Caution! This is a retro pixel art roguelike which might bring back memories you didn't even know you had. A flickering, humming CRT screen in your living room or bedroom back in the '90s after a day at school. What do you mean you weren't even born back then? Gameplay This roguelike puts you in the shoes of an unnamed adventurer who just woke up on the top level of Arkov's Tower. Try to fight your way down and escape it - or die trying. Move your player trough numerous procedural generated levels. Fight numerous enemies including some unique bosses. The turn based combat system allows you to take your time and plan every move carefully. Upgrade your character with all sorts of items found in chests or dropped by enemies. In rare occasions you might find a wishing well, which allows you to upgrade your base stats. Can you make it to the bottom of the mysterious Tower? Please be aware that this is a prologue, so more levels and bosses will be added in planned content Upgrades. Modding This game is highly customizable for people with pixel art and/or programming experience. Just have a look at the included manual and the Mod Manager in the main menu. Maybe you want to create your own story? Use this game as a roguelike engine and make it happen!

rows.name: Reckless Rally
rows.short_description: Reckless Rally Is A Small Casual Rally Racing Game. Try And Set A PB On The Two Tracks Or Build Your Own Based Off Real World Roads!
rows.description_html: Race on 2 tracks adapted from the real world, with a selection of Rally Cars bosting Hybrid or ICE Powertrains. Push the maximum out of the cars without going over the threshold and crashing to get the fastest time on the tracks. Indulge in your pro rally driver fantasies by building your own tracks based off real world roads and finally experience how you really want to drive down some of those roads! Using websites like ‘RideWithGPS’, ‘Garmin Connect’ & ‘Strava’ plot out custom race tracks using roads from the real world. Download the GPX file and import it in-game, pick the road width and barrier type before jumping into the virtual roads to see what you can really do!

rows.name: CipherCraft: Cyber Guardian Introduction
rows.short_description: Immerse yourself in the strange world of CipherCraft: CGI, where you'll perform repairs, network infiltration, programming, server management, active server administration, and meticulous assembly and cleaning of computer components. Win against an Anonymous hacker who keeps sabotaging the company.
rows.description_html: Dive into the captivating universe of CipherCraft: Cyber Guardian , an immersive experience that thrusts you into the role of a passionate young tech enthusiast. Your dream of running your own IT service takes an unexpected turn as you land a job filled with intriguing challenges. Engage in tasks ranging from intricate repairs and network infiltration to programming, server management, and active server administration. However, your skills are put to the ultimate test as you uncover the presence of an elusive Anonymous hacker, hell-bent on sabotaging the very core of your company. In CipherCraft: CGI , you're not just assembling and cleaning computer components; you're embroiled in a digital battle where success requires a blend of technical prowess and strategic thinking. As you navigate the cyber realm, it becomes apparent that the stakes are higher than you imagined – the hacker's influence extends beyond mere computer systems. ⬇️ KEY FEATURES YOU SHOULD KNOW ⬇️ 🛠️ EQUIPMENT REPAIRS Repair a variety of electronic components, including RFID, Ethernet, Wifi, and Pendrive boards. Ready-to-move-in devices include telephones and air conditioning controllers. Future additions are planned for retro consoles, cameras, wiretaps, and other futuristic equipment used in Black Mirror-type missions. Clean components using compressed air and explore the possibility of further disassembly. 🌐 NETWORK MANAGEMENT Manage routers and network devices from various companies (customers). Break into local networks to steal data, surveillance recordings, and more. 💾 TERMINAL Manage files, control data access, recover and remove malware. Crack passwords from the terminal and integrate with 'Network Management' to hack into local networks. 💻 PROGRAMMING Write software and program devices using blueprint-like mechanics. Future plans to expand the range of programs available for development. 🔧 SERVER MANAGEMENT Manage servers and enhance their power by replacing server drawers. Encounter challenges such as fires in the server room, requiring strategic extinguishing. 🔍 ACTIVE SERVER Administer access and users in the database of various companies (customers). 🔄 MONITORING REPAIR AND RECORDING RECOVERY Similar mechanics to programming, connecting appropriate threads to restore images. Future integration with the terminal for enhanced recording recovery capabilities. 🧹 ASSEMBLING AND CLEANING COMPUTER COMPONENTS Assemble computer components such as motherboards, RAM, and CPUs. Ongoing development to add case, graphics card, and disk assembly. Clean computers using compressed air for optimal performance. CIPHERCRAFT: CYBER GUARDIAN is a journey where reality blurs and you'll question whether to take the red or blue pill. Are you ready to outsmart the Anonymous hacker and fulfill your dream of becoming a Cyber Guardian? The game awaits, beckoning you into a world where every click and code could change the course of your digital destiny.

rows.name: Pirate's Money
rows.short_description: Join the ranked competition and secure the R$1,000 prize for the grand winner! Pirate's Money: where even pirates win in real life!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Pirate's Money, the ultimate adventure on the seven seas, where strategy, courage and cunning determine who will reign over the treacherous waters of Pirate's Island! Ranked: Where Legends Are Forged With the Ranked Pass , you not only test your skills against the best pirates , but you also have the chance to engrave your name in the history of Pirate's Island. Each season, the seas become a battlefield where only the most cunning survive. Stunning Graphics and Immersive Gameplay With breathtaking graphics and immersive gameplay, you'll feel every wave crashing against the hull, the wind in your sails and the sweet taste of victory. Every choice, every battle, every negotiation is a story you write in Pirate's Money. Community and Competitions Join a vibrant community of pirates! Make alliances, betray enemies and fight for the top. With regular updates, seasonal events, and a world that evolves with your actions, every visit to Pirate's Money is a new adventure. Your legend begins now. Raise the sails, load the cannons and prepare for the adventure of a lifetime in Pirate's Money.

rows.name: Eternal Spring VR
rows.short_description: Immerse yourself in 'ETERNAL SPRING (長春) VR,' an animated 360 documentary that goes inside the world of a real-life survivor of religious persecution in China, adding a new dimension to the feature film that was Canada's official submission to the 2023 Oscars®.
rows.description_html: SKY OF TIDES - TRY OUT THE FREE DEMO SHUYAN SAGA About the Game “ETERNAL SPRING (長春) VR” is an animated virtual reality documentary that brings us inside the world of a real-life survivor of religious persecution in China. This immersive, 360 accompaniment to the feature film Eternal Spring (Hot Docs winner and Canada’s official 2023 Oscar® submission) features original recorded testimony and vivid artwork from acclaimed Chinese illustrator Daxiong (Star Wars, Justice League comics), brought to life in animation. A custom soundscape enhances the immersion when experienced with the Woojer haptic vest (optional). WALK A MILE IN SOMEONE ELSE’S SHOES Put yourself in the shoes of someone facing religious persecution in China. In mid-nineties northeast China, Jin Xuezhe is drawn to the slow-moving exercises of the Buddhist Falun Gong discipline, whose early morning meditators fill the parks of his hometown, Changchun. When the communist regime bans the popular practice in 1999, Jin is unwilling to sit by as disinformation in the state media maligns his faith and community. Tragically, however, speaking out against the growing propaganda and disappearances brings the risk of arrest, and worse. This 12-minute interactive documentary combines live-action video and original recorded testimony with animated recreations brought to life from the drawings of acclaimed comic book artist Daxiong (Star Wars, Justice League), who, like Jin, was forced to flee Changchun to escape persecution. This interactive VR film features a custom soundscape to trigger haptic sensations delivered through the new Woojer Vest (optional), which heightens the experience as cops arrest you on the street for handing out leaflets, and you get to feel the heart-pounding tension of a police interrogation in China. ETERNAL SPRING (長春) VR works as a standalone experience, while also adding a new dimension to the animated documentary feature ETERNAL SPRING (長春), which was Canada’s official submission to the 2023 Academy Awards® for Best International Feature Film. Eternal Spring has screened in 86 film festivals on six continents, inside multiple national parliaments, and earned 26 awards and another 25 nominations. (See the film now on VICE, CBC, Arte, and others–visit Eternal Spring Film site for more information.) USER WARNING If you suffer from heart conditions, have experienced related trauma, or are severely affected by real-world traumatic events, you may wish to speak first with your medical professional before engaging in this experience.

rows.name: Super Cube 3D
rows.short_description: Explore beautiful worlds and make new friends in this 3D MMO Platformer.
rows.description_html: Climb mountains, swim through waterfalls, solve mazes, and dive from the sky in this 3D MMO Platformer. Set out on an adventure with square friends and conquer challenging parkours filled with fun and frustration. This game offers endless hours of entertainment through overly difficult levels, speedrunning, and an in-game chat. Multiplayer Play with hordes of players and help each other past difficult obstacles. Speedrunning Set world records by completing levels faster than everyone else. The fastest replay of every level is saved, and can be played back across game runs. And If beating your friends isn't enough, you can always use the in-game chat to tell them how much better you are. Do you have what it takes?

rows.name: WarSpawn
rows.short_description: WarSpawn is a multiplayer action PvP game inspired by old-school PvP classics such as Rakion Online and Infinity Online. Slash, stab, grab, blast, and launch your way to victory using various weapons with no timegates or pay-to-win, just dive right into the action and have fun!
rows.description_html: WarSpawn is a multiplayer action PvP game inspired by old-school PvP classics such as Rakion Online and Infinity Online . Use teamwork to strategize and eliminate the enemy team's Elder God, or challenge yourself in the PvE Solo Survival mode. So come slash, stab, grab, blast, and launch your way to victory using various weapons with no timegates or pay-to-win, just dive right into the action and have fun! Dynamic hack-n-slash combat : Out-maneuver your opponents with well timed movement abilities. Engage them with light and heavy attack combo sets unique to each weapon. And finish them off with special ranged attacks as they attempt to flee. The tools at your disposal provides fast-paced dynamic gameplay with a combat system that aims to be easy to learn, difficult to master, and always fun. Team based PvP : Hop into the teamwork focused Elder Wars mode where two teams fight to expose and then takedown the opposing Elder God in epic multiplayer boss-fight sequences. Step into a world inspired by the works of H. P. Lovecraft and the artworks of Moebius : A unique blend of Lovecraftian / Cosmic Horror, Moebius and Anime inspired aesthetics, and electronic soundscape creates a backdrop like none other for glorious PvP action.

rows.name: Tower Monster Rush
rows.short_description: A tower defense game with brand new gameplay elements, innovatively combining the strategic tower defense with card battles.
rows.description_html: A tower defense game with brand new gameplay elements, innovatively combining the strategic tower defense with card battles. With dozens of different enemies, hundreds of unprecedented levels, monthly updated trial rankings, and rich holiday-themed events. All you need to do is constantly collect and synthesize cards, cultivate your own heroes and defensive towers, and you can drive the villains out of your homeland. Join this exciting tower defense battle now! What you can do in the game: Beat up the bad guys Battle various types of enemies, from minotaurs to the undead, and even feathered demons! Upgrade your heroes Win new items with each victory and make your heroes stronger and even more brutal! Tower defense + card collection and upgrading The addictive depth of strategy and highly enjoyable card collecting mechanics will keep you hooked! Treasures and rewards galore Use a variety of tempting loot to enhance your combat power! Game features: 1. Simple and easy:to-understand towerdefense basics, easyto operate. 2. Exquisite cartoon-style graphics suitable for all ages. 3. Freely combine battle strategies, choose different routes to strengthen your own combat power, whether it's towers, heroes, spells, etc. 4. Rich enemies and levels for a deeply immersive gaming experience. 5. Regularly updated leaderboard rankings and server-wide progress, you're not alone in the battle! 6. Rich and colorful holiday-themed events for continuous surprises.

rows.name: 三国：我是主公
rows.short_description: A war strategy game set against the backdrop of the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms, where you can collect many famous generals from the Three Kingdoms for cultivation, meet other players to form alliances, collaborate and conquer the world, and write your own legendary epic.
rows.description_html: 【 Featured gameplay 】 Cross server competition, highly strategic competition Top players from different regional servers can enter the same arena for a one-on-one battle. And each player needs to send up to 5 teams of 25 generals for a battle of three wins in five innings. Not only are there peak battles between top tier teams. Among them, there are complex strategic decisions, such as using weak teams as abandoned children to ensure victory, just like Tian Ji did in horse racing; Still not encouraging at all, he fought head-on to snatch the strongest name from the strong. This is all in your hands. Xiangyang City Battle, Heroes of the Three Kingdoms Gather Together Players from three factions gather in the Xiangyang Battle Map, with the goal of capturing and defending the main hall of Xiangyang City. This is not only a battle of strength between countries, but also a test of the execution decisions of the kings of various countries. It can be a 'Sun Liu alliance' that rejects strong enemies, or it can be a combination of both sides, suppressing the strong and supporting the weak. This new chapter of the Three Kingdoms is written by players. Achieve great achievements, rank as a wolf and win the position of general With four growth lines for official positions, players can choose to ascend and change their official position types at any time. The rise of official positions will also bring more privileges, ultimately becoming powerful officials above one person and below ten thousand people.

rows.name: Neongarten - Prologue
rows.short_description: A minimalist cyberpunk city builder inspired by Islanders and Luck Be a Landlord.
rows.description_html: Wishlist the full game You can now wishlist the full game on Steam! About the Game Congratulations! We have accepted your bid to redevelop Block #27343 inside Novo Stappelstad! This site is truly a blank slate. The former occupant, Yamaha Piano Research Division, was wiped out when an rogue wormhole escaped containment. Not a single building was left behind. You will have eight weeks to complete your contract. Make sure you hit your weekly milestones, or else you and your company will be terminated. Find synergies between buildings to maximize their taxes, pit mega-corps against idealistic hackers, and place toxic waste dumps on top of coffee shops. Chill out to lo-fi tunes while you grow your city block one cube at a time.

rows.description_html: A perfect mix of card game, rogue-lite, and pure wild west mayhem. Explore an ever-changing map, collect interesting cards, and battle enemies. Explore and Collect Explore the Frontier and add powerful cards - bullets - to your collection. Each one equipped with its own unique effect. Build Each bullet has an individual effect, used to create powerful synergies. Use them to build your deck and to become an Outlaw Legend! Load and shoot to kill! Load your cards into the revolver and use the effects to your advantage, while also utilizing the limited amount of chambers and the rotations of the revolver. Then, shoot the enemies and send them 6 feet deep! But watch out, he won't just stand there letting you shoot him down so easily… Features Completely free & Open Source: And thats a great price if you ask me. No ads or any kind of microtransactions, I promise. Read down below to find out more about the open-source licence that .forty-five is under. Over 50 unique cards: some serious and some … a little bit … less serious. Innovative gameplay: allowing the player to achieve creative combos with the revolvers rotation. 100% handdrawn assets: I might not be the next picasso, but hey, I'm trying okay … A procedurally generated map: ever-changing, guaranteeing a new experience every run. Deckbuilding : to truly personalize your way of … shooting people. Different enemy types: so you'll never run out of things to shoot at. Unique biomes: each … you know what just download and find out it's free. We are open source! The source code of .forty-five is public under the GPLv3 license. But what does that actually mean? It means that anyone is free to view and share the code of the game. Also, everyone can make their own modified versions of our game and redistribute it, as long as they maintain the GPLv3.0 license. Want to know more? Read about the license here: Want to take a look at our code? Visit our Github: Project Infos: .Forty-Five is developed as a Diploma Thesis by five students of the higher technical vocational school 'HTL Rennweg' in Vienna. We hope you will have as much fun playing, as we had developing.

rows.name: Beast Collector
rows.short_description: Beast Collector: Capture, Evolve, Battle in this thrilling card game adventure!
rows.description_html: Beast Collector - Your Ultimate Stylized Card Battler Adventure! Welcome to the captivating world of 'Beast Collector,' a thrilling Trading Card Game (TCG) that seamlessly blends casual charm with competitive multiplayer excitement. Engage in epic card battles and craft your deck with style! Dive into Thrilling Card Duels! Immerse yourself in dynamic card battles with stunning visuals and an immersive soundtrack. Challenge opponents worldwide in intense Player versus Player (PvP) card combat scenarios! Accessible to All Players! 'Beast Collector' is user-friendly, catering to players of all levels. Master the game mechanics through straightforward tutorials. Begin with a basic deck and expand your collection as you progress! Explore 300 Unique Cards! Discover a diverse array of 300 distinct cards, featuring beasts, traps, spells, and enchantments. Each card presents unique strategies, empowering you to build decks that suit your playstyle. Command Strong Hero Cards! Harness powerful Hero cards with unique effects capable of shifting battle dynamics. These Heroes wield abilities that can drastically alter tactics during combat. Synergize Different Classes for Battle Advantage! Utilize distinct classes—Melee attackers, Magic attackers, Supporters, and Defenders—to create powerful synergies. Defenders boast high health points and a taunt ability, while Melee attackers wield strong attacking power and special abilities to bypass the defender's taunt. Magic attackers cast potent spells, swiftly annihilating enemies. Lastly, Supporters alter the battlefield with various abilities. Combine these classes for synergistic advantages in battles. Engage in Varied Modes! Experience four distinctive game modes: * Explore Mode: Delve into the complexities of the 'Beast Collector' world. * Dungeon Mode: Confront unique monsters found exclusively in dungeons, offering challenging Player versus Environment (PvE) encounters. * Normal Multiplayer Mode: Enjoy casual multiplayer battles, perfect for thrilling card duels. * Ranked Multiplayer Mode: Scale the ranks and engage in strategic multiplayer battles. Hatch Eggs for Random Beasts! Navigate to your deck, select the egg tab, choose your egg card, and click the hatch button on the right panel. Access the Hatch screen to choose any egg and acquire a random beast! Evolve Your Beasts! All beasts evolve through 3 stages. Begin at level 1, and by combining 5 identical beast cards, evolve to a much stronger stage, amplifying their abilities and prowess. 'Beast Collector' offers an unparalleled experience in the competitive multiplayer TCG domain, featuring over 300 cards including a diverse collection of 270 unique beast cards, and traps, spells, and enchantments. Craft Your Winning Deck Strategy! In 'Beast Collector,' devising your deck strategy is the key to victory. Explore multiple avenues to tailor your deck-building approach: * Prebuilt Decks: Dive straight into the Ranked ladder using pre-made decks designed for quick entry into battles. * Deck Crafting: Forge your deck from the ground up or take inspiration from a friend’s list to build a winning combination. * Tailored Customization: Fine-tune and personalize your decks, ensuring every card aligns perfectly with your battle tactics. Recommended for Casual players seeking card gaming fun Enthusiasts of engaging deck-building adventures Multiplayer enthusiasts looking for competitive challenges

rows.name: System Override
rows.short_description: System Override is a first-person, single player heist game where you play as a hacker clearing a route through a variety of traps that block the way of your non-playable companion on the field.
rows.description_html: System Override is a first-person, single player heist game where you play as a hacker clearing a route through a variety of traps that block the way of your non-playable companion on the field. It requires a mix of careful planning and quick thinking as you look through security cameras to disable hazards, like laser tripwires and robotics, that lay just ahead.

rows.name: DALDZAH
rows.short_description: DALDZAH is an adventure inspired by the Nart Sagas, following the journey of a child and a deceased deity to the top of a mountain. Warm your surroundings, burn obstacles in your path, and help the North Caucasian deities on your way to reunite child with his parents.
rows.description_html: DALDZAH is a bedtime story about combining the traditional with the modern and uniting the divided. A kaleidoscope of the grandeur and beauty of the North Caucasus. DEATH IS NO MORE The Daughter of the Sun destroyed the cradle of death. Death is no more, leaving only the undead Namalats. The Child runs away from home to return the forgotten amulet to father and meet mother at the top. The mountain guides the child through places of worship. The child warms his way, learns about the past, present and future, reunites the mountain and the family. MASH1O, THE CHILD OF DARKNESS, SUN, AND MANKIND Interact with the world as a playful child Mash1o is a small flame born of the blood of a Great Warrior, the light of the Daughter of the Sun and the darkness of the Lord of Death. And his legs burn as he runs. Warm the space by running in circles. Burn all obstacles on the way by dashing. JOURNEY THROUGH DEITIES Mountain changed with death gone Mash1o visits 7 abodes, meeting deities from North Caucasian pagan religions and helping them with their problems. His path takes him through: Ruins of the Land of the Dead , the abode of the Ossetian lord of death Barastyr Tower Town , the abode of the Vainakh goddess of country Mehka-nana Sun Fields , the abode of the Abazian goddess of bees Gwynda and the Abkhazian goddess of fertility Dzhadzha Dried Great River’s Riverbed , the abode of the Vainakh goddess of water Hi-nana Dark Broken Sky , the abode of the Kabardino-Balkarian deity of the sky Kek Teyrisi and the Adyghe incarnation of lightning Schyble The Place of Sun and Moon , the abode of the Ossetian god of manhood Uastyrdzhi The Top of Mountain , the abode of the Ossetian goddess of sun Atzyruhs REMINISCENCES OF THE DEATH The fragments of the world gone The mythical past bursts into the present with a haze before the eyes of Mash1o. The mountain itself tells of the gods, the past of Mash1o's parents and the effects of death's destruction on the world.

rows.name: LoveCraft
rows.short_description: Welcome to LoveCraft - home to interesting people, hot parties, exploration and fulfilling relationships! Create your world, from a unique persona to your exciting adventures.
rows.description_html: FREE SEX for all players! ✨ FREE SEX for all players! ✨ Now there are no restrictions or prohibitions! Dive into a world of pleasures without limits. About the Game What to do in your free time? Whatever you desire! Dance, meet new people or joke with friends. Getting bored from all the fun? Start a business and earn game currency. Bonuses, promos, gifts, and, of course, positive emotions! Immerse yourself in a world of sexual fantasies through beautiful animations, erotic poses and realistic graphics. Male or female, brunette, blond or ginger. Express your personality through a unique look with the help of our advanced editor. Simple but powerful! Quick-and-easy creation or detailed, elaborate appearance. Find a special someone. What will your first date be like? In a club, out for a walk, or maybe in your private apartment? Everything depends on you! You don’t need an excuse to show your moves on the dance floor! Hot parties, cool music and fun every day. Move around faster! Cars? Boring! Show your style: gather a full collection from a spacecraft to a magical unicorn! Get immersed with the help of interactive objects. Unique effects and animations are waiting at the store and around countless virtual environments. Discover them all and have fun! Every day - new things to do and discover! Finish quests and earn game currency. More adventures - more money to spend on all the awesome things at the store. Are you angry, happy or maybe amused? LoveCraft is a world where everyone can freely share their feelings. With the use of actions and avatar’s expressions, of course :) Set up your dream home, whether it’s an apartment or a luxury mansion. Our intuitive editor has everything you need for building and decor. Unleash your creativity and invite friends to check it out! Have you always wanted to start a business? Practice in a virtual world! Pick an idea and get started. Would it be a furniture store, clothing boutique or a real estate agency? Earn game currency, develop your brand and build a loyal customer base. Earned enough - have fun with your money. Explore stores and get what your heart desires: transport, effects, decor and much more!

rows.name: Kurofune : Descobrimentos Portugueses
rows.short_description: A choose your adventure, resource management and decision-making game focused on Portuguese culture.
rows.description_html: Warning: This is a DEMO version of the final game. We are 4 recently graduated Portuguese Game Developers trying to start a Game Studio . Every donation is appreciated and will contribute to the development of new games and to improve quality . Contact us via our Discord server -> ( #open-ticked ) if you want to contribute . Thank you, 3PA Studios. Be the captain of a Portuguese ship on a daring journey from Lisbon to Japan! Don't expect an easy ride, there are over 20 locations , 50 tradable items , and multiple ships that will not hesitate to steal them from you . Choose your play style ... warriors, medics, cooks, entertainers, or sailors . A mix of all? Think carefully before making any decision, they will influence your future and also how the rest of the world sees you . Reputation - Negotiators might not like a captain with a bad reputation... Crew Morale - Be careful with riots... Crew Health - You don't want your crew sick.. trust me. Along the way, there are multiple references to historical battles and items from Portuguese culture. Use your nautical journal to keep track of everything. Are you the chosen one to reach Japan? Pirates... they can cause some trouble but the reward could be worth it. You are the Captain! Tell your crew where to go. Balancing every variable could be and will be challenging. Some locations have certain resources and others don't... you can profit from that. Storms are a nightmare. Don't let your ship sink!

rows.name: Sonder
rows.short_description: Experience an innovative co-op adventure where two players have to work together. Engage in collaborative puzzle solving and dynamic combat with each player having unique abilities. Delve into a psychological narrative that explores the essence of humanity.
rows.description_html: Local Co-op requires a gamepad controller for both players. Online Co-op supports mouse and keyboard. Psychological narrative - After a mass-scale destruction of all artificial intelligence, a scrapped robot and soul form an unexpected friendship. After a mysterious train knocks them out, they wake up in a world shaped by their own thoughts. Will they be able to cooperate and escape this dark reality? Immersive atmosphere - Immerse yourself in an atmospheric world crafted with a stylish, minimalistic approach that captivates your attention and enhances the shared adventure. Unleash the power of collaboration, confront existential mysteries, and embark on a gaming journey like no other. Collaboration - Work together - succeed together. Each character has unique abilities that allow them to manipulate the world in their own way, meaning they can only proceed if they cooperate. In combat, maximum efficiency can be achieved by combining the player’s powers, allowing them to neutralize the most dangerous of foes.

rows.name: Void Guard
rows.short_description: Follow the Void Guardian as she inspects a space station after receiving a distress beacon from it and help her vanquish the hidden evil.
rows.description_html: Follow the Void Guardian as she inspects a space station after receiving a distress beacon from it. In Void Guard, you play as the Void Guardian to discover the space station's secret and vanquish the hidden evil. 'Void Guard' is a Top-Down Metroidvania shooter/puzzle game where the Void Guardian can be moved with WASD. As the Guardian explores the station and the planetoids below, she will find the cause of the station's crew vanishing, encountering mind-bending puzzles, hostile fauna, and exciting suit upgrades. Some environments may be more hostile, and she might have to figure out how to survive. The combination of dangerous technology and biology will be an exciting challenge to overcome. In 'Void Guard,' there are many abilities, such as a gun, a suit upgrade, and a hidden dash ability. You may find some planetoids are more dangerous than others. The final challenge may be impossible to beat with just a gun, but you may find another solution along the way. Mouse and Keyboard Supported.

rows.name: Narava RPG
rows.short_description: Explore a magical open world crafted by a passionate developer. Battle using weapon skills or magic and evolve your character throughout your adventure.
rows.description_html: -- Game in other language soon -- Dive into a fantastic universe called ' Narava ' and thwart the plans of a tyrannical king by completing quests and mastering elements, skills, trades, and abilities. - Unlock your chakra and elements such as fire, water, air, and earth, and learn skills such as: o Multi-cloning. o Earth wall. o Air strangulation. o Flame breath. o Thousand water needles. o Throw kunai and shuriken, and much more. - The more you use a skill, the better you will master it, increasing its damage, reducing its cooldown time, etc. - Unlock and improve your proficiencies such as agility, vitality, boxing, etc., as well as trades, and use your points wisely to customize your character to your liking. - Complete quests by helping the people to gain experience and level up. - Collect resources and craft items including equipment, with characteristics that will make you stronger and more resilient. - Destroy the environment. - When you die, it's not over. Your ghost will have to recover its body. - Dodge or parry attacks! - Time passes in Narava with a day and night system. - Save your game at any time, even when you are dead.

rows.name: Project N.E.X.T
rows.short_description: 'Project N.E.X.T: A dynamic 3D shooter where Red and Blue teams battle across shifting realms from quaint villages to vibrant cities. Face off in modes like Deathmatch and Survive, with an added twist of zombies. Strategy and skill reign supreme!'
rows.description_html: Welcome to 'Project N.E.X.T,' In this world, players engage in intense team battles, with the Red Team and Blue Team clashing in ever-changing settings. From quaint fictional villages to the mysterious city of Bazaar, the vibrant Dragon City, and the typical hustle and bustle of a train station, players strive for ultimate victory in environments that constantly shift in both time and space. This game offers not just traditional team deathmatch modes but also introduces innovative gameplay modes like capturing and surviving, where strategy and skill are paramount. Adding to the excitement, some modes feature zombies, bringing unexpected challenges to the battles. Good luck, as victory will only favor the bravest and smartest.

rows.name: Exiled Survivors
rows.short_description: Dive into the heart-pounding world of Exiled Survivors! Experience relentless action, shape your destiny through strategic choices, and face monstrous foes. Unlock up to 30 characters, conquer bosses, and revel in the perfect blend of Vampire Survivors' intensity and Diablo's depth!
rows.description_html: Experience the relentless thrill of Exiled Survivors! Engage in fast-paced action, shape your destiny with strategic choices, and confront formidable monsters and bosses. Unlock up to 30 characters as you embark on an epic journey through this adrenaline-fueled adventure. Key Features : Fast-Paced Action: Jump into the action immediately for an adrenaline-pumping gaming experience. Player-Driven Variety: Your choices shape the gameplay, even amidst the randomness of each session. Bite-Sized Gaming: Enjoy engaging sessions lasting 15-20 minutes, perfect for casual and intense play. Monstrous Challenges: Confront interesting monsters and formidable bosses. Continuous Progression: Unlock levels and characters at your own pace, turning every session into a step forward in your gaming journey. Note: Some in-game images were originally generated by an artificial intelligence and subsequently modified for artistic enhancement. The fusion of AI creativity and human touch results in unique visual elements that contribute to the immersive experience of Exiled Survivors.
rows.about_html: Experience the relentless thrill of Exiled Survivors! Engage in fast-paced action, shape your destiny with strategic choices, and confront formidable monsters and bosses. Unlock up to 30 characters as you embark on an epic journey through this adrenaline-fueled adventure. Key Features : Fast-Paced Action: Jump into the action immediately for an adrenaline-pumping gaming experience. Player-Driven Variety: Your choices shape the gameplay, even amidst the randomness of each session. Bite-Sized Gaming: Enjoy engaging sessions lasting 15-20 minutes, perfect for casual and intense play. Monstrous Challenges: Confront interesting monsters and formidable bosses. Continuous Progression: Unlock levels and characters at your own pace, turning every session into a step forward in your gaming journey. Note: Some in-game images were originally generated by an artificial intelligence and subsequently modified for artistic enhancement. The fusion of AI creativity and human touch results in unique visual elements that contribute to the immersive experience of Exiled Survivors.

rows.name: Quizz
rows.short_description: Call your friend and start engaging in a simple and cozy experience while discovering all the questions that wait for you. Quizz is a game for everyone, having multiple question domains I am sure that some will fit you. Test your knowledge and luck to be the number one in the lobby.
rows.description_html: Quizz is a simple game where you answer questions from a large variety of domains. The main aspect of the game is our multi-player part where you can connect with 7 more friends and start exploring all the questions that we prepared for you. With over 9 domains I am sure that some will fit you, but if you want you can play random sets of questions from all domains. If your friends are busy, you can try the single-player part of the game where you will try to answer correct as many questions as you can. And don't worry if you get a wrong answer, when you finish the domain you can go back and re-answer the wrong ones.

rows.name: PEPITA VIAJERA ARCTIC
rows.short_description: Pepita Viajera travels and lands in the Arctic and needs to recover the pieces of her plane. Help her recover the pieces by properly answering the questions that will be asked and avoiding multiple obstacles in this educational platform game.
rows.description_html: Pepita Viajera Arctic is an action-adventure platform game whose protagonist is Pepita Viajera. Pepita Viajera travels around the world, she is an adventurer, she loves nature and the people of all continents. She travels on her airplane but sometimes everything doesn't go as expected. Help Pepita Viajera recover the pieces of her plane, which she lost when she landed unexpectedly in the Arctic . Avoid obstacles and reach the Inushuck in each phase to answer the questions that will help you recover the pieces of the plane and allow Pepita Viajer a to continue her journey around the world.

rows.name: With Shining Eyes
rows.short_description: Uncover secrets, experience history, solve puzzles and understand one another. Immerse yourself and explore a surreal and colorful world in this short, first-person adventure.
rows.description_html: You’ve been invited to join an illustrious academic institution. Since its founding, Bellamy Academy has encouraged curiosity in its students and ambition from its headmasters. Throughout the years, additions have been built, secrets have been buried, and architecture and memories have become one. During your time at Bellamy Academy, you will explore classrooms, solve puzzles, and experience the history of the current headmaster and former student, Anya Ashby. Key Features With Shining Eyes is a free game and always will be. Solve casual puzzles in vibrant and surreal classrooms filled with surprises and secrets abound. A short but densely packed experience, can be completed within 20 to 40 minutes. Relaxing music and scenery around every corner.

rows.description_html: The easiest game you're ever going to play. Or is it? Keep doing Something as the timer goes up. If you do Nothing, you lose. If you don't like doing Something, go play Nothing instead.

rows.name: FROM THE GROUND
rows.short_description: FROM THE GROUND is a third-person PvP Multiplayer shooter. Play as juicy characters and face off yourself on the battlefield in a wacky universe.
rows.description_html: FROM THE GROUND is a third-person multiplayer PVP shooter set in a cartoon world where fruits and vegetables have taken over the world. In this game, you play as one of 12 characters, also called 'Juicers,' along with other players in a variety of game modes. Varied Environments Fruits and vegetables are not just simple foods you harvest from a field, but living beings that now dominate the world. These quirky beings call themselves 'Juicers,' and they have only one thing in mind: fighting each other. They clash in varied environments; farmlands, military bases, and undergrounds are part of their playground. Nothing can stops them. Once they choose an area, the juice starts flowing ! Fruit Salad Face off against other players in a free-for-all game mode where each elimination earns you a point. The winner of the game is the player who reaches the maximum score limit or who has the highest score at the end of the allotted time. Team Death Match Face off against other players with your team until you have eliminated them all. The winner of the game is the team that reaches the maximum score limit or who has the highest score at the end of the allotted time.

rows.name: Cumdy
rows.short_description: You've caught some holiday creatures up to no good! Thanks to your magical handcuffs, you stopped them before they could cause any trouble. Charm these creatures by combining candies in this satisfying mix of puzzle and strip games!
rows.description_html: Cumdy is a stripping game where folklore creatures remove clothing and grow to like you as you combine candies. Whether it is a werewolf or the Horror of December himself, Krampus , they are at your mercy thanks to your magical handcuffs! Features 🍬 Quick and casual runs of around 10 minutes 🍭 A playground where you can rewatch unlocked scenes 🐺 Two creatures (with more planned for upcoming holidays) 🎀 Themed artwork and candies matching each holiday 🧁 Trick buttons if you are having a hard time and need to get to the juice quicker! 🏅 Steam achievements ☁️ Unlocked scenes and best score saved on Steam Cloud

rows.name: Super Cloud Fight
rows.short_description: Super Cloud Fight allows you to experience a unique way of aerial combat with customizable planes, special combat maneuvers and powerups. Play with AI bots, friends or competitors!
rows.description_html: 🎉 Special Announcement: Super Cloud Fight Demo is LIVE! We’re thrilled to announce that the Super Cloud Fight demo is now available on Steam! In this early version, you can jump in and Play vs AI to get a taste of the action. Keep in mind, this is a work-in-progress demo — so you may encounter some bugs along the way. We’re eager to hear your feedback and appreciate your patience as we continue to improve the experience. 🛠️ Coming in the full release : Play vs Friends – battle it out in private matches Play vs Competitors – face off against challengers from around the world Thank you for supporting us during development. Stay tuned, and get ready for even more cloud-powered chaos! ☁️⚔️ About the Game Welcome to Super Cloud Fight, a battle royale game where having fun is more important than winning. Gear up, goof off, and dive into the wildest ride where powerups and laughter reign supreme! Challenge your skills and reflexes in this mesmerizing aerial ballet with your friends, where every twist and turn is a step towards becoming the ultimate airborne champions. Meet the wildest squad in the clouds! Super Cloud Fight’s silly spirit animals, like the tiger, panthers, and one speedy rabbit (and more to come) — are here to bring the fun and fluff to every sky battle! Why blend in when you can paint the skies? Customize your planes with bold colors and textures that show off your style and make your mark in our community! The jet stream allows the player to recharge the plane and take a quick break from the dogfighting. Boost your gameplay with a variety of powerups to gain the upper hand much like Super Mario Kart. Zoom in for precision strikes or zoom out for the chaos! Master the skies with dynamic zoom and see your victories up close! The throttle system lets you chase or evade enemies for adrenaline-pumping action supported by a radar view. SkyPoints allows you to track your performance as a pilot. Earn more to unlock new characters and levels! Wishlist now to stay up-to-date with the latest development updates and be the first to know when Super Cloud Fight releases. Join our community and get access to exclusive beta play sessions where you can help shape the game.

rows.name: Titan Revenge
rows.short_description: Set in the vast expanse of Norse mythology, this MMORPG thrusts you into a world on the brink of apocalypse. As an intrepid hero, you must navigate the realms of the Aesir and Vanir, battling fearsome giants, mythical beasts, and treacherous gods.
rows.description_html: [Unlock Equipment Sets for a Rapid Growth] Class Advancement will offer you more equipment slots and equipment sets. Every equipment can be enhanced, polished, and strengthened further with Lucky Binding and Superb Promotion. Exclusive attributes and set appearances will also be available when all equipment of the set is collected. [Hundreds of Customization Options] There are hundreds of beautiful skins of different styles in Titan Revenge. Show your personality by customizing your avatar and 'dressing up' your character, pets, mounts, artifacts, and putting on the Hagios and the Necro Barrier! Be reborn to the amaze of all and awake your inner power! [Ideal Drop Rate for Valuables] The drop rate of the Superb equipment in the game is fair for everyone. Titan Revenge distinguishes itself from other games by having a unique Boss reward mechanic: Equipment, skins for wings, pets and artifacts all have a good chance to drop in the battle. The more bosses you challenge, the more you get! In addition, you will be also rewarded with equipment and skins by participating in events and by completing the main quests, VIP quests in the early stage. [Recycle Repeated Equipment] Repeated low-end equipment can be recycled for in-game currency in the Inventory. The repeated high-end equipment can be consumed to increase the success rate of the Superb Promotion for the equipment in use. In short, every equipment has a purpose. Challenge Bosses often to get more! [Ethereal System] Transform yourself into an Angel or a Titan to unleash powerful skills. Both your damage and HP will be incredibly increased! Transforming at the right time can turn the tide of battle at a critical moment. [A Magical Social World] You can build relationship with other players through multiple social systems: Destiny, Friends, and Alliance. In the game you are allowed to marry another player, or team up and assist others in battles. Get tired of solo gameplay? Start your journey in Titan Revenge! [Classic and Creative Gameplay] This adventure is accompanied by an exciting story! Choose your class: Knight, Mage, or Archer, and hone your skills to earn yourself a place in this magical world. Archangel Sword, Special Ring, and the Dragonslayer gear can help you boost your BR significantly. [Thrilling Battles] Take part in thrilling battles in Cross-server Arena, Imperial War, and Archangel War. There are multiple battle modes available, including 1v1, Guild battles, and Cross-server Faction battles. You can team up in real time and use the advantages of each class wisely to win, or fight solo to the top of the throne.

rows.name: CRAZY DOG DEMO
rows.short_description: 'CyberDog' is a fast-paced multiplayer skating battle game. Defeat rivals and become the champion with strategy and skill. Compete online for endless excitement!
rows.description_html: What's this game？ 'CyberDog' is an exhilarating casual multiplayer battle game that lets you unleash your combat passion in the arena! The core gameplay revolves around players skating around the arena, disrupting opponents, and picking up power-ups in intense showdowns. Discord Server QQ Group 637516728 What can i expect？ In the game, you'll control your character's movement in diverse arenas, using skating skills to dodge enemy attacks and cleverly utilize obstacles to protect yourself. You can collect various fun items, then use them to target opponents and engage in fierce battles. How to win？ The objective is straightforward: defeat all opponents and become the ultimate victor! Each time you hit an opponent, they get eliminated, but beware, as you could become someone else's target. 'CyberDog' blends strategy, reflexes, and skills, offering an unparalleled adrenaline rush. Whether you're playing with friends or competing online, this game promises endless entertainment and challenges. Show off your skills and become the champion of arena skating battles!!

rows.short_description: A game of bouncing snow rabbits!
rows.description_html: Control the snow rabbit 'Yuki-Usa' to reach the top of the stage! Cute ornaments will appear on the stage as Yuki-Usa bounces around. Let's proceed while decorating the stage! The snow bunnies bounce around so much that you may fall off the stage. But that's no problem! This game has a respawn function. Don't give up and aim for the top!

rows.name: Zomcats Invasion
rows.short_description: Zomcats Invasion is a coop online multiplayer game! Play with up to 10 friends and fight endless hordes of Zomcats! Choose between a variety of maps, difficulties and weapons. Unlock abilities and customize your cat to fit your style!
rows.description_html: Zomcats Invasion Originally created in 2021 as 'Zombie Kittens' its coming back in 2024! Completely remade with better graphics, animations and smoother gameplay! Its made by ONE person... me! With musical help from DJ Flow'n Zomcats Invasion is a 2D birdview zombie shooter. Play with up to 10 friends online and fight endless hordes of Zomcats! (Zombie + Cat) Play alone or play with randoms or play with your friends, the choice is yours! Earn cash (not real cash) by killing Zomcats to buy weapons and ammo or to buy a door open. Barricade the doors to keep the Zomcats out or to give yourself some time. Fight different Zomcats who have different abilities and who get stronger after each wave you complete. Have fun in the random mutator waves that can be good or bad for you. Buy new weapons to fight the dead. Choose between a variety of maps and difficulties. Choose a class to play and collect xp to unlock new buffs. Find cool cosmetics to customize your cat with. Create your own cosmetics and upload them to the Steam Workshop. People can upvote your cosmetics and if your cosmetics will receive enough votes it will get added into Axe's Shop! How much will this experience cost? NOTHING! ITS FREEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE! (This game contains flashing lights!)

rows.name: The Sumerian Game
rows.short_description: A game of strategy and management. The Sumerian Game is one of the earliest computer games. Developed and programmed between 1963 and 1965, it was designed to teach children math, economy and ancient history. The source code was lost but now you can play it again.
rows.description_html: Between 1962 and 1965, some classes of students in New York were involved in an innovative research project. The goal was to create a new teaching method without teachers, using powerful computers, automatic systems such as slide projectors, and the playback of recorded audio lessons. At the conclusion of the lesson, a 300-baud modem connected a powerful mainframe, costing tens of millions of dollars at the time, to a teletype under the students' control. The teletype printed long texts on continuous paper rolls, forcing the students to make difficult decisions on how to manage scarce resources to feed the population and plant crops for the next season. It was the Sumerian Game, the ancestor of all strategy, management, and city simulation games. The Sumerian Game, which was lost for 60 years, has been rebuilt and is now playable. Manage your grain, store it to withstand harsh seasons and natural disasters, grow your population, and expand your settlements. Find the best balance between people and food, or between arable land and cultivated fields. You have ten years to expand your city and save it from extinction. If the population drops to zero, the lesson is over. Call the teacher.

rows.name: Fightland
rows.short_description: Mysterious cosmic forces have created the Fightland, and they’ve plucked warriors from across space and time to do battle there. Join with up to 100 other players in this massive team battle arena game where individual skill, squad tactics, and overall teamwork will determine the victor!
rows.description_html: Mysterious cosmic forces have created the Fightland, and they’ve plucked warriors from all across space and time to do battle in this fun, frantic action combat game. Split into 4 teams of up to 25 players each to scout for advantage, defend your positions, conquer objectives, and emerge victorious! From the makers of Bloons TD 6 comes a brand new IP and brand new game genre - the massive team battle arena game. We love MOBAs, Battle Arenas, and team combat games, and Fightland's goal is to keep the large team combat intensity high for the whole match. Whether you are playing offense or defense, your team needs your individual skill and excellent squad coordination to deliver victory. CONSIDER YOUR STRATEGY Three dynamic victory conditions keep gameplay fresh and varied: - Last Base Standing: defend your base while effectively striking the other 3 enemy bases - Crystal Carry: escort precious crystals to your base but be aware there are two crystals in play at once - can your team defend and deliver both? - Fightzone: capture and hold a single territory that shifts to varied map positions but remains the single point where all teams converge to fight in huge hilarious scrums CHOOSE YOUR CLASS Going the Brute path gives you access to heavy-hitting, crowd-clearing weapons. With Rogue, you are fast on your feet, delivering quick, precision attacks. As a Mage, you can damage enemies at range, heal your allies, or join the fray directly! BUILD YOUR LOADOUT Each of the 3 classes has bespoke Secondary items and armored Outfits to further specialize your build. Secondaries focus on defense and crowd control, and Outfits enhance one or more stats for fun combinations with Weapons and Secondaries. MASTER YOUR WEAPONS Upgrade your base weapons to Mastery level, which evolves functionality in at least one key area. Mastered Weapons are balanced as a group, and their different specialties unlock new playstyles and stunning new visuals. Enough reading - time for fighting! In Fightland! See you in the skirmish! ********** Ninja Kiwi Notes: Fightland is free to download and play, and all in-game items and levels are available to unlock via in-game play and in-game currency collection and rewards. Please note that all items can also be fast unlocked using in-app purchases using real money. Please review our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. You will be prompted in-game to accept these terms in order to cloud save and protect your game progress.

See you in the skirmish! ********** Ninja Kiwi Notes: Fightland is free to download and play, and all in-game items and levels are available to unlock via in-game play and in-game currency collection and rewards. Please note that all items can also be fast unlocked using in-app purchases using real money. Please review our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. You will be prompted in-game to accept these terms in order to cloud save and protect your game progress.

rows.name: Synthetic Fantasy;
rows.short_description: A 'Visual Novel Play' about the nature of love and relationships! Caught between his fiance and an android, Dan Garland must make a choice that will change lives forever.
rows.description_html: Do you feel lonely? Observe this story as a member of the audience and witness this tale of love and friendship and find out the answer to the ultimate question: Can YOU learn to love? This is the question the protagonist, Dan Garland, will learn the answer to as he is caught between his fiance and an android . Hopefully you will be able to answer that question too, player. Features: Multiple endings to obtain Several CG's to enjoy throughout the story Cast Talk-back after obtaining all endings Several achievements to earn You'll learn to love (hopefully!)

rows.name: Welcome To Eden
rows.short_description: Welcome To Eden is a narrative driven adventure RPG set in a utopian city, Eden. Take on quests to help your fellow residents, while learning about the more secretive side of Eden in this psychological adventure. And maybe, just maybe, everything isn't as it seems...
rows.description_html: Welcome To Eden! Eden is a Utopian city where all things are perfect, simply as they exist. Play as the main character Drakely, as they suddenly arrive at Eden unbeknownst to how they got there. Meet your fellow residents and neighbors of your new home, as you explore this open world city. Take on quests to help your fellow residents, in order to do your part in helping maintain this utopian society. As you progress through the story and as you earn more responsibility in Eden, a mystery begins to unfold, and it is solely up to you to solve what exactly is happening. And just maybe, things have not been exactly as they've seemed all along... Welcome To Eden Part 1 is set to release this December 2024! EXPLORE THE OPEN WORLD OF EDEN Welcome To Eden is a non linear story taking place in the open world city of Eden. Quests can be done in a variety of orders, as you are free to explore from the beginning and set off on this adventure at your own pace. TAKE YOUR PLACE IN THIS UTOPIAN SOCIETY Mingle with the fellow occupants, and be the good friendly neighbor that it takes to help maintain the blessing Eden is. TAKE ON QUESTS IN THIS PSYCOLLOGICAL ADVENTURE Welcome To Eden is a Narrative and Quest driven game. In this non linear adventure, progress through the story in an order of your choosing, as you uncover the mysteries of Eden. SIDE QUEST ADVENTURES AND COLLECTIBLES For those seeking extra adventures and for the completionists out there, take part in side quests and find collectibles throughout the city.

rows.name: DarkAndLight
rows.short_description: Use clues to power up generators, find weapons to kill zombies, and utilize items to escape the bunker maze!
rows.description_html: The game is about being trapped in a bunker with a zombie virus and trying to find a way out. You must find a generator to open the door, a flashlight to illuminate the dark bunker, and weapons to kill the zombies in order to make it to the exit. The generators must be put in order and often require a password to be entered as well. The clues to this are left to the player to find on their own. Guns and bullets are very important, so you'll also need to find items to kill the zombies along the way.

rows.name: Bugger Off!
rows.short_description: The fun and refreshing tower defense, tasked with controlling and commanding a squadron of specially trained frogs, your mission is to thwart the relentless bug invasion. Brace yourself, as each wave increases in difficulty with bosses that tanks damage for days.
rows.description_html: Bugger Off! is an engaging tower defense strategy puzzle game set in a world where insects have been magnified to colossal proportions by the Dr. Thaddeus Hopperdoodle. Players take the role of a rookie military frog trainer. Tasked with controlling and commanding a squadron of specially trained frogs, your mission is to thwart the relentless bug invasion. Players embark on a thrilling adventure across three diverse landscapes inspired by England, Egypt, and Japan, each with its own unique challenges. Features: Immersive tower defense that delivers its own unique twist to the genre Various bugs and insects to fight against! Different frogs with unique attacks and abilities! Incrementally difficult waves and bosses Upgradability of frogs RNG jumping of frogs, creating unpredictability Quirky, cartoony art style It’s fun and free! Easy for you to try Credits: Made by Ribbit Inc. : Áron Dexter: Product Owner/Designer & Implementation/Programmer Essi Venho: Lead Art & Narrative Khairulhelmy Hussain: Lead Tech (Programmer) & Publisher Santiago Sala: Animation & Scrum Master/UI Veikka Virtanen: Lead Designer & Q/A Music and Sound: Jaakko Kuorikoski, Laura Lindemann, Matti Mali & Mira Oja Background Art: Aleksia Mäntylä & Maia Thompson

rows.name: Fox Game
rows.short_description: Embark on a magical journey as a young fox in Harmony in the Wild, an enchanting open-world adventure where nature's balance is in your paws. Explore vibrant forests, navigate icy terrains and unravel the secrets of dying nature through various quests to restore harmony back to your new home.
rows.description_html: THIS IS AN OUTDATED PAGE, YOU CAN FIND OUR NEW BUILD AND PAGE FROM THE LATEST  ANNOUNCEMENT OR SEARCHING 'Harmony in the Wild' FROM STEAM! Welcome to an enchanting world of Harmony in the Wild . As a young fox, you'll roam a captivating open world through forest, arctic and ocean while mending the delicate balance of dying nature. During the adventure you learn new abilities and a power of transformation to help you restore harmony back to your new home. This game started as a product of game production students at Jamk with the help of composer Kai Tuominen . Features: Transforming fox​: Adapt to your surroundings by transforming into either an arctic fox or a red fox. Open-world exploration: Explore vibrant forests, navigate icy terrains, swim through vast ocean and unravel the secrets of a fading ecosystem. Various Main & Side Quests​: Embark on a compelling journey with various main and side quests, each revealing new abilities for you to use. Unique abilities​ such as: Gliding Swimming Charged Jump Freezing Telegrab Rock Smashing Adventurous Companions: Befriend a diverse cast of animal companions, each offering unique insights and assistance on your quest. Harmonious Gameplay: Enjoy a harmonious experience through a blend of exploration and narrative-driven gameplay, providing a peaceful yet engaging experience. Credits: Made by Lumo Creations: Valtteri Yli-Olli – Product Owner, Publishing, Audio, Business, Design Zsombor Faragó – Scrum Master, Programming, Publishing Jutta Mujunen – Programming, Implementation, World Building Charlie Anna Rosputnia – Programming, Testing Flavio Florovits – Programming, Testing David Vanderheyden – Programming, Audio Implementation Vasilina Kämppä – 3D Art Saara Kämäräinen – 3D Art & Implementation, Tech Art Jeremy LeBlanc – Visual Effects, Tech Art Sannina Salin – 2D Art, UI Design Aaron Wirenius – Design, Testing Kai Tuominen – Composer

rows.name: Last Minute Shopping
rows.short_description: Last Minute Shopping is a chaotic “first-person shopper” where players must face one of mankind’s most difficult tasks: Getting lost in a legally distinct furniture store. Filled to the brim with wacky physics, procedurally generated layouts, and Swedish!
rows.description_html: Welcome customers, to [REDACTED] furniture store! We’re thrilled that you’ve chosen to silence your inner shopping demons by becoming our customer! Feel free to explore our store to your heart’s content! Check out the upstairs area to find inspiration for your interior decorating journey, pick the product you wish to purchase, and check its price tag for the warehouse location! Then head downstairs, pick up a few loose items on the way, and finish your shopping spree at the self-serve warehouse! After you’re done, be sure to come again! Our store will always offer you a fresh experience, with a new combination of products to buy with each shopping spree! The more you spend, the more we’ll earn! Win-win! Just make sure not to leave your shopping till the very last minute! Shopping takes time, patience, and a calm mind, and doing this under time pressure is no simple task! Features Immersive shopping experience! Feels just like the real thing! 200+ products to purchase, each with its own ridiculous names and gags! Physics! Blow off some steam and cause as much mess as you want! Procedurally generated furniture stores! Just like the real thing! Tons of replayability! Swedish! Many jabs at capitalism and consumerism! It’s free! Your money is no good here! NOTE: Last Minute Shopping is a parody game! The game is not affiliated with any real-life company or property that isn’t listed in the credits!

rows.name: Damaaz the Barbarian Warlock
rows.short_description: Damaaz The Barbarian Warlock is a single player fast-paced Beat 'em Up action game with unique, comic style line art. Inspired by Sword and Sorcery, plunge into the dark fantasy world of Damaaz the Barbarian Warlock.
rows.description_html: Kill to kill more! After the mad Wizard Kings destroy Damaaz’s whole tribe with demonic magicks, the barbarian warlock is set on a path of revenge, bloody mayhem and destruction. Damaaz The Barbarian Warlock is a single player fast-paced Beat 'em Up action game with unique, comic style line art. Inspired by Sword and Sorcery, plunge into the dark fantasy world of Damaaz the Barbarian Warlock. The game was produced by students of University of Applied Sciences Jamk during the fall semester 2023 Features: As Damaaz the Barbarian Warlock you hack and slash your way through countless enemies on your quest. Combo attacks with the use of Light and Heavy attacks. Dash and run to avoid danger. Power bar combining both player health and skill stamina bar. Multiple enemy types to challenge your skills. Boss battle to overcome. Dynamic sounds utilizing Wwise. Original soundtrack. Original hand drawn comic style art and animations. Credits: Made by Team NothingToSay : Sami Villa : Product owner, Art Tony Eriksson : Coding, Testing Binh Lai : Coding, Business Ilkka Reponen : Design, Publishing Sannina Salin : Art Laura Suurla : Music Maia Thompson : Marketing, Art Mika Karhulahti : Music vocals Risto Koskenkorva : Music vocals Jaakko Kuorikoski : Sound effects Samppa Leino : Music Mira Oja : Sound effects Special thanks to: Aron Dexter : Choreography Urho Heinonen : Choreography Daniel Imbert : Audio implementation Tuomas Roininen and Digi & Game Center

rows.name: Spectacle: Worlds Unseen
rows.short_description: Change your surroundings in the blink of an eye. Wield powerful glasses that let you see and interact with the world in new ways. Spectacle is a surreal first-person puzzle game about observation, spatial reasoning, and lizards.
rows.description_html: Spectacle: Worlds Unseen is a cancelled project from 2023 that we have decided to release for free in its unfinished state. Because of this, players should expect to encounter mechanics that are not fully explained as well as some bugs. We are excited to see players engage with the strange world of Spectacle and are interested to hear your thoughts on what could have been. Hold either one of the mouse buttons down to blink or wink, thus changing and interacting with your surroundings. The buttons on your mouse act as your character’s eyes. Discover a spectacular world where sight is everything and nothing is as it seems. In Spectacle you switch between glasses that enable you to look at the world in different ways to solve the puzzles. Explore mind-twisting puzzles where observation, spatial reasoning, and line of sight are your best tools. Trip Space is a surreal universe where parallel spaces, perspective changes, and match cuts dictate how you perceive the world.

rows.name: Seasons of Rocco
rows.short_description: Help Rocco prepare for the winter season by gathering and sorting fruit at his Tree House in the autumn season. Plant new fruit trees in the spring season, to make sure Rocco has even more food next winter! A relaxing experience for cozy gamers who seek a delightful escape into the charming seasons.
rows.description_html: Step into the enchanting world of 'Seasons Of Rocco,' where nature reclaims its space, and a lovable raccoon named Rocco looks to you for guidance. In this cozy simulation, your goal is to assist Rocco in surviving the challenges of each winter. Explore Rocco’s world in 2 playable seasons; Autumn and Spring. Rocco's world is a tranquil haven, offering a peaceful escape for those who cherish relaxation over challenges. Immerse yourself in the soothing ambiance of nature's beauty, where seasons unfolds with its unique charm. Help Rocco gather fruit to prepare for the winter ahead. Discover the treasures scattered in the warm hues of autumn, and experience the joy of gathering nature's bounty. Explore through rustling leaves, gather fruit for Rocco and sort them at his Tree House! 🍂❄️ As spring arrives, plant the seeds collected during winter, and experience the joy of new life budding. Explore the blooming landscapes as nature awakens, bringing forth vibrant colors. Witness the beauty of renewal and growth in every corner of Rocco's world. 🌱☀️ 'Seasons Of Rocco' is more than a game; it's an invitation to unwind, explore, and create a harmonious world filled with heartwarming moments. Join Rocco and embark on a journey where the seasons become chapters of joy. About Vivid Visions Studios: Vivid Visions Studio was founded back in October of 2023, as part of our Bachelor program at the Rotterdam of Applied Sciences in The Netherlands. We're a team of 17 students, starting our very first game development project. For our debut in the gaming world, we aimed to bring more positivity into the industry. With 'Seasons of Rocco,' we're taking our first steps toward creating a wholesome gaming experience. We're excited to see what the future will bring!

rows.name: EBBIL: Alternative Bible
rows.short_description: In Heaven, mistakes have been made. In this story inspired by TMC, follow Archangel Gabriel through a trial of corruption and feigned purity as he explores celestial realms and the rekindling of lost friendships. Will you save the Heavens, or will you see them fall?
rows.description_html: Despite common belief, eternal peace does not reign in Heaven, and with each growing day, angels continue to find fault in their Eden. Raised above hellfire and below the bellowing bellies of serpents, the celestial world is no stranger to peril. See through the eyes of Archangel Gabriel as he traverses the three realms in a tale of estrangement and fear told through intricate, handmade artistry and creative storytelling. Navigate choices both promising and cursed to deliver desired endings and peculiar secrets as you uncover the convoluted mysteries of this world. The Story Making a deal with the Devil is never an easy feat; even more, it's a lesson hard learned . After having lost his wings in a terrible error, Gabriel sets out to hunt down Lucifer, his childhood friend, to force him to atone for his crimes against the Father. In times of devastation, join the story as the archangel struggles between his obligation and past, and decide his verdict for him. In each story, familiarize yourself with leagues of archangels, legions of demons, and clamors of fearful humans. The Heavens are falling; the choice is yours. And the Features Traverse three different storylines as you explore EBBIL’s diverse universe, are introduced to its compelling characters, and make decisions that impact your journey. Developed with simplicity in mind, EBBIL provides an easy-to-access yet captivating story, containing precise chapter selection and multiple save files in a kinetic style. With its simple user-friendly interface, beautiful art, animated scenes, and original OST, immersion is unbroken. As you’re left with smooth sailing, allow yourself to enjoy the intrigue and mystique of the story with no difficulty.

rows.name: my eyes deceive
rows.short_description: Set over the course of roughly a week, you play as a young girl who has been living in a shelter all her life. The outside world is infected with a deadly disease. Society is in chaos. Fortunately, your papa is protecting you.
rows.description_html: Set over the course of roughly a week, you play as a young girl who has been living in a shelter all her life. The outside world is infected with a deadly disease. Society is in chaos. Fortunately, your papa is protecting you. my eyes deceive is a first-person psychological horror experience that makes players question their perception and consider whether they can blame themselves in retrospect. FEATURING A twisted, dark, and engaging narrative that gradually unravels itself over the course of the experience. An experience where you uncover and interpret the story as you play. The power of deciding the child's fate. (multiple endings) ADDITIONAL INFORMATION Average playtime: 45 minutes (longer if both endings are desired) It is recommended to carefully pay attention to your surroundings and every word spoken. DISCLAIMER: Includes sensitive and distressing subject matter, including highly triggering elements such as suggested sexual abuse. It may be deeply unsettling to some players. Individuals who find disturbing content distressing or have experienced trauma related to these triggers are advised to refrain from playing.
