rows.name: The Witch's Cauldron Prologue
rows.short_description: The Witch's Cauldron is a narrative roguelike game about being a medieval witch. Grab your cauldron and get brewing. Love, curses, laughter, wisdom for sale! Do what thou wilt shall be the whole of the Law. At least before the inquisitors come around.
rows.description_html: FULL VERSION. In the full version you will find even more exciting stories, experiments and game mechanics. You will be able to discover 12 unique game endings and determine the fate of the entire kingdom The Witch's Cauldron: prologue – A small plot part of a simulator of a medieval witch from the young indie team Harvey Games. You are a witch living on the outskirts of a small medieval town with her cat. Potions are your tools of choice. With your cauldron you brew your way through the world. But you've got to keep your balance. On one side of the scales is the terror you bring. On the other - your fame among the people. If the scales are tipped too much, someone will definitely come for your life. But it doesn't really matter, for your soul was lost long ago. And the cycle will continue. While the shadow of the inquisition is yet far away, peasants, townsfolk and even the king himself are coming to pay their respects to you. Listen to their problems, learn their mysteries, unlock new recipes, and keep in mind that your benevolent or malevolent intentions will surely make a difference. Branching narrative. Meet a cast of weird petitioners with their incessant requests. Help them or follow your own agenda. Uncover secrets, play with people's fates or just make the cows sing. Potions you choose to brew for your visitors influence future events. Potion discovery. You begin knowing only a couple of basic recipes, but by experimenting with mixes you can unlock new ones. Not every problem can be solved with rat poison (but nothing stops you from trying). And no matter what gruesome end you've met in your last cycle, you get to keep all unlocked recipes. If you hit a block in your research, you can always ask for help, but are you ready to pay the price? Keep the balance. Don't let fame or fear get to your head. And remember: peasants have pitchforks and there's a lot of them. Plethora of endings. The multitude of potions and plot twists ensure high replayability. Some recipes, game mechanics and endings become unlocked only when certain conditions are fulfilled (like beating the main story or getting some game-ending events). A cat. You have one and you can pet him.

rows.name: No Strings Attached
rows.short_description: No Strings Attached is a puzzle platform thriller where you play as Pavo, a newly-sentient puppet, in a struggling circus. Marionette Pavo’s arms to swing, climb, and more to escape your Master’s true intentions.
rows.description_html: Created by passionate students at the University of Utah. Dive into No Strings Attached , a puzzle platform thriller where you play as Pavo, a newlysentient puppet trying to escape from an abandoned circus. Marionette Pavo’s arms to swing, climb, and more as you are guided by a mysterious Blue Light to the Big Top. Unravel your Master’s true intentions in this captivating, Pinocchio-inspired adventure. MARIONETTE THROUGH PUZZLES Raise Pavo’s arms and use the push and balance poses to navigate the puzzles you will encounter along the way. EXPLORE THE CIRCUS Explore the Puppet Master’s struggling circus where Pavo and other creations were created. UNCOVER YOUR MASTER’S SECRET Find out what actually goes on in Puppet Master’s circus and what will happen when he finds one of his creations is sentient.

rows.name: MechAvenger
rows.short_description: MechAvenger is a fast paced VR shooter and platformer about fighting robots after the end of humanity. Shoot, punch, jump and climb your way through the enemy horde, and shut down their factory.
rows.description_html: MechAvenger is a fast paced VR shooter and platformer about fighting robots after the end of humanity. Shoot, punch, jump and climb your way through the enemy horde, and shut down their factory. Take down enemies with 9 unique weapons, using your quick reload belt to keep them firing! Bash your enemies with weapons and fists to knock them to the ground. The robotic horde is plentiful, but ammo is not. Search your environment for extra weapons and ammo. Kill stunned enemies with a melee hit for an ammo bonus! Navigate platforming sections by climbing and flinging yourself off walls. Swing with the grappling hook to cross long pits and build speed. Get yourself out of harms way with your servo powered dodge.

rows.name: Rogue Galleon and the Haunted Treasure
rows.short_description: Rally your band of rogues to battle the spooky monsters haunting the Pirate's galleon! In this top-down shooter + rogue-lite game, power up with temporary upgrades, then spend gold on permanent power once you fall in battle.
rows.description_html: The Galleon has been infested with spooky monsters! Rally your band of rogues to take them out and delve deeper into the cursed ship. Fight Rogue Galleon is a top-down shooter + rogue-lite, offering different characters and weapons you can use against various monsters. Each floor gets progressively harder; the further you go, the more monsters spawn, and stronger monsters will begin to appear too. At the end of each floor, you can pick from a selection of upgrades to power yourself up too. These offer increased DPS or survivability, or add some utility effect. Collect Every monsters has a chance to drop some amount of gold, but the most lucrative rewards come from the Bonus Gold system. On floor 1 and every 5 floors beyond, you are given the 'Disciplined Heart' and 'Relentless Timer'. The Heart breaks if you take damage, and the Timer breaks if if a countdown runs out. If 5 floors are cleared with either one intact, a large sum of gold is rewarded, and each is reset. Unlock When certain conditions are met, a new playable character will unlock. Each character has a special ability and comes with a unique weapon as well. Weapons are not restricted to the character they come with, so experiment to find your favourite combo! Spend When you die, you are sent back to the Armoury and lose the upgrades you picked. But not all is lost - you keep some of the gold you found. This gold can be spent at merchants to unlock permanent power - this is how you get further and further into the game. These unlocks can increase the gold you gain, let you take more upgrades, power up certain characters, and much more. Progress The further you go, the more gold you can earn. The more gold, the more unlocks. The more unlocks, the further you can go... but can you get far enough to uncover the source of the horde of monsters...?

rows.name: Shape of Clouds
rows.short_description: Keep calm and drag. Then drag some more. Find the right angle to reveal the hidden beauty. Relax and enjoy the amazing artworks you will discover.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Shape of Clouds, a captivating art game that challenges your creativity and spatial skills! Immerse yourself in a world of pixelated beauty where you embark on a unique journey to restore stunning pictures. Gameplay: In Shape of Clouds, your mission is to reconstruct intricate images by strategically rotating voxel pieces. This innovative puzzle experience combines the charm of traditional art with the excitement of 3D gameplay. Each level presents a canvas waiting for your touch, offering a refreshing challenge for your mind and a feast for your eyes. How to Play: - Select a level and observe the fragmented picture. - Click and drag to rotate voxel pieces until the picture is restored. - Enjoy the satisfaction of revealing the complete artwork. Diverse Themes: Explore a vast array of themes, from serene landscapes to vibrant cityscapes. Shape of Clouds takes you on a visual adventure through multiple levels, each featuring a distinct atmosphere and artistic style. Whether you're a fan of nature, architecture, or abstract designs, there's a puzzle waiting for you. 3D 360-Degree Perspective: Engage with the game in a way you've never experienced before. Shape of Clouds provides a dynamic 3D environment with a 360-degree perspective, allowing you to view and manipulate the voxel pieces from every angle. This adds an extra layer of immersion, making each puzzle-solving moment more enjoyable. Features: - Unique voxel art style - Intuitive controls for easy rotation - Relaxing yet challenging gameplay - Multiple levels with diverse themes - 3D 360-degree perspective for a truly immersive experience

rows.name: Museum Mystery: Deckbuilding Card Game
rows.short_description: Museum Mystery is a deck-building, story-driven roguelite adventure where museum exhibits come to life, wreaking chaos. Explore halls from different eras, battle works of art, collect your own deck of artifacts, and solve the mystery!
rows.description_html: Museum Mystery is a fusion between deckbuilding rogulite game and narrative adventure with intriguing secrets waiting for you to uncover. Your first night as a museum security guard takes a disastrous turn. Animated exhibits, awakened gods, and total chaos. And it’s your job to restore order until dawn. Explore Various Eras Museum halls are portals into history. Literally. Walk through each era, from Ancient Egypt to the 19th century, to find the roots of what’s happening. Battle With Unique Enemies Museum exhibits have come to life. And most of them are mad. Try to calm down this amazing pieces of art. Master Hundreds of Cards Find cards of ancient artifacts or practices. Combine them, unlock new mechanics and craft your perfect hand. Adventure Through History and Art Talk with historical figures, complete side-quests and help legendary characters! Features 4 historical eras to explore 150+ cards to create the best deck possible Unique relics that give unprecedented power Can you solve this Mystery?

rows.name: Red Planet Rampage
rows.short_description: A build-your-own-gun FPS! Play online, splitscreen or vs. AI in this goofy party game with over 600 unique weapons! Outbid your opponents and assemble the wildest weapon on Mars!
rows.description_html: Red Planet Rampage is a dieselpunk western-themed arena shooter where robots face off on Mars with wacky modular guns. Win gun parts in auctions and assemble a unique combination among hundreds of possible weapons! The game is developed by volunteers at Hackerspace NTNU and is free and open source! Lore The robots responsible for terraforming Mars have donned cowboy hats and started wreaking havoc with staged shootouts and competitions where they auction off rudimentary weapon parts assembled from scrap. Terraforming Inc. is still investigating the cause of this disturbance, but rumors point to a fateful upload of a western film. Features Modular weapons with wildly different parts; over 500 different combinations Auctions where players bid on these weapon parts Splitscreen and online multiplayer Fast-paced movement with rewarding tech Weapons Reload by playing a rhythm minigame or shaking a soda can Shoot bouncing cowboy hats Mount a frying pan at the end of your gun as a makeshift shield Slay your enemies in one hit with a rubber barrel that wiggles uncontrollably and more!

rows.name: Apathy In Our Stars
rows.short_description: Meet some aliens, make some money, and save the galaxy while you're at it!
rows.description_html: After being in cryogenic storage for 18,000 years, re-emerge into the galaxy and try to make a name for yourself! Buy your freedom, upgrade your ship, and save the galaxy from an all consuming hive mind! And maybe even more... Discover what the Tretsi look like! Why have the humans formed an alliance with a Spider race? Who keeps breaking the galactic speed limit near Rehbe? And why not get married while you're out and about in Juxin? Inspired by Star Trader and Star Control 2, explore the galaxy and find all it has to offer! 14 aliens to meet and talk with 5 different ships 14 upgrades to buy and 26 to earn in quests 9 main quests and 20 side quests 22 enemies to fight 3 varied endings 80,000 words of dialogue 24 unique songs Supports cloud saves, and can transfer save data between phone and PC 100% free and done as a hobby project!

rows.name: Holo X Break
rows.short_description: Fight your way through endless waves of holoX's minions! Gear up with all sorts of equipment and items in this action packed beat-em-up to reach the 5 bosses of hololive's 'holoX', and put a stop to their plans!
rows.description_html: It was your usual daily life over at hololive HQ in Holo City, until one day their CEO mysteriously disappears! Moments later, a nefarious organization who called themselves 'holoX, the Secret Society' announces their plans to take over the world! Play as the talents of the Vtuber group Hololive to fight your way through the minions of holoX and put a stop to their plans in this classic style beat-em-up! -Play as different talents of hololive, such as the talents of Generation 5's 'NePoLaBo', each equipped with their own unique abilities and super attacks! -Find various kinds of equipment that will change the way you play each time! -Use quick consumable defensive or offensive items to change the tide of battle -Fight action packed boss battles against the members of holoX -Up to 4 players local with online in an upcoming update -Easy to pick up and get right into the action -Challenge harder difficulties that will put your skills to the test! -The 'X' in the title is silent. Play as the talents of the Vtuber group Hololive to fight your way through the minions of holoX and put a stop to their plans in this classic style beat-em-up! -Play as different talents of hololive, such as the talents of Generation 5's 'NePoLaBo', each equipped with their own unique abilities and super attacks! -Find various kinds of equipment that will change the way you play each time! -Use quick consumable defensive or offensive items to change the tide of battle -Fight action packed boss battles against the members of holoX -Up to 4 players local with online in an upcoming update -Easy to pick up and get right into the action -Challenge harder difficulties that will put your skills to the test! -The 'X' in the title is silent. rows.name: Manor Madness
rows.short_description: You have been accepted to Polter High. As a ghost in training, you will learn how to scare people away from your assigned manor. At the end, it will be time for your final test before becoming a fully certified poltergeist.
rows.description_html: Manor Madness is a 3D, third-person sandbox game. In this game, you play a young ghost, Ghustav, who wants to learn how to become a real poltergeist. As a ghost, you can possess, throw, and interact with different objects around the house. Observe each visitor carefully to understand their fears and exploit them to make the humans’ blood run cold. Ghustav attends Polterhigh, the most prestigious school for poltergeisting. In the course Manor Madness, you will learn what it means to be a poltergeist and what abilities are at your disposal. In each assignment, your goal is to scare all the humans out of your assigned manor. Currently on sale, the manor is frequented by humans interested in buying the building and a realtor trying his best to sell the house. He needs to get creative in finding excuses for your spooky shenanigans. The realtor has a soothing effect on the other humans in the room. Distract him to maximize your scariness. Will you merely be able to send a shiver down their spine, or will you succeed in scaring their pants off? Your class starts now! Key Features Possess and interact with different objects Every room in your manor is equipped with unique objects for you to discover. Possess different objects and throw them across the room Interact with objects, flicker the light switch, or play an eerie melody on the piano Polter Sense Tap into your ghostly senses and see beyond the mortal realm. Use your Polter Sense to discover all the objects you can use.

rows.name: Striker Manager 3 - Online Football Manager
rows.short_description: Join the online Football Revolution and become the best Manager ever. Striker Manager 3 represents the nextgen of Football Manager games. Control all the management tools that Striker Manager 3 puts at your fingertips to take your team to the top.
rows.description_html: JOIN THE DISCORD About the Game CREATE YOUR LEGACY Striker Manager 3 is the best multiplayer football manager game that combines the fun of traditional football games with the ability to own your in-game assets. Generate income by trading your in-game assets, get your plot in the world of Striker Manager 3 and become the real owner of your club. . BUILD A FOOTBALL EMPIRE In Striker Manager 3 you are not just a player, you are a true owner and creator of your own world . Each user manages a unique plot where you can build from scratch whatever you want to make your plot grow in value and beauty. COMPETE AGAINST REAL MANAGERS Compete daily against real opponents from all over the world and climb to the top of the Striker Manager 3 league. Each season lasts two months and you will have to face promotions and relegations depending on your team's performance. You will also compete in the Striker Cup and you will be able to organize private leagues to play online soccer matches against your friends. SHOW YOUR TACTICAL SKILLS Make your mark and define how your team will play using the advanced tactical tools that Striker Manager 3 puts at your fingertips. Is your football style based on counterattacking or do you prefer to keep possession of the ball? Talented players or physical wonders? Show us your style of play. EXPERIENCE REAL TIME 3D GAME PLAY Our advanced match engine gives you the opportunity to feel every football match with passion and in real time . Take care of your fans and make them fall in love with your team to get great attendances at home matches. STRIKER PASS Striker Pass allows you to unlock rewards by reaching new levels (25 per season) of in-game experience. Rewards can be acquired through the free Striker Pass, or through the Striker Pass Exclusive (Reedem Ucoins). Reaching new experience levels will unlock a free reward (not all levels have free rewards) and, if you have the Striker Pass Exclusive, you will always unlock an exclusive reward in each level .

In a world where magic is gradually disappearing in favor of technological advances that threaten the balance, you play the role of the Elders, protectors of the continent. rows.name: The Bonerooms
rows.short_description: The Bonerooms is a goofy horror-themed multiplayer game about surviving in a living maze. What will be your downfall? The spooky inhabitants of the maze, or your fellow players?
rows.description_html: Bonerooms is a PvPvE multiplayer game about surviving in an ever-changing maze. Use an array of items to sabotage, deceive, and explode your friends as you fight to be the last one standing! Bonerooms is designed for 4+ players! For the best experience, gather some friends, put on headphones, and use the in-game VOIP! Online Play with up to 8 players A maze that is constantly changing 15+ Items to use to defend yourself or sabotage others Per-round maze modifiers to keep you on your toes Proximity VOIP Bonerooms can be played in one of three Game Modes: Try to be the last one standing in Free for All Outlast the other team in Red vs. Blue Work together to survive as long as possible in Co-Op!

rows.name: Droste Effect
rows.short_description: Explore the peculiar tale of Droste Effect, a captivating 2D puzzle game. Confront the mysterious past of your new home with Alexandra, uncover secrets, and manage your sanity in an intense adventure. Rediscover the power of memories as you dive into a past that will reshape your present.
rows.description_html: Embark on a mysterious journey with Alexandra , who moves to a charming Swiss countryside house. As Alex begins to settle down, she begins to notice strange happenings around her, like what she believes to be vivid dreams about the house's past. Alex will soon find herself forced to uncover the truth, living a bizarre adventure to find out more. Through the memories, Alex will realize that the distant past of the house is closer to her than she thought. Will she be able to escape and get her present back? Droste Effect is a 2D puzzle game with survival horror elements, created using Rpgmaker XP. Experience unconventional mechanics and embark yourself in immersive exploration through interactive minigames and classic puzzles . Look for hidden details and secret memories crucial to both puzzle-solving and understanding the plot. Be curious and observe your surroundings carefully. Immerse yourself in exploration through books, paintings, diaries and more Experience a mix of classic and interactive puzzles Manage survival elements such as sanity and flashlight Uncover a captivating storyline Discover all 4 epilogues in search of the true ending Try to complete the game through achievements and collectibles Unlock a secret extra gameplay Playtime: 2 hours minimum The DEMO is for demonstration purposes only of game mechanics. Storyline, mini-games and puzzles will be different in the full game although the style will be the same. DEMO playtime: at least 15 minutes

rows.name: VFurrika!
rows.short_description: VFurrika! is an addictive puzzle game that combines the charm of your favourite VFur streamers with strategic gameplay. Drop your favorite furry VTuber into a glass and witness them merging into other VTubers upon contact!
rows.description_html: About VFurrika! VFurrika! is an addictive puzzle game that combines the charm of your favourite VFur streamers with strategic gameplay. Drop your favorite furry VTuber into a glass and witness them merging into other VTubers upon contact! Gameplay The game is simple: Aim and drop randomly-generated VTubers heads into a glass. Have 2 of the same heads touch each other for them to merge into a bigger head of another type. This kind of gameplay allows combos to be made, but only if you’ve got skills! Once the glass is filled to the brim, the game is over, but you can upload your score to the Leaderboards. Try beating your friends’ scores! Features: Leaderboards Addictive Gameplay Recognizable Faces Cute Visuals

rows.name: Karos Classic
rows.short_description: The living legend returns in his original form! The Сlassic version of Karos. Rebirth, untouched by years and updates. Maximum level, sharpening level is limited.
rows.description_html: Karos. Rebirth: Classic Edition is a classic of the MMORPG genre, with an amazing fantasy world in which you will find the most unusual adventures. The variety of locations, a great variety of dungeons and monsters will make you plunge into this world headlong. The beloved world of Azmara, filled with the confrontation between Light and Darkness, returns in its classic form. This legendary version of the game has absorbed all the best things that Karos heroes have loved over the years. It will bring back your original gaming experience and give you the opportunity to take a personal look at the origins of the famous MMORPG and remember how it was used to be. Choose one of four original races, fight for a better future and write your name in the history of your native lands. FEATURES - An ideal opportunity to indulge your nostalgia for your favorite game, untouched by years and updates. ​ - Four unique races and many classes, each of which can be developed by choosing additional specializations. - Intuitive game: no difficulties in mastering. - PvP at every turn: castle sieges, mine captures, endless battles in the open world. - Variety of PvE content: raid bosses, many dungeons of varying degrees of difficulty, which can be completed either alone or with a reliable team. - Interesting Flett system: get the energy of fallen monsters to create powerful equipment that will improve along with your character. - Mounts turn into beautiful accessories when you walk, and your little pet friends are able to grow and develop. - Low system requirements. Years passed, Karos changed, became better, updated. Today, many things look completely different from those in the distant years when we were just launching this legendary MMORPG. And now we are pleased to present you Karos. Rebirth: Classic Edition. It will take you back to the very beginnings of the Karos world and show you what the game looked like at the time of its inception.

rows.name: Seeds of Paradise
rows.short_description: A mini side story set in the same universe as 'Sylvie's Bar' featuring a different flavor of monster girl brothels. You play an overworked man who's all but run out of luck, but the sadistic strawberry girl who keeps the business running may just take pity on you, yet.
rows.description_html: / A linear mini visual novel that takes place in a monster girl brothel set in the same universe as 'Sylvie's Bar.' You play the role of a nameless, overworked man who's come to town just in time for the 'Fruits of the Forest' special. The time of your life awaits you with any of the lovely monster girls of the garden-grown variety, who will make you forget all about your worries and fretting. However, you quickly find that you're too late, and the girls have all gone home for the night. But, the owner seems to have taken pity on you, and maybe things will work out for you, in the end. Welcome to 'Seeds of Paradise.' We hope you enjoy your stay.

rows.name: Brutal Ball
rows.short_description: Brutal Ball is a retro-styled shooter-sport hybrid where players can kill each other with gauntlet weapons or giant controllable spiked balls of destruction. Players strive to work together and dominate a match scoring goal after brutal goal.
rows.description_html: Brutal Ball is a multi-perspective option shooter that is also a deadly sport set on far away bizarre alien arena locations. Each team has a two meter tall spiked ball that can be controlled and thrown. In addition to its deadly spikes, the ball’s electric field will damage players if any contact is made. The ball will decrease in size depending on how many kills a team has. As the spiked ball shrinks, the ball becomes a more effective weapon and easier to shoot goals with. Oh yeah, players can also shoot their opponents if that is what they are into. Four different gauntlet weapons that cater to different play styles are available to choose from. Points are given for goals, and from traditional kills. Player motivation: As a hybrid, Brutal Ball has the strengths of both multi-view shooter and regular team-sports games. The game offers players a competitive environment with team building elements in addition to kill or be killed action. Outsmarting the opponent is key. To thrive, teammates must coordinate plans and execute them to be successful. Anyone who has ever been on a team knows: the bonding that comes from working as a team makes victory even sweeter. Plus, who doesn’t like killing opponents in different and exciting ways?

rows.name: From Nava
rows.short_description: Uncover the secrets of an abandoned research laboratory by drawing patterns to cast powerful spells in order to escape a puzzle and monster-infested world.
rows.description_html: From Nava is a 2D action puzzle game, set in the remains of a mysterious laboratory. You are equipped with only a seemingly ordinary pen that possesses the extraordinary ability to unleash magic attacks by drawing specific patterns. You must escape from this abandoned research laboratory by gathering all the keys and polaroids left behind in the aftermath of an unknown incident. Navigate through all 9 sectors using spells learned from fighting enemies or interacting with nearby objects. Various monsters and puzzles are all that stand in your way from fulfilling a stranger's final wish and unravel the mysteries of the world and yourself. Features 2D Movement and Action Casting Spells by Drawing Specific Patterns Customizable Patterns 9 Areas 5 Secret Rooms 5 Main Spells Detailed Pixel Art Various Puzzles with Multiple Solutions Assortment of Collectables Achievements This game is best played with a mouse and keyboard.

rows.name: CLeM: The First Attribute
rows.short_description: CLeM: The First Attribute is a free prologue that offers the first loop of CLeM, a narrative-driven puzzle adventure game with a dark twist. Wake up in a world where puzzles intertwine with exploration, weaving a unique narrative rooted in alchemy.
rows.description_html: CLeM: The First Attribute is a free prologue that offers the first loop of CLeM, a narrative-driven puzzle adventure game with a dark twist. You awaken in a cold, dimly lit room, your senses slowly adjusting to the surroundings that, oddly, feel familiar. A strange sensation lingers in you, reminding you that something is not quite right. As you find your bearings, your attention is drawn to a peculiar item on the ground. A notebook labeled 'CLeM' lies before you. As you delve into its pages, covered with intricate sketches of insects accompanied by vague symbols, you find a note containing a cryptic message: “Bring me BEAUTY.” Lost in deciphering the contents, a voice interrupts your focus. Puzzles intertwine with exploration, weaving a unique narrative experience we call “Puzzlevania” with a shadowy story to unravel and countless challenges to overcome. Craft magic toys to unveil hidden secrets, access unreachable spots, and reclaim items from the past as you uncover new revelations in familiar spaces. Investigate a seemingly desolate house accompanied only by an obscure voice and a notebook full of annotations and drawings on alchemy, insects, and other creepy crawlies. Choose your fate in this dark story of manipulation, pride, forgiveness, and redemption. Features: A new genre, “Puzzlevania,” intertwines puzzles and exploration. Discover hidden secrets in each room as you delve deeper into the mysteries with every crafted magical toy. Unique and beautiful art style with hand-drawn elements. 2D graphics with 3D environmental navigation. Challenging and diverse puzzles to solve. An enigmatic story with a dark turn.
rows.about_html: CLeM: The First Attribute is a free prologue that offers the first loop of CLeM, a narrative-driven puzzle adventure game with a dark twist. You awaken in a cold, dimly lit room, your senses slowly adjusting to the surroundings that, oddly, feel familiar. A strange sensation lingers in you, reminding you that something is not quite right. As you find your bearings, your attention is drawn to a peculiar item on the ground. A notebook labeled 'CLeM' lies before you. As you delve into its pages, covered with intricate sketches of insects accompanied by vague symbols, you find a note containing a cryptic message: “Bring me BEAUTY.” Lost in deciphering the contents, a voice interrupts your focus. Puzzles intertwine with exploration, weaving a unique narrative experience we call “Puzzlevania” with a shadowy story to unravel and countless challenges to overcome. Craft magic toys to unveil hidden secrets, access unreachable spots, and reclaim items from the past as you uncover new revelations in familiar spaces. Investigate a seemingly desolate house accompanied only by an obscure voice and a notebook full of annotations and drawings on alchemy, insects, and other creepy crawlies. Choose your fate in this dark story of manipulation, pride, forgiveness, and redemption. Features: A new genre, “Puzzlevania,” intertwines puzzles and exploration. Discover hidden secrets in each room as you delve deeper into the mysteries with every crafted magical toy. Unique and beautiful art style with hand-drawn elements. 2D graphics with 3D environmental navigation. Challenging and diverse puzzles to solve. An enigmatic story with a dark turn.

rows.name: Blast Them All
rows.short_description: Reload your weapon, the show's about to start! Blast Them All is a wave-based twin stick shooter where you face endless hordes of hungry zombies. Use your agility, pick up weapons and activate traps to defend yourself, build up your strength, collect points and reach the top of the leaderboard!
rows.description_html: SURVIVE ENDLESS WAVES. The growing waves of zombies challenge you and your dexterity. Keep your cool and put on a good show in the face of ever-increasing difficulty. ADAPT TO CHANGING ARENAS. At the end of each wave, the arena you survived fades away to make way for your next challenge. Take advantage of the new layout, weapons and traps at your disposal and try to survive. GO WILD AND SCORE MAXIMUM POINTS. Chain together elimination and ignite your gauge. Annihilate the zombies in your path and boost your multiplier before blasting your score. Push on and die proudly, with your name at the top of the leaderboard. STRENGTHEN YOURSELF DURING AND BETWEEN WAVES. Collect upgrades and take advantage of their contents to perform during the round. After each special wave, choose upgrades from the store and make good use of your reroll tokens to adapt your upgrades and push your survival further.

Dynamic Ecosystem – Watch your tank come alive with fish behaviors and interactions. Peaceful & Non-Intrusive – No stress, no pressure — just ambient chill. Fully Customizable View – Resize, position, and theme your aquarium to match your mood.

rows.name: Divine Twins
rows.short_description: Dual roles, open world adventure，be both hero and spouse.
rows.description_html: Indie Game, Open World, Dual-Character Development! Catch fish, hunt monsters, dash, jump, with diverse gameplay and elemental reactions involving fire, ice, lightning, and poison! Companion Dual-Character Features : In a sunset-lit courtyard, vegetable garden, stable—capture various pets, plant crops, fish, hunt, gather resources, raise pets, race, battle, explore, idle, trade, raid dungeons, treasure hunt, cook, craft... A complete gear system and totem gameplay enhance the adventurer's ultimate abilities! New dimensions and hellish corrupted demon dungeons await your challenge! Game Overview Built on a self-developed engine with a brand-new upgrade, enjoy seamless dual-character open-world adventures with even more freedom. Use various attribute-based explosive barrels to catch fish or hunt monsters. Jumping fruits let you leap into the air or dive into the sea—thousands of different items to use! Weapons can be freely combined, and dual characters can switch gender and profession anytime: Sword skills with fire attributes, staff skills with ice attributes, bow skills with corrosion attributes, blade skills with lightning attributes. Elemental Reactions: Fire + Ice = Steam Damage Fire + Poison = Burning Poison Damage Lightning + Corrosion = Overload Damage Lightning + Ice = Frostshock Damage Under the moonlight or in daylight, your companion dual-characters await. In a sunset courtyard, vegetable garden, stable—capture pets, catch fish, hunt, cook, gather resources, raise pets, race in pet competitions, experience elemental reactions, jump and fly, battle, explore, treasure hunt, idle, team up... This open-world game offers endless fun. Switch freely between characters, control any one of them. Adventure with your partner, watch the flowers bloom and wither together in this vast world...

rows.name: OrcinUS: Orca Pod Rescue
rows.short_description: Explore the sea and save the killer whales in this 'Endless Swimmer' game. Discover unique biomes, orcas, powerups, and more!
rows.description_html: Your pod has been captured by a cruel marine park - only you can rescue all the orcas to reunite your family! SWIM FOREVER In this 'Endless Swimmer' game, you play an orca swimming through the ocean, catching fish and avoiding dangers. The simple one-button controls are easy for anyone to learn! EXPLORE VIBRANT BIOMES Your journey starts in a beautiful coral reef, but the quest to save your pod from cruel SlamWharf will bring you across the seas. Discover new food (and dangers) as you progress on your missions. RESCUE YOUR POD Unlock 4 unique playable orcas - each has different skills, swimming stats, and personality traits. Bring your family together! COMPLETE CHALLENGES Through dozens of unique missions, master the seas to level up your character and unlock new sights. The challenge doesn't stop there - several stats are also tracked for each swim, so you can always increase your high scores. UNLOCK COOL POWERUPS Grab powerups from helpful bubbles to slow time, gain lives, shatter obstacles, and more! Catch 6 fish in a row and your orca will gain a special boost. Plus, as you level up, additional powerups become available, so there's always more to explore.

rows.name: Santa's busy day
rows.short_description: Santa has a hard time, delivering all his presents on time. In this little Arcade Game, you will help him fly over the roofs and drop the presents in the right spot. But be careful:The game gets progressivly harder, as Santa's reindeer is flying faster and faster and faster.
rows.description_html: 'Santa's Busy Day' is an atmospheric little arcade game . You control Santa's sleigh and fly over roofs, trees, churches, and more. The goal is to drop presents at the right time, so they fall into the right place. There are two modes in this game: Compete with players around the world. Who can drop the most presents without crashing into a building? This mode will get progressively harder and faster . For everyone who wants to enjoy the peace and atmosphere of Christmas. It's specifically designed to be relaxing. There's no score, and it doesn't get faster – just for you to enjoy. If you're not yet in a Christmas mood, maybe you will be because of this game. That's our goal.

rows.name: Notes To Myself
rows.short_description: The horror began when you wrote your first note.
rows.description_html: 'I'm writing to myself so they won't find my words...' Notes To Myself is a first-person horror game where you must navigate and escape from the embodiments of your worst fears. Pull switches, collect flashlights and run from demons in an unsettling world that exists between reality, your nightmares and your OS. So, you want to escape from the control of your keepers? Maybe the inspections have been getting a little 'too much' for you, or you wonder if you'll ever stop scratching the day counts into the wall/wrist? It ain't so simple, I'm afraid, since you are unable to function in the 'real world' and you've been sedated for so long it is impossible to tell what is real and what is fantasy. Well, let's break it down: when you are scratched, the scratch doesn't hurt, but you interpret it as pain, yes? So is this world, reality on the outside but the horrors of the world on the inside... or is it? Maybe all of those sedatives actually made you pass into the 'other world' where there really isn't any escape? Fortunately for you, the player can always reset the game , and maybe you'll be safe... or be trapped forever until the next update?

rows.name: AIMX
rows.short_description: Free, easy to use & efficient aim trainer. Improve faster!
rows.description_html: Free, easy to use & efficient aim trainer. Improve your aim on exercises made specifically for the game you wanna imrpove at! An aim trainer created by players. As passionate gamers with a strong desire to improve, we naturally became interested in aim training. After experimenting with various options, we realized that none of the existing aim trainers fully satisfied our needs. This is where the idea for AimX was born, a simple and intuitive aim trainer designed to provide players with exercises that are specifically tailored to the game they want to practice for. Players don't need 10'000+ exercises but only the ones that will help them improve the most. In the long term, AimX will analyze each player’s strengths and weaknesses to provide customized exercises. We want AimX to interact with its community in the way we wish all games would: listening to players, taking their feedback, needs and preferences into account to evolve in the right direction.

rows.name: SUPER LIFTPIA
rows.short_description: Pick up the enemy and throw it! This is an action game drawn with dots that gives you a nostalgic feel.
rows.description_html: Pick up the enemy and throw it! This is an action game drawn with dots that gives you a nostalgic feel. The difficulty level is set to low. The main character of this game, Lifton, is skilled at 'lifting up' his enemies. If you step on an enemy and flip them over, you can lift them up. Enemies can be lifted up in two layers. The lifted enemy can be swapped up and down with the up key. And you can throw the enemies in the lower row by pressing the X key. If you lift a specific enemy, that enemy may exhibit mysterious abilities. *This game does not use any text other than the title and staff roll.

rows.name: Dark Memories: Prologue
rows.short_description: Dark Memories is an episodic psychological horror game based on road thriller, slasher, and survival thriller genres. You are currently viewing the prologue episode of the Dark Memories anthology.
rows.description_html: About the Game Dark Memories is an episodic psychological horror game based on road thriller, slasher, and survival thriller genres. You are currently viewing the prologue episode of the Dark Memories anthology. Dark Memories: Prologue - Brenton Lake In the prologue episode of Dark Memories, you play as Benjamin, who is traveling to his friend Sarah's family house at Brenton Lake. As he enters the rural roads, weather conditions rapidly deteriorate and heavy snowfall begins. Benjamin finds himself alone on desolate roads, unaware of what this night has in store for him. The conditions that leave you vulnerable are filled with unpredictable dangers. The Prologue episode covers a small portion of the full story. Key Features Atmospheric environment and realistic graphics VHS film aesthetic Driving mechanics Dialogue and messaging system with NPCs Environmental interaction The prologue episode has an average playtime of approximately 15-20 minutes and aims to showcase the game's atmosphere and narrative approach.

Key Features Atmospheric environment and realistic graphics VHS film aesthetic Driving mechanics Dialogue and messaging system with NPCs Environmental interaction The prologue episode has an average playtime of approximately 15-20 minutes and aims to showcase the game's atmosphere and narrative approach.

rows.name: FADE^2
rows.short_description: FADE^2 is a 2D action game that brings platformer, runner and music interactive genre all together. A desperate journey of the reanimated one, and the storytelling of music from the bleached world. Run along the music, and play along the course!

Menu control : Mouse Game control : F (jump) / J (ground) Single Gem : short input, Long Gem : long input, hold until the line ends. Special Flower : collide to be harvested.

rows.name: The Bard for Her
rows.short_description: A visual novel, dating sim with map exploration. Play a womanizing bard with a lute and romance and build a relationship with five attractive women.
rows.description_html: You are a bard that enjoys a hedonistic lifestyle. Your conservative, disapproving uncle sends you off to an institution to rehabilitate you. He threatens to take away your inheritance if you refuse him. Without much choice, you decide to play along with his wishes. At the institution you'll meet several women, the other residents likewise sent there by family members. Get to know them and their stories, as you romance them, and find a way out of the institution. The game is a visual novel with map exploration. You'll play your lute and woo the ladies in various places around the map. Featuring five women with different looks and personalities, get to know each, as you build a relationship with them and perhaps a future.

rows.name: Tribes
rows.short_description: Dive into the future of gaming and wield your own arsenal of weapons against adversaries. Most importantly, revel in the chaos of possibilities that the weapons provide in this new type of game and have an absolute blast!
rows.description_html: Gear up for Non-Stop Action Join the action-packed world of Tribes, the low-poly First-Person Shooter by Block Bastards. Battle it out in beautifully designed arenas, armed with Interoperable weapons. Are you ready to dominate the competition? Use your own Interoperable Weapons — Elevate your gaming experience with Tribes. Unlock powerful weapons and bring them for a competitive edge like never before. With seamless interoperability, you can dominate in Tribes and beyond. So why settle for a standard arsenal? Bring your own weapons and emerge victorious. Explore all the different Tribes — Embrace the diverse cultures of the Rapper Tribe, the soulful Blues Tribe, the electrifying Metal Tribe, the laid-back Country Tribe and much more. Each tribe brings its own unique flair to the battlefield, offering distinct playstyles and aesthetics that will resonate with every gamer's preferences. Challenge your friends in different Game Modes — Experience the thrill of strategic teamwork and precision aiming in Capture the Flag. Dominate the battlefield alongside your squad in Team Deathmatch and test your individual mettle in Free-For-All battles! Defend your Tribe in all the different maps — Battle across a variety of maps, from the bustling parking lot to the lively festival map and the gritty docks in Shipyard, testing your mettle. Adapt, outsmart, and defend your tribe to victory!

rows.name: Onward and Upward! DX
rows.short_description: Climb from the Earth to the Moon to try and solve an urban legend! Brave tough challenges as you float and grapple your way up to the tune of a great soundtrack! Be sure to bring a space suit, and get climbing!
rows.description_html: Meet Lily, an energetic young lady with a love for exploration. One boring day at school, Lily looks up at the sky and begins to ponder. 'Is the moon really made of cheese?' Determined to find out, Lily sneaks out and tries her hand at some parkour using her parasol, to try to make her way up to the moon. Look, man, I don't know either. Help Lily make her way to the moon! There are four tough levels to overcome, each more difficult than the last. Float across deadly chasms, grapple your way through tight corridors, and make your way upwards! And for an extra challenge, you can try finding the big coins! Once you've perfected the main game, there's also an extensive cheat selection to spice things up! With its tight controls, colourful graphics and expertly-crafted levels, as well as a great soundtrack, this short yet addictive game is sure to keep you coming back for more! This game also features a simple yet robust level editor that allows you to make your own Onward and Upward! DX challenges! Create the exact setting you wish for your level, play it through and share it with the world using Steam Workshop! From clever puzzles to devilish gauntlets, there's always something new to play! Originally made for GBJam 11.

rows.name: Charrua Soccer - Mirror Edition
rows.short_description: Mirror Edition? Absolutely! Dive into the action and adrenaline you know and love from the Pro Edition, now face off against players online in both friendly and ranked matches through Mirror Online. Create your team, enhance it with every match, and progress until you reach the Elite league!
rows.description_html: This is CHARRUA SOCCER!, with the same action and adrenaline that you already know from the Pro Edition, in this edition, you can face other players in Mirror Online matches! Mirror Online? yes! this is something new in football games… two simultaneous matches, one overall score! Control your local team and direct your remote team. The combined goals decide the winner! A ranked game mode, in which while you directly control your local team, another version of your team, playing as the visitor, faces the opponent on the remote PC, following the strategy you define in advance. Both players will be aware of what happens in the remote match, even being able to view the replays of the best moments from each game. Create and lead your team to glory, competing in ranked mode or playing with friends. You can face your rivals alone or if you wish, you can even invite friends to play on the same team, a feature available by connecting locally or through Steam Remote Together. Mirror Online: An original mode- a new way to play and compete against remote opponents. Two Matches Simultaneously- Home and away games, with remote match event alerts! Control your home team- you face the rival team under the direction of your opponent. Manage your remote team- with your direction, your team will play against the rival. Evolve your team- by playing you will get XP to improve your stats. Ranked Leagues- start at the bottom and lead your team to compete among the best. Ranked Matches- find an opponent with similar skills to play mirror online. Friendly Matches- play Mirror Online matches against a friend. Cooperative Matches- invite your friends to join your team to face rivals. The connection of these friends can be local or through Remote Play Together. Store: Earn coins as you play to buy cool items in the store, like custom balls, flags, stadiums, and player cosmetics – think unique hairdos to dog costumes. The possibilities are endless! Link with the PRO Edition: Those who already own or plan to purchase the Pro Edition will also benefit from accessing their thematic items, stadiums, balls, etc., in Mirror Edition as well. The Mirror and Pro versions are linked, the coins earned in both editions are unified, as are the items purchased in either store. That is, if you need coins for an item that you want to buy in the Mirror store, you can also collect coins by playing the various game modes available in the Pro edition. Features: Intuitive yet challenging gameplay, perfect for all skill levels. Dual control modes cater to both casual and seasoned players. Customizable assistance – turn it on for help or off for a tougher challenge. Realistic soccer elements: fouls, cards, injuries, penalties. Options for women's, men's, and mixed teams. Variety of moves: passes, shots, and specialty skills like Chilean kicks. In-depth team management: formation, strategy, substitutions, and more. The Mirror Edition promises endless entertainment! Are you prepared to challenge friends or fight for the title of ultimate champion?

rows.name: Kona & Snowrabbit
rows.short_description: Kona, an ice artist with a reputation for mischief, and Snowrabbit, a white-furred snow rabbit full of desire. After hearing the story of Aquus, the mermaid goddess, the two down-on-their-luck artists break into the monastery of Aquus, nicknamed 'the sea on land,' to make a statue of a goddess.
rows.description_html: Kona, an ice artist with a reputation for mischief, and Snow Rabbit, a snow-white rabbit. After hearing rumors of the mermaid god Aquis, the two young artists set out to create the ultimate ice sculpture of the mermaid god and to break into the monastery of the mermaid god, known as the 'sea on land'. Quarter-view casual 'frozen' shooting action with a twist on the arcade genre. Cool 'Frozen' action Frozen Action Is A Must to Defeat Enemies! Your snobbish but reliable partner, Snow Rabbit, has the ability to freeze enemies by firing ice bullets. Once frozen, you can freeze them a second time to break them, or smash them with your hammer to send them flying! Nostalgic arcade gameplay We've included all the 'yummy' elements of the arcade genre! Intuitive controls with the attack button to attack and the dash button to dash, Stage-by-stage progression through rooms filled with menacing enemies, And an item that gives you access to a powerful attack for a brief moment! Personalized Comedic Elements Rabbit with ice coming out of its mouth is used as weapon and the rabbit turns into hammer, Enemies get frozen in the air and sink underwater, the protagonist is a villain who makes his enemies suffer... Enjoy the humorous atmosphere of this game with its comedic elements!

rows.name: Spark of Survival
rows.short_description: Defend your kingdom by fighting back against an approaching robot invasion. Place, upgrade, and relocate elementally-charged towers strategically to destroy incoming robots. Watch as elements collide and combine to create explosive reactions!
rows.description_html: Spark of Survival is a top-down 2.5D tower defense strategy game in which you must defend your kingdom against an incoming robot invasion using the five unique elemental towers at your disposal. Place, upgrade, and move towers strategically to form the strongest possible line of defense. Combine the effects of various towers to create elemental reactions that destroy the approaching robot army. Advance through increasingly difficult levels to finally destroy the robot leader once and for all. Key Features Unique elemental towers 25 tower upgrades Buy, move, and sell towers 16 types of enemies to destroy 3 levels

rows.name: Paws Trail
rows.short_description: 'Paws Trail' is an enchanting adventure game where players guide a charming black cat through a mystical forest and unlocking secrets along the way. Experience a vivid world filled with engaging challenges and endearing forest companions.
rows.description_html: Game Description: In this original adventure game, featuring a charming black cat as the protagonist, players will explore a beautiful forest, uncovering hidden secrets and unlocking mysterious doors. This game combines enchanting storytelling with gameplay that allows players to meet forest friends, and embark on new journeys with the cat. Key Features: 1. Enchanting Storyline: Follow the black cat on a mystical journey through the forest, meeting friends along the way. 2. Beautiful Graphics: A fantastical world filled with rich colors, lush forests, and vivid characters. 3. Meet Forest Friends: Interact with various animal friends in the forest to unlock new stories and puzzles. 4. Exploration and Discovery: Uncover hidden secrets as you explore every corner of the forest. Why It's the Perfect Choice for Players: 'Paws Trail' is suitable for all ages, with beautiful graphics and a captivating storyline that will transport you into a mystical world of the forest. Join the black cat on this adventure to meet new friends and experience an unforgettable journey. Embark on your forest adventure now with 'Paws Trail'! * This is still a visual demo version.

rows.name: KoChaos
rows.short_description: Slash, shoot, explode, vaporize, smash, and destroy, enemies with eight heroes to use to your advantage! Fight tons of bosses on one of four difficulties in the incredibly difficult souls-like/risk-like. The game takes inspiration from Risk of Rain 2, Dark Souls combat, and Vampire Survivors.
rows.description_html: Hi! I'm Alexander and this is my game KoChaos! This is a project I've been working on since 2020. Me and a buddy always discussed wanting to make a game in middle school and I went for it. It took me forever to get the idea down but I think I've got it. In KoChaos, you aim to defeat minions and bosses to collect XP to get extremely powerful. There are four difficulties that you can use to your advantage. Start small on Easy and work your way to Ko difficulty. There are eight heroes you can level up to your heart's content. Each has three abilities and there primary attacks to use at your disposal. There are tons of bosses to fight and conquer as well. -Features- - You can use glowing emerald swords. - Every bit of XP you gain for a hero stays with that hero and the stats. - The longer you play the easier the game becomes. - Guns are here for some reason. - Dash like never before! - You can infinitely ascend your heroes to make them extremely powerful. - No cap on stats. - The enemies have one eye. I hope you hop in the game and enjoy!

rows.name: Mortal Glory 2 Prologue
rows.short_description: Manage a team of traveling gladiators in this turn-based fantasy roguelike. Find the best recruits, tinker with unique items and discover clever tactics on the battlefield. The tournament awaits those who desire MORTAL GLORY!
rows.description_html: Buy the full game! More skills, new game mode, unique items, bosses and a lot more! About the Game Mortal Glory 2 Prologue gives a quick glimpse into what the full game contains. Roll an explosive barrel at your enemy, throw them into a pit or take out two enemies by knocking them into each other. With a wide variety of tools available to you, your creativity will determine how you deal with the competition. Unique arenas, randomized environments and occasional special rules ensure that each fight offers new tactical opportunities. A wide variety of fantasy races are seeking glory, each with their own unique racial strengths. Whatever your tactics are, finding the best recruits is essential! There is a vast collection of unique relics, character perks and more to discover. Finding clever combos and deadly synergies will unlock new strategies and occasionally turn your gladiators into unfairly strong demons. Various difficulty settings will accommodate your preferred playstyle and there are increasingly harder challenges to master. But beware... The AI is brutally talented at the highest levels. With every step comes a new challenge or perhaps... an opportunity? It is up to you to guide where your team should travel next... and suffer the consequences. Each playthrough is different! With various tactics to try and additional increasingly harder challenges to master, the arena will keep welcoming you back again and again. Thanks to conveniently paced combat, Mortal Glory 2 is also great to play if you only have a moment to spare.

rows.name: Trail of the Wretched
rows.short_description: Nobody said being a photographer was easy.
rows.description_html: A land of danger and decay. You hop off the boat and step onto the dirt of the New World. The wind is suffocating. The people are suspicious. Outlaws roam free and corruption is an everyday fact of life. Between the small towns littered across the continent is a vast wilderness where no sane person would dare to venture. You are entirely out of your element, but there's no turning back now. Take those pictures like you were told to do, and try not to say anything stupid. Trail of the Wretched is a bleak visual novel set on a fictional continent inspired by the old west. You play as a photographer sent across the ocean to capture the New World in all its untamed and horrible beauty. You'll argue with the voices in your head, witness unspeakable acts, cross rivers, acquire a fancy new coat, put your head in a noose, and maybe, just maybe, you'll say something profound. Length: 1-2 Hours.

rows.name: Sluggerpunk
rows.short_description: Sluggerpunk is a gripping 2D survivors roguelike adventure. As you navigate through a myriad of challenges, hone your skills and strategies to clash with formidable foes lurking in the underground. Build a versatile arsenal of abilities and gear to enhance your chances to survive, but will you?
rows.description_html: About This Game Dive deep into the underground world of Sluggerpunk, where shadows loom large and danger lurks around every corner. Here, beneath the surface of a corrupt city, you arm yourself with nothing but a trusty baseball bat and baseballs to beat back the darkness and carve out a legend all your own. Make yourself stronger by buying powerful upgrades from Telebi's shop. Survive in an arena mode that will require every possible trick you got up your sleeve. The longer you survive the stronger you, and the enemies, get.

rows.description_html: Satori is a Hack & Slash Roguelike game with a third-person camera where a mask allows you to choose between different passive abilities and a ghost arm gives you different special abilities that you must use to fight against yokais and Japanese gods, all with a unique aesthetic. Each enemy will give you coins that you can exchange in the lobby for new skills or character upgrades. If you die, you will always return to the lobby.

rows.name: Incursion2D
rows.short_description: A fast paced action RPG where you will fight increasingly difficult waves of enemies, each with unique abilities! You will be fighting various bosses, work on your secondary skills, collect cosmetics for your character and work on your very own island!
rows.description_html: Fast paced reactive combat  Wave based enemies with unique moves each increasing in difficulty Advanced bossfights that don't care about your stats Decorate your own island and enhance your home which acts as the games' storage system Work on secondary skills and systems to enhance the power of your character: Farming, Alchemy, Fishing, Smithing and much more to come Gather equipment to change up your build Unlock new attack combo's/styles and ultimate abilities throughout your journey Personalize your characters by grinding out pets, outfits and character auras Combat should never be boring and require your focus at all times, that's why instead of having the player choose a class, you get to utilize each combat style at once! Quick swapping between melee, magic and ranged allows for mixing in a lot actions at once, increasing involvement and clearing out monsters in style! Each category of enemy you encounter in the world will have plenty of variants jumping into the fray to hit you with surprise mechanics! You will clear waves of these invaders in each room until you find the leader of that specific category! Getting to a boss and being able to finish it should feel satisfying at all times. Because we believe in the concept of making sure bosses should always be challenging, in this game you will not actually be able to out-level a boss to be able to cheese through it! Player stats aren't relevant in these fights and are a true test of skill and using your toolkit! Is that not enough for you?  Fear not! For each boss will have a hardcore version available with instakill mechanics that will be sure to keep you on your toes! How can one feel at home in a game without actually having a home? And why should you stop there? Enjoy a magical floating island that you can customize using all sorts of art assets that you encounter throughout your journey! You'll also unlock more floating islands as you progress further! Need a break from cutting through your enemies? Why not get stronger while doing that as well? Skills will give you passive combat increases and unlock various ingredients needed to upgrade other systems as well as materials to purchase furniture for your player owned island! You like shiny things? So do crows but don't let that stop you! At the end of every set of waves you slap a crystal which will reward you with a random piece of loot! Mix and match to get the build you want and try to get the rarest drops on the tables! Sometimes you just want to stop and admire. Unlock various outfits, pets and auras throughout your journey that will show off your progression and challenges in a fun way! And yes these will be shown off when multiplayer comes around (soon!) as well! - Continued Multiplayer support. Currently you are able to meet and chat to people online. You can always play in a party and heal/buff each other. In the endgame you are also able to tackle combat challenges together in the forms of dungeons! More of these will become available throughout the lifecycle of the game. - New skills will be added over time and upon the release of each new continent! - Controller support  already exists in a basic form. While the game is playable with a controller, certain features are still missing on it and it's not very smooth to navigate a menu. This will be iterated upon further down the line. - Content that gets added as you go. For this Early Access release you will have access to the first three continents of the game, the Weathered Woods, The Empire and The Frozen North!  We will gradually release new areas and bosses for you to progress through . Below is a sneak peek at what the world map looks like currently! We hope you'll enjoy your stay! Come help us shape the game at our Discord, let us know your thoughts or just join us for a conversation!

rows.name: Westland Survival
rows.short_description: Saddle up for the ultimate survival adventure in the untamed Wild West! Build your homestead, tame the wilderness, bounty hunt the outlaws, and duel against the dangers that lurk on the frontier. Do you have what it takes to be a legend of the West?
rows.description_html: Survive the Wild West and Build Your Legacy Step into the unforgiving world of the Wild West. In Westland Survival , you’ll build and expand your own ranch, tame fierce beasts, craft powerful weapons, chase outlaws, and take part in intense PvP showdowns—all in a world teeming with danger, opportunity, and mystery. Build and Expand Your Ranch Establish your homestead from the ground up. Gather resources, craft workbenches, and fortify your property. Grow crops, rear livestock, and turn your ranch into a true frontier stronghold. Tame, Breed, and Fight with Pets Hunt wild beasts, tame them, and turn them into loyal companions. Breed animals at your ranch to unlock stronger perks and build your ultimate pack—whether it's wolves, bears, or other fierce allies. Every predator you meet at the prairies can be your ally—even alligators! Raise and Ride Your Horses Build stables and breed horses with unique traits. Whether you need speed for swift travel or strength for hauling wagons, there’s a wide variety of types and colors to choose from. Craft Weapons and Gear Survive with a handcrafted arsenal. Forge everything from classic revolvers to durable armor. Discover rare blueprints to improve and customize your loadout to fit your playstyle. Engage in PvP and Join Alliances Prove your mettle in duels and clan wars. Join forces with other players in alliances, compete in ladders like Gold Rush, and dominate the Wild West!  Explore Mystical and Dangerous Frontiers This land holds more than outlaws—it echoes with the ancient legends of the Indigious, now brought to life. Venture into mysterious locations like the Canyon Trials and the Spirit Cave, where facing mythical forces grants powerful rewards. Uncover a Rich and Twisting Storyline The West holds secrets beyond survival. Follow a gripping storyline filled with frontier justice, ancient mysteries, and personal revenge. Meet unforgettable characters, investigate the disappearance of your sister, and face choices that shape your path through a lawless land. Dive into Regular Events and Challenges Experience rotating in-game events, time-limited challenges, and global activities that keep the frontier full of fresh content and rewards. Answer the call of the Wild West. Build your ranch, ride into battle, and become a legend.

rows.name: Blaster Multiplayer
rows.short_description: Thrust into the fray of Blaster Multiplayer, a tactical third-person shooter where strategy meets intense combat.
rows.description_html: About This Game Overview: Immerse yourself in the relentless action of Blaster Multiplayer , a third-person shooter. Striking a balance between strategic depth and high-octane gameplay, this game offers a robust platform for both competitive gamers and those looking to showcase their game development acumen. Gameplay Details: At its core, Blaster Multiplayer delivers dynamic combat scenarios across varied environments, each requiring a distinct strategic approach. Engage in the classic Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch modes where skill, precision, and teamwork pave the path to victory. As a showcase of technical prowess, 'Blaster Multiplayer' is a testament to sophisticated game design, featuring polished mechanics, seamless multiplayer experiences, and a display of advanced graphics. Key Features: Multiplayer Excellence: Enjoy refined matchmaking in both Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch modes. Varied Battlefields: Compete across multiple maps, each offering unique strategic advantages. Futuristic Armaments: Access an extensive arsenal of high-tech weaponry and gadgets. Visual and Technical Finesse: Powered by Unreal Engine 5 for groundbreaking visuals and physics. A Developer's Craft: More than a game - a professional portfolio piece exemplifying top-tier game development. Step into the Arena: Blaster Multiplayer beckons you to a constantly evolving battlefield. Perfect for those aiming to climb the leaderboards or scrutinize expert game development, the game stands ready to challenge your skills. Are you prepared to join the ranks and leave your mark ?

rows.name: Karina Katana
rows.short_description: A 'Sidescroller' Adventure with Fight Mechanics and Leveling System for your skills and items.
rows.description_html: Description Karina Katana is a classic 2D-style action adventure in a world divided into individual levels with 8 exciting biomes. Gameplay You level up your skills to traverse the different worlds and fight 8 different types of enemies. Every opponent has different strengths and weaknesses. You need to recognize these and use them against them. Upgrades Each enemy drops different items when you defeat them. Collect your opponents' items and use them to improve your weapons and skills in the shop. Items / Skins Find new items in the newly unlocked biomes and unlock new skins by playing. Speedrunning Each level also has a timer with which you can see your speed so you can be faster next time. You can also get up to 3 badges for different challenges for each level.

rows.name: Coin Pusher Live
rows.short_description: Rigged? Maybe. Fun? Absolutely. Engage, enrage, and let your chat flood the machine with coins using !drop. The more they play, the more you win. Turn your Twitch & YouTube streams into a live arcade where skill is a myth and the house always wins…probably. Add Coin Pusher Live to your stream today!
rows.description_html: NOW SUPPORTING TWITCH & YOUTUBE! DISCLAIMER : This is not an online gambling game. You do not use real money to drop your coins in game. Anything sold in the store is purely cosmetic, and can be purchased with both points earned from playing or steam wallet. This game is to host on your live streams, and your viewers !drop in chat for sh!%s and giggles. Does not cost the streamer or viewer anything to play. Easy to setup and connect to your live streams. Once connected, you just drop coins in chat for fun with viewers! Players always have 25 coins to drop even if they hit 0! Immerse yourself and your viewers in an interactive gaming experience like never before. As the streamer, you become the host of the virtual arcade. Viewers do not need the game, only Streamers. The machine is designed to be a more realistic experience, without the parody nonsense.     Coin Pusher Live is a community building tool that adds a layer of interactivity to your content, making your stream an even more engaging destination for viewers! Important : This is a stream chat interactive game. Coin Pusher Live requires a Twitch or YouTube account to play. Viewers play through a streamer's live stream and do not need to download the game to play. The game will become active once you successfully connect your Stream.  To play once connected, type !drop in chat to drop coins.

The altar is a place for the resurrection of the ancient demon. The heroes will break into the ghost's estate to deter it. Control the skulls and bring the ancient demon resurrect safely. If you have any bugs or questions, please sen me an email ! : minsang0610@gmail.com . Thank you for playing.

rows.short_description: Rise of the Eternal is a 2D-side scroller developed in Unreal Engine 5. It has beat'em up aspects and boss battles.
rows.description_html: Rise of the Eternal is a 2D side scrolling game developed in Unreal Engine 5, it seamlessly combines platformer and beat'em up aspects. The pixel art design gives a nostalgic yet modern feel, offering a visually distinctive experience. As players embark on this early journey, they not only face the challenges of the first level but also contribute valuable feedback that will shape the future content of this promising title.

rows.name: Abstract Code
rows.short_description: Embark on a unique gaming experience that delves into thought-provoking themes... this SHMUP/Visual Novel hybrid offers a compelling narrative interspersed with addictive arcade gameplay.
rows.description_html: Embark on a unique gaming experience that delves into thought-provoking themes... this SHMUP/Visual Novel hybrid offers a compelling narrative interspersed with addictive arcade gameplay. Play through the captivating Story Mode , immersing yourself in a journey that combines engaging storytelling with arcade excitement. Alternatively, challenge your skills in the pure Arcade Mode , a score attack mode featuring 6 levels of intense action. Explore CODE KNIGHT's personal space within the game, an Apartment where you can enjoy a Juke Box, Gallery, and more additional FREE CONTENT In the digital world of Abstract Code, assume the role of CODE KNIGHT and embark on a mission to rectify the errors made by those less accountable than yourself. Engage in thrilling battles against the FINK incursion into humanities' knowledge center, CODENAME D1, and uncover the truth behind the enigmatic character known as Katie. Please note that the game contains content that may be triggering, as it explores various sensitive topics such as social masking, and transhuman identity. Stay connected with us on our Insta page @_ruok2000_

rows.name: L'Île Archéo
rows.short_description: Explore a strange island and discover the secret of the mysterious human civilisation. Restore artefacts and uncover the past in this serious game about ecology, archeology and what will remain after we are gone.
rows.description_html: L’Île Archéo is a student game project made by student of the NAD UQAC about ecology, archeology and what will remain after we are gone. Play as Titi, a young archeologist on his first field internship on the mysterious Archéo Island, home of the lost human civilisation. Explore the island, rendered in a painterly picture book aesthetics, use your tools to recover and clean the artefacts you find, collect information, and discover the secrets of the island. The game was awarded the Bourse de rayonnement Illogika 2023-2024 as well as the Technical Excellence Award from the CHI PLAY 2023 Student Game Design Competition. Features: Explore the island: The Archéo island is a newly discovered island full of unexplored ruins of the now lost human civilisation. While they were the dominant civilisation of earth for several thousands of years there are now gone, bringing with them their strange tradition and secrets. In a 3d isometric view you will explore the beautifully rendered island with a painterly artstyle. Meet your colleagues: You will not be alone on your adventure, you will work side by side with your field supervisor and muscle bound corvid Corbac as well as your analyst and 8 armed technology expert Poulpa, nothing can go wrong with their expert guidance. Restore artefacts: Use your multitool to explore dark ruins and smash any obstacle standing in your way! By hammering, scraping, brushing, and cleaning, you will recover and restore lost artefact to discover the purpose of those strange fragment of the human civilisation. Uncover the secret of the island! Maybe you will be able to understand and solve the greatest mystery of the island; why did the human disappeared?

rows.short_description: Capybara: The Story of Sisyphus is a game about a very lazy capybara who wants to take a bath at the top of the mountain. To do this, the capybara must gain speed and cling to the obstacles with a rope with a barrel so as not to fall!
rows.description_html: Special Offer DISCORD About the Game You play as a very lazy capybara who has to climb a mountain to take a bath in his barrel! It seemed that the capybara had already accepted her fate of not being able to take a bath. Prepare for the falls, try not to fall and keep going. Travel through different eras and reach the top of the mountain! You have a rope with a barrel to balance while climbing. Use all your experience to hold on to the capybara. There are several locations in the game: 🐪 Walk through ancient architecture! ⚔️ See medieval houses and walk through narrow streets! 🌵 Wild West - Walk through a small base and out into the mines! 🍜The City - Stroll down an anime inspired street! ⛰️ Climb a mountain and take a bath! ☯ If you suddenly fall off the mountain, there's a small chance you'll end up on the roof of a steampunk building!

rows.name: Gun vs. Zombies
rows.short_description: Gun vs. Zombies is a thrilling showdown where precision meets undead mayhem. Take control of a dynamic gun affected by physics as you fend off waves of zombies hungry for a brain feast. Compete against others on the global leaderboard by showcasing your shooting skills.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Gun vs. Zombies, the ultimate showdown between firepower and the undead! Brace yourself for an intense, physics-driven experience where your trusty gun becomes more than just a tool—it's your lifeline against waves of hungry zombies. In Gun vs. Zombies, you're in control of a unique weapon that's not just about aiming and firing. This isn't your typical shooter; the gun's physics play a crucial role in your strategy. Every shot you take applies forces to the gun, causing it to move dynamically. Your skill in managing this movement while taking down hordes of zombies will determine your survival. Your mission is clear: defend the precious brain located on the stage. Waves of relentless zombies are relentlessly advancing, driven by an insatiable hunger. It's up to your sharpshooting skills and mastery of the gun's physics to keep them at bay and prevent them from reaching their ultimate goal. Compete against other players and showcase your skills on the global leaderboard! In Gun vs. Zombies, it's not just about surviving the zombie onslaught—it's about proving your mastery. Climb the ranks by showcasing your prowess in eliminating the undead. Are you ready to experience the adrenaline rush of controlling a weapon that challenges traditional shooting mechanics? Get ready to immerse yourself in Gun vs. Zombies, where precision, strategy, and the laws of physics collide in a battle for survival!
