rows.name: Per Aspera Test
rows.short_description: Survive an intense 5-minute challenge in Per Aspera Test, a nostalgic horror game reminiscent of the PlayStation 1 era. Run, decide, and confront stressful challenges. Run, breathe, think fast - can you handle it? Share results with friends and find out who's the best!
rows.description_html: Curious to find out just how fast your mind works in a life-or-death situation? Welcome to the Per Aspera Test – a scary game that looks like those old PlayStation 1 games. Picture this: an intense 5-minute challenge, you against the unknown, racing to survive. Can you make split-second decisions and find your way out? Time to put your skills to the test! And hey, if you manage to escape, we've got some results waiting for you at the end! WHAT TO EXPECT Run for Your Life: Imagine you're in a movie, and you have to run away from scary stuff. That's what this game feels like. Run, make decisions fast, and try not to get too scared! Old-School Design: It's like going back to the old days of video games. The graphics are pixelated, just like the games on the first PlayStation. It's familiar but also kind of spooky. Stressful Challenges: We added some annoying and scary things on purpose to make it extra tough. Can you handle the stress and still be a quick thinker? Attention: Consideration for Visual Sensitivity Please be cautious: if you're sensitive to bright lights, this may not be the right fit for you. Our aim is for everyone to enjoy the game without feeling uneasy. Your comfort is important to us. HOW TO PLAY Run, breathe, and think fast to survive. It's not easy, but it's super fun. When you're done, we'll tell you how quick you were. Share with your friends and see who's the best!

rows.name: Joy Land
rows.short_description: Lewis, an intelligent detective, finds himself on a mission to uncover the truth behind the many disappearances including his sister's. With the help of Joy, Lewis is going to explore what lies behind these walls. only to realize that there's much more to discover than he initially thought.
rows.description_html: This game is chapter based, this is the first chapter of this game! Features Joy Land is a first-person horror game that contains puzzles, exploration, investigation and more! Joy is the one that you always need to count on while playing this game, with her help you can uncover the mysteries of Joy Land. You can communicate with her through your special Joy walkie talkie, or what we like to call, The Joy Communicator! Lewis is the protagonist of this story, he'll try to explore and investigate on what happened to his sister and the many disappearances. Echo your virtual assistant, she's going to help Lewis too, with giving him an access card for many areas, and she's connected in all of Joy Land's devices, so if Lewis needed some help and Joy wasn't there he knows who to call! Welcome to Joy Land! Joy Land is a place to be enJOYed by all ages! Here, we provide you with the best experiences and memories that'll last forever. Making our guests happy is a rule we always follow, ensuring that every guest leaves with joy. JoyBots! To make the experience more enJOYable, our JoyBots are the best at it! They're the most fun, smart and joyful robots the world has ever seen. Our main mascot and symbol, Joy , is a friend for every guest, so if you're lonely you know who to call! Each JoyBot have their own special charm in this place, so what are you waiting for? come and have FUN! The Telly .V Show! How can we forget about Telly? The host with the most! With Telly .V you can have fun, joy, and even receiving education. With Mr. V you can be the next winner!!! So, what are waiting for? Come to Joy Land and sign up TODAY!

rows.name: Finding Cinderella
rows.short_description: A lighthearted game about love and murder.
rows.description_html: A lighthearted game about love and murder. Assume the role of a royal successor to the throne, who is definitely not very good at their job or the brightest bulb there is, in their quest of finding the love of their life in the upcoming royal ball - select one of the 9 ladies to be your Cinderella. Fun times. But beware! There is an assassin coming for your life disguised as one of the ladies! Oh no! You must reveal the assassin's identity in 3 days time while winning the heart of your future queen. Get to know each lady, search for clues, but most importantly, survive! Multiple playthroughs! Assassin changes every round! Approximately 10 hours of quality time filled with love and blood. 9 or so romanceable ladies Epic minigames that will challenge your sanity as they progress Interactive BGs and daily activities! Achievements! Can you collect them all? Funny and livid dialogue sure to keep you mildly entertained! A unique art style, 20+ CGs, animated sprites! Jampacked with OWO energy throughout! Lady Anna Belle A bubbly daughter of merchants who just wants to know what’s inside your heart. Also, never refuse her cupcakes made with love, NEVER. Lady Sophie de Fleur A lady of royal lineage such as yourself, except that she’s a loner, but wants someone to understand and love her. Will you be able to catch her eye? Lady Juliet Espada Fearless, bold and confident, and a member of the royal guards, this lady sure is no damsel in distress. Humor is her best defense. Lady Katarzyna Von Liechtenstein Horses. Lady Gwynne Vanderbilt A lady with a mysterious background, for some reason, doesn’t show any interest in you at all. Maybe the rumors were true, maybe she did, infact, only come cus her father told her to. Lady Jewell Blue Your childhood friend, you remember her don’t you? A perfect lady in every way, or so they say. Lady Maria Keetab Smart, kind and patient, this lady is a teacher at the local orphanage. Is there a place in her heart for one more child? Lady Anastasia Nikolaevna Romanov I know. Lady Lilly Lupin Curious, energetic and eager to live her life to the fullest, this lady never stops. Will you help her find what she’s looking for?
